x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C11-MemHierarchy/caching.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 11.4. CPU Caches 在 描述了存储设备 、认识了 时间局部性和空间局部性 这两种重要模式之后，我们就可以来探讨 CPU 缓存是如何设计和实现的了。 缓存 （cache）是 CPU 上一种小而快的存储设备，存放主存的有限子集。缓存面临几个重要的设计问题： Having characterized storage devices and recognized the important patterns of temporal and spatial locality , we’re ready to explore how CPU caches are designed and implemented. A cache is a small, fast storage device on a CPU that holds limited subsets of main memory. Caches face several important design questions: 缓存应当存放程序内存的 哪些 子集？ Which subsets of a program’s memory should the cache hold? 缓存应当在 何时 把程序数据的某个子集从主存复制到缓存，或者反过来？ When should the cache copy a subset of a program’s data from main memory to the cache, or vice versa? 系统 如何 判断程序的数据是否在缓存中？ How can a system determine whether a program’s data is present in the cache? 在探讨这些棘手的问题之前，我们需要先介绍一些缓存的行为和术语。回想一下，访问内存中的数据时，程序首先 计算数据的内存地址 。理想情况下，所需地址处的数据已经在缓存中了，程序就可以完全跳过对主存的访问。为了使性能最大化，硬件会把所需的地址 同时 发送给缓存和主存。由于缓存更快、离 ALU 更近，它的响应比内存快得多。如果数据在缓存中（ 缓存命中 ，cache hit），缓存硬件就会取消挂起的内存访问，因为缓存提供数据比内存快。 Before exploring these challenging questions, we need to introduce some cache behavior and terminology. Recall that when accessing data in memory, a program first computes the data’s memory address . Ideally, the data at the desired address already resides in the cache, allowing the program to skip accessing main memory altogether. To maximize performance, the hardware simultaneously sends the desired address to both the cache and main memory. Because the cache is faster and closer to the ALU, the cache responds much more quickly than memory. If the data is present in the cache (a cache hit ), the cache hardware cancels the pending memory access because the cache can serve the data faster than memory. 否则，如果数据不在缓存中（ 缓存未命中 ，cache miss），CPU 别无选择，只能等待内存取回数据。但关键的是，对主存的请求完成后，CPU 会把取回的数据加载到缓存中，以便后续对同一地址的请求（得益于时间局部性，这很可能发生）能由缓存快速满足。即使未命中的内存访问是 写 内存，CPU 在未命中时仍然会把值加载到缓存中，因为程序将来很可能会再次访问同一位置。 Otherwise, if the data isn’t in the cache (a cache miss ), the CPU has no choice but to wait for memory to retrieve it. Critically though, when the request to main memory completes, the CPU loads the retrieved data into the cache so that subsequent requests for the same address (which are likely thanks to temporal locality) can be serviced quickly from the cache. Even if the memory access that misses is writing to memory, the CPU still loads the value into the cache on a miss because it’s likely that the program will attempt to access the same location again in the future. 在未命中后把数据加载到缓存时，CPU 常常会发现缓存没有足够的空闲空间。在这种情况下，缓存必须先 驱逐 （evict）一些驻留的数据，为要加载的新数据腾出空间。由于缓存存放的是从主存复制来的数据子集，驱逐已被修改过的缓存数据时，缓存必须先更新主存的内容，然后才能把数据从缓存中驱逐出去。 When loading data into a cache after a miss, a CPU often finds that the cache doesn’t have enough free space available. In such cases, the cache must first evict some resident data to make room for the new data that it’s loading in. Because a cache stores subsets of data copied from main memory, evicting cached data that has been modified requires the cache to update the contents of main memory prior to evicting data from the cache. 为了提供上述所有功能，缓存设计者采用三种设计之一。本节首先考察 直接映射缓存 ，它比其他设计更简单。 To provide all the aforementioned functionality, cache designers employ one of three designs. This section begins by examining direct-mapped caches , which are less complex than the other designs. 11.4.1. 直接映射缓存 11.4.1. Direct-Mapped Caches 直接映射缓存把它的存储空间划分成称为 缓存行 （cache line）的单元。根据缓存的大小，它可能有几十、几百甚至几千个缓存行。在直接映射缓存中，每个缓存行都独立于其他所有缓存行，并包含两类重要的信息： 缓存数据块 和 元数据 。 A direct-mapped cache divides its storage space into units called cache lines . Depending on the size of a cache, it might hold dozens, hundreds, or even thousands of cache lines. In a direct-mapped cache, each cache line is independent of all the others and contains two important types of information: a cache data block and metadata . 缓存数据块 （cache data block，常简称为 缓存块 ，cache block）存放来自主存的程序数据的一个子集。缓存块存放多字节的程序数据块，以利用 空间局部性 。缓存块的大小决定了缓存与主存之间数据传输的单位。也就是说，从内存向缓存加载数据时，缓存每次收到的都是一个缓存块大小的数据块。 缓存设计者在选择缓存的块大小时需要权衡。在存储预算固定的情况下，缓存可以存放较多的小块，或者较少的大块。使用较大的块能提高空间局部性好的程序的性能，而块数较多则让缓存有机会存放更多样化的内存子集。归根结底，哪种策略性能最好取决于应用程序的工作负载。由于通用 CPU 无法对系统上的应用程序做太多假设，如今典型的 CPU 缓存使用 16 到 64 字节之间的折中块大小。 A cache data block (often shortened to cache block ) stores a subset of program data from main memory. Cache blocks store multibyte chunks of program data to take advantage of spatial locality . The size of a cache block determines the unit of data transfer between the cache and main memory. That is, when loading a cache with data from memory, the cache always receives a chunk of data the size of a cache block. Cache designers balance a trade-off in choosing a cache’s block size. Given a fixed storage budget, a cache can store more smaller blocks or fewer larger blocks. Using larger blocks improves performance for programs that exhibit good spatial locality, whereas having more blocks gives a cache the opportunity to store a more diverse subset of memory. Ultimately, which strategy provides the best performance depends on the workload of applications. Because general-purpose CPUs can’t assume much about a system’s applications, a typical CPU cache today uses middle-of-the-road block sizes ranging from 16 to 64 bytes. 译注 Apple Silicon 是一个例外：译者在 Apple M1 Pro 上用 sysctl hw.cachelinesize 查到的缓存行大小是 128 字节。 元数据 （metadata）存放关于缓存行数据块内容的信息。缓存行的元数据 不 包含程序数据，而是维护缓存行的簿记信息（例如，帮助识别缓存行的数据块存放的是内存的哪个子集）。 Metadata stores information about the contents of the cache line’s data block. A cache line’s metadata does not contain program data. Instead, it maintains bookkeeping information for the cache line (for example, to help identify which subset of memory the cache line’s data block holds). 当程序试图访问一个内存地址时，缓存必须知道到哪里去找对应的数据，检查所需的数据在那个缓存位置上是否可用，如果可用，就把所存缓存块的一部分取给发出请求的程序。下面的步骤详细介绍在缓存中查找并取出数据的过程。 When a program attempts to access a memory address, a cache must know where to look to find the corresponding data, check whether the desired data is available at that cache location, and if so, retrieve a portion of the stored cache block to the requesting application. The following steps walk through the details of this process for finding data in a cache and retrieving it. 定位缓存中的数据 Locating Cached Data 缓存必须能够快速判断与所请求地址对应的内存子集当前是否在缓存中。要回答这个问题，缓存首先必须确定要检查哪一个（或哪些）缓存行。在直接映射缓存中，内存中的每个地址都对应于 恰好 一个缓存行。这一限制正是 直接映射 这个名字的由来：它把每个内存地址直接映射到一个缓存行。 A cache must be able to quickly determine whether the subset of memory corresponding to a requested address currently resides in the cache. To answer that question, a cache must first determine which cache line(s) to check. In a direct-mapped cache, each address in memory corresponds to exactly one cache line. This restriction explains the direct-mapped name — it maps every memory address directly to one cache line. 图 1 展示了在一个有四个缓存行、缓存块大小为 32 字节的小型直接映射缓存中，内存地址是如何映射到缓存行的。回想一下，缓存的块大小代表缓存与主存之间数据传输的最小单位。因此，每个内存地址都落在某个 32 字节的范围内，而每个范围映射到一个缓存行。 Figure 1 shows how memory addresses map to cache lines in a small direct-mapped cache with four cache lines and a 32-byte cache block size. Recall that a cache’s block size represents the smallest unit of data transfer between a cache and main memory. Thus, every memory address falls within one 32-byte range, and each range maps to one cache line. 图 1. 在一个有四个缓存行、缓存块为 32 字节的直接映射缓存中，内存地址到缓存行的映射示例 Figure 1. An example mapping of memory addresses to cache lines in a four-line direct-mapped cache with 32-byte cache blocks 注意，尽管每个内存区域只映射到一个缓存行，但许多内存范围会映射到 同一个 缓存行。映射到同一缓存行的所有内存区域（即 图 1 中颜色相同的块）争夺同一个缓存行的空间，所以每种颜色的区域一次只能有一个驻留在缓存中。 Note that although each region of memory maps to only one cache line, many memory ranges map to the same cache line. All of the memory regions that map the same cache line (that is, chunks of the same color in Figure 1 ) compete for space in the same cache line, so only one region of each color can reside in the cache at a time. 缓存使用内存地址中的一部分位，把内存地址映射到缓存行。为了把数据更均匀地分散到各个缓存行中，缓存使用取自内存地址 中间 的位来确定地址映射到哪一行，这部分称为地址的 索引 （index）部分。用作索引的位数（各不相同）决定了缓存有多少行。 图 2 展示了内存地址的索引部分指向一个缓存行。 A cache maps a memory address to a cache line using a portion of the bits in the memory address. To spread data more evenly among cache lines, caches use bits taken from the middle of the memory address, known as the index portion of the address, to determine which line the address maps to. The number of bits used as the index (which varies) determines how many lines a cache will hold. Figure 2 shows the index portion of a memory address referring to a cache line. 图 2. 内存地址中间的 索引 部分确定一个缓存行。 Figure 2. The middle index portion of a memory address identifies a cache line. 当程序数据聚集在一起时（局部性好的程序常常如此），使用地址的中间部分可以减少对同一缓存行的争夺。也就是说，程序倾向于把变量彼此相邻地存放在少数几个位置（例如栈上或堆上）。这些聚集在一起的变量具有相同的高位地址位。因此，如果用高位来做索引，这些聚集的变量就会全都映射到同一些缓存行上，让缓存的其余部分闲置。通过使用地址中间的位，缓存能把数据更均匀地分散到可用的缓存行中。 Using the middle of the address reduces competition for the same cache line when program data is clustered together, which is often the case for programs that exhibit good locality. That is, programs tend to store variables nearby one another in one of a few locations (for example, on the stack or heap). Such clustered variables share the same high-order address bits. Thus, indexing with the high-order bits would cause the clustered variables to all map to the same cache lines, leaving the rest of the cache unused. By using bits from the middle of the address, caches spread data more evenly among the available cache lines. 识别缓存中的内容 Identifying Cache Contents 接下来，找到合适的缓存行后，缓存必须判断该行是否存有所请求的地址。由于多个内存范围映射到同一个缓存行，缓存要检查该行的元数据来回答两个重要问题： 这个缓存行存放的是不是有效的内存子集？ 如果是，它当前存放的是映射到这个缓存行的众多内存子集中的哪一个？ Next, having located the appropriate cache line, the cache must determine whether that line holds the requested address. Because multiple memory ranges map to the same cache line, the cache examines the line’s metadata to answer two important questions: Does this cache line hold a valid subset of memory? If so, which of the many subsets of memory that map to this cache line does it currently hold? 为了回答这些问题，每个缓存行的元数据都包含一个有效位和一个标记。 有效位 （valid bit）是一个单独的位，表示该行当前是否存放着有效的内存子集（有效位为 1 时）。无效的行（有效位为 0）永远不会产生缓存命中，因为还没有数据被加载进去。无效的行实际上代表缓存中的空闲空间。 To answer these questions, each cache line’s metadata includes a valid bit and a tag. The valid bit is a single bit that indicates whether a line is currently storing a valid subset of memory (if valid is set to 1). An invalid line (if valid is set to 0) never produces a cache hit because no data has been loaded into it. Invalid lines effectively represent free space in the cache. 除了有效位之外，每个缓存行的元数据还存有一个 标记 （tag），它唯一地标识该行的缓存块存放的是内存的哪个子集。标记字段存放缓存行中所存地址范围的高位，让缓存行能够记录它的数据块来自内存中的哪个位置。换句话说，由于许多内存子集映射到同一个缓存行（那些索引位相同的子集），标记记录的是其中哪一个子集当前存在于缓存行中。 In addition to a valid bit, each cache line’s metadata stores a tag that uniquely identifies which subset of memory the line’s cache block holds. The tag field stores the high-order bits of the address range stored in the cache line and allows a cache line to track where in memory its data block came from. In other words, because many memory subsets map to the same cache line (those with the same index bits), the tag records which of those subsets is currently present in the cache line. 要让缓存查找产生命中，缓存行中存放的标记字段必须与程序所请求内存地址的标记部分（高位）完全匹配。标记不匹配表示缓存行的数据块不包含所请求的内存，即使该行存放的是有效数据。 图 3 展示了缓存如何把内存地址划分为标记和索引，用索引位选出目标缓存行，验证该行的有效位，并检查该行的标记是否匹配。 For a cache lookup to produce a hit, the tag field stored in the cache line must exactly match the tag portion (upper bits) of the program’s requested memory address. A tag mismatch indicates that a cache line’s data block does not contain the requested memory, even if the line stores valid data. Figure 3 illustrates how a cache divides a memory address into a tag and an index, uses the index bits to select a target cache line, verifies a line’s valid bit, and checks the line’s tag for a match. 图 3. 用所请求内存地址的索引位找到合适的缓存行后，缓存同时验证该行的有效位，并把它的标记与所请求地址的标记进行比较。如果该行有效且标记匹配，查找就以命中告终。 Figure 3. After using the requested memory address’s index bits to locate the proper cache line, the cache simultaneously verifies the line’s valid bit and checks its tag against the requested address’s tag. If the line is valid with a matching tag, the lookup succeeds as a hit. 取出缓存中的数据 Retrieving Cached Data 最后，用程序所请求的内存地址找到合适的缓存行，并验证该行存放着包含该地址的有效内存子集之后，缓存把所请求的数据发送给 CPU 中需要它的部件。由于缓存行数据块的大小（例如 64 字节）通常比程序请求的数据量（例如 4 字节）大得多，缓存把所请求地址的低位用作缓存数据块内的 偏移 （offset）。 图 4 描绘了地址的偏移部分如何确定程序想取的是缓存块中的哪些字节。 Finally, after using the program’s requested memory address to find the appropriate cache line and verifying that the line holds a valid subset of memory containing that address, the cache sends the requested data to the CPU’s components that need it. Because a cache line’s data block size (for example, 64 bytes) is typically much larger than the amount of data that programs request (for example, 4 bytes), caches use the low-order bits of the requested address as an offset into the cached data block. Figure 4 depicts how the offset portion of an address identifies which bytes of a cache block the program expects to retrieve. 图 4. 给定一个缓存数据块，地址的偏移部分确定程序想取的是哪些字节。 Figure 4. Given a cache data block, the offset portion of an address identifies which bytes the program wants to retrieve. 内存地址的划分 Memory Address Division 缓存的 尺寸参数 决定了内存地址中有多少位被解释为偏移、索引和标记部分。等价地，地址中每一部分的位数也意味着缓存必须具有怎样的尺寸参数。在确定地址的哪些位属于哪一部分时，从右往左（即从最低有效位到最高有效位）考虑地址会很有帮助。 The dimensions of a cache dictate how many bits to interpret as the offset, index, and tag portions of a memory address. Equivalently, the number of bits in each portion of an address imply what the dimensions of a cache must be. In determining which bits belong to each portion of an address, it’s helpful to consider the address from right to left (that is, from least to most significant bit). 地址最右边的部分是 偏移 ，它的长度取决于缓存的块大小。地址的偏移部分必须有足够的位，以便指向缓存数据块中每一个可能的字节。例如，假设缓存存放 32 字节的数据块。由于程序可能来要这 32 个字节中的任何一个，缓存需要足够的偏移位来准确描述程序想要的是 32 个可能位置中的哪一个。在这种情况下，偏移需要五位，因为表示 32 个不同的值需要五位（log 2 32 = 5）。反过来，偏移使用四位的缓存，必定存放 16 字节的数据块（2 4 = 16）。 The rightmost portion of the address is the offset , and its length depends on a cache’s block size dimension. The offset portion of an address must contain enough bits to refer to every possible byte within a cache data block. For example, suppose that a cache stores 32-byte data blocks. Because a program might come along asking for any of those 32 bytes, the cache needs enough offset bits to describe exactly which of the 32 possible positions the program might want. In this case, it would need five bits for the offset because five bits are necessary to represent 32 unique values (log 2 32 = 5). In the reverse direction, a cache that uses four bits for the offset must store 16-byte data blocks (2 4 = 16). 地址的 索引 部分紧挨在偏移的左边。要确定索引的位数，就要考虑缓存的行数，因为索引需要足够的位来唯一地标识每一个缓存行。用与偏移类似的逻辑，有 1,024 行的缓存需要 10 位索引（log 2 1,024 = 10）。同样，索引使用 12 位的缓存必定有 4,096 行（2 12 = 4,096）。 The index portion of the address begins immediately to the left of the offset. To determine the number of index bits, consider the number of lines in the cache, given that the index needs enough bits to uniquely identify every cache line. Using similar logic to the offset, a cache with 1,024 lines needs 10 bits for the index (log 2 1,024 = 10). Likewise, a cache that uses 12 bits for the index must have 4,096 lines (2 12 = 4,096). 图 5. 地址的索引部分唯一地标识一个缓存行，偏移部分唯一地标识该行数据块中的一个位置。 Figure 5. The index portion of an address uniquely identifies a cache line, and the offset portion uniquely identifies a position in the line’s data block. 地址中剩下的位构成标记。由于标记必须唯一地标识缓存行中所含的内存子集，标记必须使用地址中 所有 剩余的、未被占用的位。例如，如果机器使用 32 位地址，一个有 5 个偏移位和 10 个索引位的缓存，就用地址中剩下的 32 - 15 = 17 位来表示标记。 The remaining address bits form the tag. Because the tag must uniquely identify the subset of memory contained within a cache line, the tag must use all of the remaining, unclaimed bits of the address. For example, if a machine uses 32-bit addresses, a cache with 5 offset bits and 10 index bits uses the remaining 32 - 15 = 17 bits of the address to represent the tag. 直接映射的读取示例 Direct-Mapped Read Examples 考虑一个具有以下特征的 CPU： Consider a CPU with the following characteristics: 16 位内存地址 16-bit memory addresses 一个有 128 个缓存行的直接映射缓存 a direct-mapped cache with 128 cache lines 32 字节的缓存数据块。 32-byte cache data blocks. 缓存开始时是空的（所有行都无效），如 图 6 所示。 The cache starts empty (all lines are invalid), as shown in Figure 6 . 图 6. 一个空的直接映射示例缓存 Figure 6. An empty direct-mapped example cache 假设在这个 CPU 上运行的程序访问下面这些内存位置： Suppose that a program running on this CPU accesses the following memory locations: 读地址 1010000001100100 Read from address 1010000001100100 读地址 1010000001100111 Read from address 1010000001100111 读地址 1001000000100000 Read from address 1001000000100000 读地址 1111000001100101 Read from address 1111000001100101 把整个序列串起来，跟踪缓存的行为时按照下面的步骤： To put the entire sequence together, follow these steps when tracing the behavior of a cache: 把所请求的地址从右（低位）到左（高位）划分为三部分：缓存数据块内的偏移、指向相应缓存行的索引，以及标识该行存放的是哪个内存子集的标记。 Divide the requested address into three portions, from right (low-order bits) to left (high-order bits): an offset within the cache data block, an index into the appropriate cache line, and a tag to identify which subset of memory the line stores. 用所请求地址的中间部分索引缓存，找到该地址映射到的缓存行。 Index into the cache using the middle portion of the requested address to find the cache line to which the address maps. 检查缓存行的有效位。有效位无效时，无论标记是什么，程序都不能使用该缓存行的内容（缓存未命中）。 Check the cache line’s valid bit. When invalid, the program can’t use a cache line’s contents (cache miss), regardless of what the tag might be. 检查缓存行的标记。如果地址的标记与缓存行的标记匹配并且该行有效，那么缓存行的数据块中就存有程序要找的数据（缓存命中）。否则，缓存必须从主存中把数据加载到所确定的索引处（缓存未命中）。 Check the cache line’s tag. If the address’s tag matches the cache line’s tag and the line is valid, the cache line’s data block holds the data the program is looking for (cache hit). Otherwise, the cache must load the data from main memory at the identified index (cache miss). 命中时，用地址的低位偏移从所存的块中取出程序想要的数据。（示例中未展示。） On a hit, use the low-order offset bits of the address to extract the program’s desired data from the stored block. (Not shown in example.) 地址划分 Address Division 首先确定如何把内存地址划分为 偏移 、 索引 和 标记 部分。从低位到高位（从右到左）考虑地址的各个部分： Begin by determining how to divide the memory addresses into their offset , index , and tag portions. Consider the address portions from low-order to high-order bits (right to left): 偏移 ：块大小为 32 字节，意味着地址最右边的五位（log 2 32 = 5）构成偏移部分。有了五位，偏移就能唯一地标识块中 32 个字节中的任何一个。 Offset : A 32-byte block size implies that the rightmost five bits of the address (log 2 32 = 5) comprise the offset portion. With five bits, the offset can uniquely identify any of the 32 bytes in block. 索引 ：缓存有 128 行，意味着地址接下来的七位（log 2 128 = 7）构成索引部分。有了七位，索引就能唯一地标识每一个缓存行。 Index : A cache with 128 lines implies that the next seven bits of the address (log 2 128 = 7) comprise the index portion. With seven bits, the index can uniquely identify each cache line. 标记 ：标记由不属于偏移或索引的所有剩余地址位组成。在这里，地址还剩下四位构成标记（16 - (5 + 7) = 4）。 Tag : The tag consists of any remaining address bits that don’t belong to the offset or index. Here, the address has four remaining bits left that form the tag (16 - (5 + 7) = 4). 图 7. 读地址 1010000001100100。索引 0000011（第 3 行）无效，所以请求未命中，缓存从主存加载数据。 Figure 7. Read from address 1010000001100100. Index 0000011 (line 3) is invalid, so the request misses and the cache loads data from main memory. 图 8. 读地址 1010000001100111。索引 0000011（第 3 行）有效，并且标记（1010）匹配，所以请求命中。缓存给出其数据块中从第 7 个字节（偏移 0b00111）开始的数据。 Figure 8. Read from address 1010000001100111. Index 0000011 (line 3) is valid, and the tag (1010) matches, so the request hits. The cache yields data beginning at byte 7 (offset 0b00111) of its data block. 图 9. 读地址 1001000000100000。索引 0000001（第 1 行）无效，所以请求未命中，缓存从主存加载数据。 Figure 9. Read from address 1001000000100000. Looking Ahead: Caching on Multicore Processors 到目前为止，我们对缓存的讨论集中在单核处理器上的单级缓存。然而，现代处理器是多核的，并且有多级缓存。通常，在存储器层次结构较高的一级（或几级），每个核心都维护自己私有的缓存，而在较低的级别，所有核心共享一个缓存。 图 1 展示了一个四核处理器上存储器层次结构的例子，其中每个核心都有私有的一级（L1）缓存，而二级（L2）缓存由四个核心共享。 So far our discussion of caching has focused on a single level of cache memory on a single-core processor. Modern processors, however, are multicore with several levels of cache memory. Typically, each core maintains its own private cache memory at the highest level(s) of the memory hierarchy and shares a single cache with all cores at lower levels. Figure 1 shows an example of the memory hierarchy on a four-core processor in which each core contains a private level 1 (L1) cache, and the level 2 (L2) cache is shared by all four cores. 图 1. 多核处理器上的存储器层次结构示例。四个核心各有私有的 L1 缓存，它们通过一条共享总线访问一个共享的 L2 缓存。多核处理器通过内存总线连接到 RAM。 Figure 1. An example memory hierarchy on a multicore processor. Each of the four cores has its own private L1 cache, and all four cores share a single L2 cache that they access through a shared bus. The multicore processor connects to RAM via the memory bus. 回想一下，存储器层次结构中较高的级别比较低的级别访问更快、容量更小。因此，L1 缓存比 L2 缓存更小、更快，而 L2 缓存又比 RAM 更小、更快。还要回想一下，缓存存储的是存储器层次结构中较低一级的值的副本；存放在 L1 缓存中的值，是存放在 L2 缓存中同一个值的副本，而后者又是存放在 RAM 中同一个值的副本。因此，存储器层次结构中较高的级别充当较低级别的缓存。于是，对于 图 1 中的例子，L2 缓存是 RAM 内容的缓存，而每个核心的 L1 缓存是 L2 缓存内容的缓存。 Recall that higher levels of the memory hierarchy are faster to access and smaller in capacity than lower levels of the memory hierarchy. Thus, an L1 cache is smaller and faster than an L2 cache, which in turn is smaller and faster than RAM. Also recall that cache memory stores a copy of a value from a lower level in the memory hierarchy; a value stored in a L1 cache is a copy of the same value stored in the L2 cache, which is a copy of the same value stored in RAM. Thus, higher levels of the memory hierarchy serve as caches for lower levels. As a result, for the example in Figure 1 , the L2 cache is a cache of RAM contents, and each core’s L1 cache is a cache of the L2 cache contents. 多核处理器中的每个核心同时执行一个独立的指令流，这些指令流常常来自不同的程序。给每个核心配一个私有的 L1 缓存，让核心能在它最快的缓存中只存放它正在执行的指令流的数据和指令的副本。换句话说，每个核心的 L1 缓存只存放来自它自己执行流的那些内存块的副本，而不必在所有核心共享的单个 L1 缓存中争夺空间。与所有核心共享一个 L1 缓存的设计相比，这种设计让每个核心私有的 L1 缓存（即它最快的缓存）获得更高的命中率。 Each core in a multicore processor simultaneously executes an independent stream of instructions, often from separate programs. Providing each core a private L1 cache allows the core to store copies of the data and instructions exclusively from the instruction stream it’s executing in its fastest cache memory. In other words, each core’s L1 cache stores a copy of only those blocks of memory that are from its execution stream as opposed to competing for space in a single L1 cache shared by all cores. This design yields a higher hit rate in each core’s private L1 cache (in its fastest cache memory) than one in which all cores share a single L1 cache. 如今的处理器常常有不止两级缓存。台式机系统中常见的是三级缓存，其中最高一级（L1）通常分成两个独立的 L1 缓存，一个用于程序指令，另一个用于程序数据。较低级别的缓存通常是 统一缓存 （unified cache），即同时存放程序数据和指令。每个核心通常维护一个私有的 L1 缓存，并与所有核心共享一个 L3 缓存。位于每个核心私有的 L1 缓存与共享的 L3 缓存之间的 L2 缓存层，在现代 CPU 设计中差异很大。L2 可能是私有的，可能由所有核心共享，也可能是一种混合组织：有多个 L2 缓存，每个由一部分核心共享。 Today’s processors often include more than two levels of cache. Three levels are common in desktop systems, with the highest level (L1) typically split into two separate L1 caches, one for program instructions and the other for program data. Lower-level caches are usually unified caches , meaning that they store both program data and instructions. Each core usually maintains a private L1 cache and shares a single L3 cache with all cores. The L2 cache layer, which sits between each core’s private L1 cache and the shared L3 cache, varies substantially in modern CPU designs. The L2 may be a private L2 cache, may be shared by all cores, or may be a hybrid organization with multiple L2 caches, each shared by a subset of cores. 原书旁注 · Linux 系统上的处理器与缓存信息（Processor and Cache Information on Linux systems） 如果你好奇自己 CPU 的设计，有几种方法可以获取系统上处理器及其缓存组织的信息。例如， lscpu 命令显示处理器的信息，包括它的核心数以及各级缓存的级别和大小： $ lscpu ... CPU(s): 12 Thread(s) per core: 2 Core(s) per socket: 6 Socket(s): 1 ... L1d cache: 192 KiB L1i cache: 384 KiB L2 cache: 3 MiB L3 cache: 16 MiB 这个输出显示共有六个核心（ Socket(s) 的数目乘以 Core(s) per socket ），每个核心都是双路超线程的（ Thread(s) per core ），使六个物理核心在操作系统看来是 12 个 CPU（关于硬件多线程的更多信息，见 第 5.9.2 节 ）。此外，输出还显示有三级缓存（ L1 、 L2 和 L3 ），并且有两个独立的 L1 缓存，一个缓存数据（ L1d ），另一个缓存指令（ L1i ）。 除了 lscpu ， /proc 和 /sys 文件系统中的文件也包含关于处理器的信息。例如，命令 cat /proc/cpuinfo 输出关于处理器的信息，而下面的命令列出某个特定处理器核心的缓存信息（注意，这些文件是按核心的超线程 CPU 命名的，在这个例子中， cpu0 和 cpu6 是核心 0 上的两个超线程 CPU）： $ ls /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cache index0/ index1/ index2/ index3/ 这个输出表明核心 0 有四个缓存（ index0 到 index3 ）。要查看每个缓存的详细信息，查看 index 目录下的 type 、 level 和 shared_cpu_list 文件： $ cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cache/index*/type Data Instruction Unified Unified $ cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cache/index*/level 1 1 2 3 $ cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cache/index*/shared_cpu_list 0,6 0,6 0,6 0-11 type 的输出表明核心 0 有独立的数据缓存和指令缓存，以及另外两个统一缓存。把 level 的输出与 type 的输出对照起来可以看出，数据缓存和指令缓存都是 L1 缓存，而两个统一缓存分别是 L2 和 L3 缓存。 shared_cpu_list 进一步表明，L1 和 L2 缓存是核心 0 私有的（只由核心 0 上的两个超线程 CPU 0 和 6 共享），而 L3 缓存由所有六个核心共享（由所有 12 个超线程 CPU 0-11 共享）。 If you’re curious about your CPU’s design, there are several ways to obtain information about a processor and its cache organization on your system. Additionally, the output shows that there are three levels of cache ( L1 , L2 , and L3 ), and that there are two separate L1 caches, one for caching data ( L1d ) and another for caching instructions ( L1i ). Cache Coherency 由于程序通常表现出很高的访问局部性，让每个核心拥有自己的 L1 缓存，来存放它所执行的指令流中的数据和指令副本，是很有好处的。然而，多个 L1 缓存可能导致 缓存一致性 （cache coherency）问题。当存放在一个核心 L1 缓存中的某个内存块副本的值，与存放在另一个核心 L1 缓存中同一个块的副本的值不同时，就会出现缓存一致性问题。当一个核心写入它 L1 缓存中缓存的某个块，而这个块也缓存在其他核心的 L1 缓存中时，就会发生这种情况。由于缓存块包含的是内存内容的副本，系统需要在该缓存块的所有副本之间维持内存内容一致的单一值。 Because programs typically exhibit a high degree of locality of reference, it is advantageous for each core to have its own L1 cache to store copies of the data and instructions from the instruction stream it executes. However, multiple L1 caches can result in cache coherency problems. Problems with cache coherency arise when the value of a copy of a block of memory stored in one core’s L1 cache is different than the value of a copy of the same block stored in another core’s L1 cache. This situation occurs when one core writes to a block cached in its L1 cache that is also cached in other core’s L1 caches. Because a cache block contains a copy of memory contents, the system needs to maintain a coherent single value of the memory contents across all copies of the cached block. 多核处理器实现了一种 缓存一致性协议 （cache-coherence protocol），来确保可以被多个核心缓存和访问的内存具有一致的视图。缓存一致性协议确保任何访问某个内存位置的核心，看到的都是该内存位置最近被修改的值，而不是它的 L1 缓存中可能存放的一个较旧（过时）的副本。 Multicore processors implement a cache-coherence protocol to ensure a coherent view of memory that can be cached and accessed by multiple cores. A cache coherency protocol ensures that any core accessing a memory location sees the most recently modified value of that memory location rather than seeing an older (stale) copy of the value that may be stored in its L1 cache. 11.6.2. MSI 协议 11.6.2. The MSI Protocol 缓存一致性协议有很多种。这里我们讨论其中一个例子 MSI 协议的细节。 MSI 协议 （Modified、Shared、Invalid，即已修改、共享、无效）给每个缓存行添加三个标志（或位）。标志的值要么是清除（0），要么是置位（1）。这三个标志的值编码了缓存行数据块相对于该块其他缓存副本的一致性状态，它们的值会在对缓存行中的数据块进行读或写访问时触发缓存一致性动作。MSI 协议使用的三个标志是： There are many different cache coherency protocols. Here, we discuss the details of one example, the MSI protocol. The MSI protocol (Modified, Shared, Invalid) adds three flags (or bits) to each cache line. A flag’s value is either clear (0) or set (1). The values of the three flags encode the state of its data block with respect to cache coherency with other cached copies of the block, and their values trigger cache coherency actions on read or write accesses to the data block in the cache line. The three flags used by the MSI protocol are: M 标志：置位时表示该块已被修改，即这个核心写过它缓存的值副本。 The M flag that, if set, indicates the block has been modified, meaning that this core has written to its copy of the cached value. S 标志：置位时表示该块未被修改，可以安全地共享，即多个 L1 缓存可以安全地存放该块的副本并从各自的副本中读取。 The S flag that, if set, indicates that the block is unmodified and can be safely shared, meaning that multiple L1 caches may safely store a copy of the block and read from their copy. I 标志：置位时表示缓存的块无效或包含过时的数据（是数据的一个较旧的副本，不反映该内存块的当前值）。 The I flag that, if set, indicates if the cached block is invalid or contains stale data (is an older copy of the data that does not reflect the current value of the block of memory). 对缓存项的读访问和写访问都会触发 MSI 协议。 The MSI protocol is triggered on read and write accesses to cache entries. 读访问时： On a read access: 如果缓存块处于 M 或 S 状态，就用缓存的值来满足读请求（它的副本的值就是该内存块的最新值）。 If the cache block is in the M or S state, the cached value is used to satisfy the read (its copy’s value is the most current value of the block of memory). 如果缓存块处于 I 状态，说明缓存的副本相对于该块的较新版本已经过时，必须先把该块的新值加载到缓存行中，才能满足读请求。 如果另一个核心的 L1 缓存中存有新值（它存放该值时 M 标志置位，表示它存的是一个修改过的副本），那么那个核心必须先把它的值写回较低的级别（例如写到 L2 缓存）。完成写回之后，它清除该缓存行的 M 标志（它的副本和较低级别中的副本现在一致了），并置位 S 位，表示这个缓存行中的块处于可以被其他核心安全缓存的状态（这个 L1 块与它在 L2 缓存中的副本一致，并且核心是从这个 L1 副本中读到该块的当前值的）。 然后，在 I 标志置位的行上发起读访问的那个核心，就可以把该块的新值加载到它的缓存行中。它清除 I 标志，表示该块现在有效，并存入该块的新值；置位 S 标志，表示该块可以安全地共享（它存的是最新的值，并且与其他缓存副本一致）；清除 M 标志，表示这个 L1 块的值与存放在 L2 缓存中的副本相同（读操作不会修改 L1 中缓存的内存副本）。 If the cache block is in the I state, the cached copy is out of date with a newer version of the block, and the block’s new value needs to be loaded into the cache line before the read can be satisfied. If another core’s L1 cache stores the new value (it stores the value with the M flag set indicating that it stores a modified copy of the value), that other core must first write its value back to the lower level (for example, to the L2 cache). After performing the write-back, it clears the M flag with the cache line (its copy and the copy in the lower-level are now consistent) and sets the S bit to indicate that the block in this cache line is in a state that can be safely cached by other cores (the L1 block is consistent with its copy in the L2 cache and the core read the current value of the block from this L1 copy). The core that initiated the read access on an line with the I flag set can then load the new value of the block into its cache line. It clears the I flag indicating that the block is now valid and stores the new value of the block, sets the S flag indicating that the block can be safely shared (it stores the latest value and is consistent with other cached copies), and clears the M flag indicating that the L1 block’s value matches that of the copy stored in the L2 cache (a read does not modify the L1 cached copy of the memory). 写访问时： On a write access: 如果该块处于 M 状态，就写入该块的缓存副本。标志无需改变（该块仍处于 M 状态）。 If the block is in the M state, write to the cached copy of the block. No changes to the flags are needed (the block remains in the M state). 如果该块处于 I 或 S 状态，就通知其他核心该块正在被写入（修改）。其他以 S 状态存放该块的 L1 缓存需要清除它们的块的 S 位并置位 I 位（它们的副本相对于另一个核心正在写入的副本已经过时了）。如果另一个 L1 缓存以 M 状态存放该块，它会把它的块写回较低的级别，并把它的副本设为 I。然后，执行写操作的核心把该块的新值加载到它的 L1 缓存中，置位 M 标志（它的副本将被这次写操作修改），清除 I 标志（它的副本现在有效），并写入缓存的块。 If the block is in the I or the S state, notify other cores that the block is being written to (modified). Other L1 caches that have the block stored in the S state, need to clear the S bit and set the I bit on their block (their copies of the block are now out of date with the copy that is being written to by the other core). If another L1 cache has the block in the M state, it will write its block back to the lower level, and set its copy to I. The core writing will then load the new value of the block into its L1 cache, set the M flag (its copy will be modified by the write), and clear the I flags (its copy is now valid), and write to the cached block. 图 2 到 图 4 逐步演示了一个例子：一个内存块缓存在两个核心各自私有的 L1 缓存中，MSI 协议如何确保对它的读写访问保持一致。在 图 2 中，例子一开始，共享的数据块被复制到两个核心的 L1 缓存中，并且 S 标志都已置位，这意味着 L1 中缓存的副本与 L2 缓存中该块的值相同（所有副本都存放着该块的当前值 6）。此时，核心 0 和核心 1 都可以安全地读取各自 L1 缓存中的副本，而不会触发一致性动作（S 标志表明它们的共享副本是最新的）。 Figure 2 through Figure 4 step through an example of the MSI protocol applied to ensure coherency of read and write accesses to a block of memory that is cached in two core’s private L1 caches. In Figure 2 our example starts with the shared data block copied into both core’s L1 cache with the S flag set, meaning that the L1 cached copies are the same as the value of the block in the L2 cache (all copies store the current value of the block, 6). At this point, both core 0 and core 1 can safely read from the copy stored in their L1 caches without triggering coherency actions (the S flag indicates that their shared copy is up to date). 图 2. 开始时，两个核心的私有 L1 缓存中都有该块的副本，并且 S 标志置位（处于共享状态） Figure 2. At the start, both cores have a copy of the block in their private L1 caches with the S flag set (in Shared mode) 如果核心 0 接下来写入它 L1 缓存中存放的该块副本，它的 L1 缓存控制器会通知其他 L1 缓存使它们的该块副本失效。于是核心 1 的 L1 缓存控制器清除它的副本的 S 标志并置位 I 标志，表示它的块副本已经过时。核心 0 写入它 L1 缓存中的块副本（在我们的例子中把值改为 7），并在该缓存行上置位 M 标志、清除 S 标志，表示它的副本已被修改，存放的是该块的当前值。此时，L2 缓存中和核心 1 的 L1 缓存中的副本都已过时。得到的缓存状态如 图 3 所示。 If core 0 next writes to the copy of the block stored in its L1 cache, its L1 cache controller notifies the other L1 caches to invalidate their copy of the block. Core 1’s L1 cache controller then clears the S flag and sets the I flag on its copy, indicating that its copy of the block is stale. Core 0 writes to its copy of the block in its L1 cache (changing its value to 7 in our example), and sets the M flag and clears the S flag on the cache line to indicate that its copy has been modified and stores the current value of the block. At this point, the copy in the L2 cache and in core 1’s L1 cache are stale. The resulting cache state is shown in Figure 3 . 图 3. 核心 0 写入它的块副本之后各缓存的状态 Figure 3. The resulting state of the caches after Core 0 writes to its copy of the block 此时，核心 0 可以安全地读取它缓存的块副本，因为它的副本处于 M 状态，即存放着该块最近写入的值。 At this point, core 0 can safely read from its copy of the cached block because its copy is in the M state, meaning that it stores the most recently written value of the block. 如果核心 1 接下来读取这个内存块，它 L1 中缓存副本上的 I 标志表明它的 L1 块副本已经过时，不能用来满足读请求。核心 1 的 L1 缓存控制器必须先把该块的新值加载到 L1 缓存中，才能满足读请求。为此，核心 0 的 L1 缓存控制器必须先把它修改过的块值写回 L2 缓存，以便核心 1 的 L1 缓存能把该块的新值读入它的 L1 缓存。这些动作的结果（如 图 4 所示）是，核心 0 和核心 1 的 L1 中缓存的块副本现在都处于 S 状态，表明每个核心的 L1 副本都是最新的，可以安全地用来满足之后对该块的读请求。 If core 1 next reads from the memory block, the I flag on its L1 cached copy indicates that its L1 copy of the block is stale and cannot be used to satisfy the read. Implementing Cache Coherency Protocols 为了实现缓存一致性协议，处理器需要某种机制来识别：对一个核心的 L1 缓存内容的访问，何时需要改变涉及其他核心 L1 缓存内容的一致性状态。实现这种机制的一种方法，是在所有 L1 缓存共享的一条总线上进行 监听 （snooping）。监听式缓存控制器在总线上监听（或窥探）对它所缓存的块的读或写。由于每个读写请求都是以内存地址的形式发出的，监听式 L1 缓存控制器能识别出另一个 L1 缓存对它所存块的任何读写，然后根据一致性协议作出相应的响应。例如，当它监听到另一个 L1 缓存对同一地址的写操作时，可以在对应的缓存行上置位 I 标志。这个例子就是用监听实现 写失效协议 （write-invalidate protocol）的方式。 To implement a cache coherency protocol, a processor needs some mechanism to identify when accesses to one core’s L1 cache contents require coherency state changes involving the other cores’ L1 cache contents. One way this mechanism is implemented is through snooping on a bus that is shared by all L1 caches. A snooping cache controller listens (or snoops) on the bus for reads or writes to blocks that it caches. Because every read and write request is in terms of a memory address, a snooping L1 cache controller can identify any read or write from another L1 cache for a block it stores, and can then respond appropriately based on the coherency protocol. For example, it can set the I flag on a cache line when it snoops a write to the same address by another L1 cache. This example is how a write-invalidate protocol would be implemented with snooping. MSI 以及 MESI、MOESI 等其他类似的协议都是写失效协议，即在写操作时使缓存项的其他副本失效的协议。监听也可以用于写更新（write-update）的缓存一致性协议：从总线上监听到数据的新值，并用它更新其他 L1 缓存中存放的所有副本。 MSI and other similar protocols such as MESI and MOESI are write-invalidate protocols; that is, protocols that invalidate copies of cached entries on writes. Snooping can also be used by write-update cache coherency protocols, where the new value of a data is snooped from the bus and applied to update all copies stored in other L1 caches. 除了监听之外，还可以用基于目录（directory-based）的缓存一致性机制来触发缓存一致性协议。由于多个核心共享一条总线会带来性能限制，这种方法比监听的可扩展性更好。不过，基于目录的机制需要更多的状态来检测内存块何时被共享，而且比监听慢。 Instead of snooping, a directory-based cache coherence mechanism can be used to trigger cache coherency protocols. This method scales better than snooping due to performance limitations of multiple cores sharing a single bus. However, directory-based mechanisms require more state to detect when memory blocks are shared, and are slower than snooping. 11.6

Code Optimization 代码优化 （code optimization）是在不改变程序固有功能的前提下，通过减小代码规模、降低复杂度、减少内存使用或缩短运行时间（或它们的某种组合）来改进程序的过程。许多编译系统都把代码优化器作为中间步骤。具体来说， 优化编译器 （optimizing compiler）在编译过程中应用改进代码的变换。几乎所有现代编译器（包括 GCC）都是优化编译器。GCC 的 C 编译器实现了各种各样的 优化选项 （optimization flag），让程序员可以直接使用其中一部分已实现的优化。编译器优化选项以增加编译时间和降低调试便利性为代价来优化代码。为简单起见，GCC 把这些优化选项中的一部分打包成不同的 优化级别 （optimization level），程序员可以直接调用。例如，下面的命令以 1 级优化编译一个示例程序： Code optimization is the process by which a program is improved by reducing its code size, complexity, memory use, or runtime (or some combination thereof) without changing the program’s inherent function. Many compilation systems include a code optimizer as an intermediate step. Specifically, an optimizing compiler applies code-improving transformations as part of the compilation process. Virtually all modern compilers (including GCC) are optimizing compilers. The GCC C compiler implements a wide variety of optimization flags that give programmers direct access to a subset of the implemented optimizations. Compiler optimization flags optimize code at the expense of compile time and ease of debugging. For simplicity, GCC wraps up a subset of these optimization flags into different optimization levels that the programmer can directly invoke. For example, the following command compiles a sample program with level 1 optimizations: $ gcc -O1 -o program program.c GCC 的 1 级优化（ -O1 或 -O ）执行基本的优化，以减小代码规模和执行时间，同时尽量把编译时间控制在最低。2 级优化（ -O2 ）包括 GCC 已实现的、不涉及空间与性能权衡的大部分优化。最后，3 级优化（ -O3 ）执行额外的优化（例如本章后面讨论的函数内联），可能会使程序的编译时间显著变长。 GCC 文档 详细描述了已实现的各种优化选项。 The level 1 ( -O1 or -O ) optimizations in GCC perform basic optimizations to reduce code size and execution time while attempting to keep compile time to a minimum. Level 2 ( -O2 ) optimizations include most of GCC’s implemented optimizations that do not involve a space-performance trade-off. Lastly, level 3 ( -O3 ) performs additional optimizations (such as function inlining, discussed later in this chapter), and may cause the program to take significantly longer to compile. The GCC documentation describes the implemented optimization flags in detail. 现代更新（截至 2026-11）· 现在的 GCC 优化级别 原文说函数内联属于 -O3 的「额外优化」。按当前的 GCC 手册， -O2 已经开启了 -finline-functions 和 -finline-small-functions 等内联相关选项；手册对 -O2 的描述是「执行几乎所有不涉及空间与速度权衡的已支持优化」。调试时，手册建议在不使用其他优化选项时用 -Og 配合 -g ：不加任何 -O 时，一些收集调试有用信息的编译遍根本不会运行，因此 -Og 可能带来更好的调试体验。 GCC 手册：Optimize Options ； GCC 手册：Debugging Options 关于优化编译器及其构造和工作原理的详细讨论超出了本教材的范围；我们鼓励感兴趣的读者阅读 Aho、Sethi 和 Ulman 的经典著作 Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools 。本章的目的在于指出大多数编译器能做（和不能做）的一些事情，以及程序员如何与编译器和剖析工具配合来改进代码。 A detailed discussion of optimizing compilers and their construction and operation is beyond the scope of this textbook; we encourage interested readers to check out the seminal text, Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools , by Aho, Sethi, and Ulman. Lam。 编译器已经在做的事 What Compilers Already Do 接下来的几个小节简要介绍几乎每个编译器都会执行的几种常见优化。学生 绝不 应该手动实现这些优化，因为编译器已经实现了它们。 Several of the common optimizations performed by virtually every compiler are described briefly in the upcoming sections. Students should never manually implement these optimizations, because they are already implemented by the compiler. 常量折叠 （constant folding） 代码中的常量在编译时求值，以减少生成的指令数。例如，在下面的代码片段中， 宏展开 （macro expansion）把语句 int debug = N-5 替换为 int debug = 5-5 ，然后 常量折叠 把这条语句更新为 int debug = 0 。 Constant Folding Constants in the code are evaluated at compile time to reduce the number of resulting instructions. For example, in the code snippet that follows, macro expansion replaces the statement int debug = N-5 with int debug = 5-5 . Constant folding then updates this statement to int debug = 0 . #define N 5 int debug = N - 5; //constant folding changes this statement to debug = 0; 常量传播 （constant propagation） 如果在编译时就知道某个变量的值是常量， 常量传播 就用这个常量值替换该变量。考虑下面的代码段： Constant Propagation Constant propagation replaces variables with a constant value if such a value is known at compile time. Consider the following code segment: int debug = 0; //sums up all the elements in an array int doubleSum(int *array, int length){ int i, total = 0; for (i = 0; i < length; i++){ total += array[i]; if (debug) { printf("array[%d] is: %d
", i, array[i]); } } return 2 * total; } 采用常量传播的编译器会把 if (debug) 改为 if (0) 。 A compiler employing constant propagation will change if (debug) to if (0) . 译注 · 这个例子其实不成立 debug 是一个普通的（外部链接、非 const ）全局变量，其他源文件可以声明 extern int debug; 并在调用 doubleSum 之前修改它，所以编译器 不能 假定它在函数里一定是 0。译者用 clang -O2 -target x86_64-linux-gnu -S 编译原文的 doubleSum ，生成的汇编里仍保留了对 printf 的调用；把声明改成 static int debug = 0; （本文件内从未修改）之后， printf 调用才被完全删掉。要让编译器做这种优化，变量应声明为 static 、 const ，或者干脆用宏。 死代码消除 （dead code elimination） 程序中散落着用不到的变量、赋值或语句并不罕见。尽管这些多余的语句很少是有意引入的，但它们往往是软件开发周期中不断迭代和完善的自然副产品。如果不加检测，这些所谓的 死代码 （dead code）序列会让编译器输出不必要的汇编指令，进而浪费处理时间。大多数编译器使用数据流分析等技术来识别不可达的代码段并将其删除。 死代码消除 通过减小代码规模及相应的指令集合，常常能让程序更快。举个例子，我们再来看 doubleSum 函数，编译器已用常量传播把 if 语句中的 debug 替换成了 0 ： Dead Code Elimination It is not uncommon for a program to be littered with unused variables, assignments, or statements. Even though these unneeded statements are rarely introduced intentionally, they are often a natural by-product of the constant iteration and refinement of the software development cycle. If left undetected, these so-called dead code sequences can cause compilers to output unnecessary assembly instructions that in turn waste processing time. Most compilers employ techniques such as dataflow analysis to identify unreachable code segments and thereby remove them. Dead code elimination often makes a program faster by shrinking code size and the associated set of instructions. As an example, let’s revisit the doubleSum function in which the compiler employed constant propagation to replace debug with 0 in the if statement: int debug = 0; //sums up all the elements in an array int doubleSum(int *array, int length){ int i, total = 0; for (i = 0; i < length; i++){ total += array[i]; if (0) { //debug replaced by constant propagation by compiler printf("array[%d] is: %d
", i, array[i]); } } return 2 * total; } 采用数据流分析的编译器能认识到 if 语句总是求值为假， printf 语句永远不会执行。因此，编译器会在编译出的可执行文件中删除这个 if 语句和对 printf 的调用。另一遍处理还会删除语句 debug = 0 。 A compiler employing dataflow analysis recognizes that the if statement always evaluates to false and that the printf statement never executes. The compiler therefore eliminates the if statement and the call to printf in the compiled executable. Another pass also eliminates the statement debug = 0 . 简化表达式 有些指令比其他指令代价更高。例如，汇编中的 imul 和 idiv 算术指令需要很长时间才能执行完。编译器通常会尽可能简化数学运算，以减少代价高的指令的数量。例如，在 doubleSum 函数中，编译器可能会把表达式 2 * total 替换为 total + total ，因为加法指令比乘法代价低： Simplifying expressions Some instructions are more expensive than others. For example, the imul and idiv arithmetic instructions in assembly take a long time to execute. Compilers commonly attempt to reduce the number of expensive instructions by simplifying mathematical operations whenever possible. For example, in the doubleSum function, the compiler may replace the expression 2 * total with total + total because the addition instruction is less expensive than multiplication: //declaration of debug removed through dead-code elimination //sums up all the elements in an array int doubleSum(int *array, int length){ int i, total = 0; for (i = 0; i < length; i++){ total += array[i]; //if statement removed through data-flow analysis } return total + total; //simplifying expression } 同样，编译器会用移位和其他位运算符来变换代码序列，以简化表达式。例如，编译器可能会把表达式 total * 8 替换为 total << 3 ，或把表达式 total % 8 替换为 total & 7 ，因为位运算只需一条很快的指令就能完成。 Likewise, the compiler will transform code sequences with bit-shifting and other bitwise operators to simplify expressions. For example, the compiler may replace the expression total * 8 with total << 3 , or the expression total % 8 with total & 7 given that bitwise operations are performed with a single fast instruction. 译注 对 int 这样可能为负的有符号数， total % 8 不能直接换成 total & 7 ：C 中 -1 % 8 等于 -1，而 -1 & 7 等于 7。编译器只会在能证明 total 非负，或者类型是无符号数时才做这种替换，否则要加修正指令（同理见 9.3 节关于有符号除法的译注）。 编译器并不总能做到的事：学习代码优化的好处 What Compilers Cannot Always Do: Benefits of Learning Code Optimization 既然优化编译器有这么多好处，学习代码优化有什么用，可能并不是一眼就能看清的。人们很容易把编译器想象成一个「聪明」的神奇黑盒。但归根结底，编译器只是一个为了加速代码而执行一系列代码变换的软件。编译器能执行的优化类型也是有限的。 Given the benefits of optimizing compilers, it may not be immediately obvious why learning code optimization is useful. It may be tempting to think of the compiler as a magical black box that is “smart.” At the end of the day, the compiler is a piece of software that performs a series of code transformations in an effort to speed up code. Compilers are also limited in the types of optimizations they can perform. 算法上的强度削弱是不可能的 代码性能差的首要原因是选错了数据结构和算法。编译器无法神奇地修正这些错误的决定。例如，编译器永远不会把实现冒泡排序的程序优化成实现快速排序的程序。尽管编译器及其优化的复杂程度在不断提高，但任何一个编译器的优化 质量 在不同平台上都有差异。因此，确保代码使用最佳算法和数据结构的责任在于程序员。 Algorithmic Strength Reduction Is Impossible The top reason for poor code performance is bad choices of data structures and algorithms. Compilers cannot magically fix these bad decisions. For example, a compiler will never optimize a program implementing bubble sort into one that implements quick sort. While the sophistication of compilers and their optimizations continues to improve, the quality of any individual compiler’s optimizations varies between platforms. The onus is therefore on the programmer to ensure that their code leverages the best algorithms and data structures. 编译器优化选项不能保证让代码「最优」（或行为一致） 提高编译器的优化级别（例如从 -O2 提高到 -O3 ）并不总能缩短程序的运行时间。有时，程序员可能会发现把优化选项从 -O2 提高到 -O3 反而 拖慢 了程序，或者根本没有提升性能。在另一些情况下，程序员可能会发现，不加优化选项编译的程序看似没有错误，而用 -O2 或 -O3 编译却出现段错误或其他错误。这类编程错误特别难以调试，因为 GCC 的调试选项（ -g ）与优化选项（ -O ）不兼容： -O 级别的编译器优化所做的变换，会干扰调试器分析底层代码的能力。许多常用的剖析工具（例如 GDB 和 Valgrind）都需要 -g 选项。 Compiler Optimization Flags Are Not Guaranteed to Make Code “Optimal” (or Consistent) Increasing the level of compiler optimizations (e.g., from -O2 to -O3 ) may not always decrease the runtime of a program. Sometimes, the programmer may discover that updating the optimization flags from -O2 to -O3 slows down a program, or yields no performance increase at all. In other cases, a programmer may discover that a program compiled without the optimization flags seemingly yields no errors, whereas compiling it with -O2 or -O3 results in segmentation faults or other errors. These types of programming errors are especially difficult to debug, because GCC’s debug ( -g ) flag is incompatible with its optimization ( -O ) flags, as the transformations performed by compiler optimizations at the -O levels interfere with the debugger’s ability to analyze the underlying code. The -g flag is required by many common profiling tools, such as GDB and Valgrind. 译注 · -g 与 -O 可以同时使用 说两者「不兼容」并不准确。GCC 手册明确写道：「GCC 允许你把 -g 和 -O 一起使用」，只是优化后的代码可能出人意料：有些声明的变量可能根本不存在，控制流可能短暂地跑到意想不到的地方，等等。手册还建议，如果不使用其他优化选项，可以把 -Og 与 -g 一起使用，以获得更好的调试体验。 GCC 手册：Debugging Options 行为不一致的一个重要原因是，C/C++ 标准没有为如何处理未定义行为提供明确的指导。因此，如何解决这种模糊性往往由编译器决定。不同优化级别对未定义行为的处理方式不一致，可能导致结果 发生变化 。考虑下面这个来自 John Regehr 1 的例子： One large reason for inconsistent behavior is that the C/C++ standard does not provide clear guidance for resolving undefined behavior. As a result, it is often up to the compiler to decide how to resolve ambiguity. Inconsistencies on how different optimization levels handle undefined behavior can cause answers to change . In this case, the computation a 1 results in integer overflow. However, the C/C++ standard does not define how integer overflow should be handled by the compiler. If a transformation risks changing the behavior of the program, the compiler will not make the transformation. This is especially true in the case of memory aliasing where two different pointers point to the same address in memory. As an example, consider the following function shiftAdd that takes two integer pointers as its two parameters. The function multiplies the first number by 10 and adds the second number to it. Code Optimization First Steps: Code Profiling 「真正的问题在于，程序员在错误的地方、错误的时间，为效率操心得太多了；过早优化是编程中一切罪恶（至少是大部分罪恶）的根源。」 ——高德纳（Don Knuth），《 计算机程序设计艺术 》（ The Art of Computer Programming ） “The real problem is that programmers have spent far too much time worrying about efficiency in the wrong places and at the wrong times; premature optimization is the root of all evil (or at least most of it) in programming.” - Don Knuth, The Art of Computer Programming 代码优化中最大的危险之一，是 过早优化 （premature optimization）的观念。所谓过早优化，是指程序员凭着对性能低效之处的「直觉」而不是数据来进行优化。只要有可能，在着手优化 之前 ，就应当在不同的输入上测量代码不同部分的运行时间，以找出 热点 （hot spot），即程序中执行指令最多的区域。 One of the biggest dangers in code optimization is the concept of premature optimization . Premature optimization occurs when a programmer attempts to optimize based on “gut feelings” of where performance inefficiencies occur, and not on data. Whenever possible, it is important to measure the runtime of different portions of code on different inputs prior to starting optimization to identify hot spots or areas in the program in which the most instructions occur. 为了弄清如何优化 optExample.c ，我们先仔细看看 main 函数： To figure out how to optimize optExample.c , let’s start by taking a closer look at the main function: int main(int argc, char **argv) { // error-handling and timing code omitted for brevity int limit = strtol(argv[1], NULL, 10); int length = limit; int *array = allocateArray(length); //allocates array of specified length genPrimeSequence(array, limit, &length); //generates sequence of primes return 0; } main 函数包含对两个函数的调用： allocateArray 初始化一个由用户指定长度（即上限）的数组； genPrimeSequence 生成指定上限内的素数序列（注意，对于 2 到 n 之间的任何序列，素数不可能超过 n 个，而且通常要少得多）。 该 C 文件 中的 main 函数包含为上述两个函数分别计时的代码。在 limit 设为 5,000,000 时编译并运行这段代码，得到下面的结果： The main function contains calls to two functions: allocateArray , which initializes an array of a user-specified length (or limit), and genPrimeSequence , which generates a sequence of primes within the specified limit (note that for any sequence between 2 and n , there cannot be more than n primes, and frequently there are significantly less). The main function in the C file contains code that times each of the two functions above. Compiling and running the code with limit set to 5,000,000 reveals the following: $ gcc -o optExample optExample.c -lm $ time -p ./optExample 5000000 Time to allocate: 5.5e-05 Time to generate primes: 3.85525 348513 primes found. real 3.85 user 3.86 sys 0.00 optExample 程序大约需要 3.86 秒才能完成，几乎所有时间都花在 genPrimeSequence 函数上。花时间去优化 allocateArray 没有意义，因为任何改进对整个程序的运行时间来说都微不足道。在接下来的例子中，我们更仔细地关注 genPrimeSequence 函数及其相关的函数。为方便起见，这里再把这些函数列出来： The optExample program takes approximately 3.86 seconds to complete, with nearly all of the time in the genPrimeSequence function. There is no point in spending time optimizing allocateArray , because any improvements will be negligible to the runtime of the overall program. In the examples that follow, we focus more closely on the genPrimeSequence function and its associated functions. The functions are reproduced here for convenience: // helper function: checks to see if a number is prime int isPrime(int x) { int i; for (i = 2; i < sqrt(x) + 1; i++) { //no prime number is less than 2 if (x % i == 0) { //if the number is divisible by i return 0; //it is not prime } } return 1; //otherwise it is prime } // finds the next prime int getNextPrime(int prev) { int next = prev + 1; while (!isPrime(next)) { //while the number is not prime next++; //increment and check again } return next; } // generates a sequence of primes int genPrimeSequence(int *array, int limit) { int i; int len = limit; if (len == 0) return 0; array[0] = 2; //initialize the first number to 2 for (i = 1; i < len; i++) { array[i] = getNextPrime(array[i-1]); //fill in the array if (array[i] > limit) { len = i; return len; } } return len; } 要找出程序中的热点，应关注循环最多的区域。人工检查代码有助于定位热点，不过在尝试优化之前，总应该用基准测试工具加以验证。人工检查 optExample 程序，可以得出以下观察结果。 To find hot spots in a program, focus on the areas with the most loops. Manual inspection of code can assist in locating hot spots, though it should always be verified with benchmarking tools prior to attempting optimization. A manual inspection of the optExample program yields the following observations. genPrimeSequence 函数试图生成 2 到某个整数 n 之间的所有素数。由于 2 到 n 之间的素数个数不会超过 n ， genPrimeSequence 中的 for 循环最多运行 n 次。 for 循环的每次迭代都调用一次 getNextPrime 函数。因此， getNextPrime 最多运行 n 次。 The genPrimeSequence function attempts to generate all the prime numbers between 2 and some integer n . Since the number of primes between 2 and n cannot exceed n , the for loop in genPrimeSequence runs no more than n times. Every iteration of the for loop calls the getNextPrime function once. Thus, getNextPrime runs no more than n times. getNextPrime 函数中的 while 循环会一直运行，直到发现一个素数为止。尽管很难预先把 getNextPrime 函数中 while 循环的执行次数表示为 n 的函数（相邻素数之间的间隔可以任意大），但可以肯定的是， while 循环的每次迭代都会执行 isPrime 。 The while loop in the getNextPrime function will continue running until a prime is discovered. Suppose that the loop runs for a total of k iterations. Then, the code in the loop body runs k times in total. Recall that the structure of a for loop consists of an initialization statement (which initializes the loop variable to a particular value), a Boolean expression (that determines when to terminate the loop), and a step expression (that updates the loop variable every iteration). Table 1 depicts the number of times each loop component executes in a for loop that runs for k iterations. In every for loop, initialization happens exactly once. The Boolean expression executes k + 1 times for k iterations, since it must perform one final check to terminate the loop. Loop-Invariant Code Motion 循环不变量外提（loop-invariant code motion）是一种优化技术，它把循环内部发生的静态计算移到循环外部，而不影响循环的行为。优化编译器能够自动完成大多数循环不变量优化。具体来说，GCC 中的 -fmove-loop-invariants 编译选项（在 -O1 级别启用）会尝试识别可以外提的循环不变量代码，并把它们移到各自的循环之外。 Loop-invariant code motion is an optimization technique that moves static computations that occur inside a loop to outside the loop without affecting the loop’s behavior. Optimizing compilers are capable of making most loop-invariant code optimizations automatically. Specifically, the -fmove-loop-invariants compiler flag in GCC (enabled at level -O1 ) attempts to identify examples of loop-invariant code motion and move them outside their respective loop. 然而，编译器并不总能识别出循环不变量外提的机会，尤其是在涉及函数调用的情况下。由于函数调用可能无意中引起 副作用 （side effect，即非预期的行为），大多数编译器会避免去判断一个函数调用是否总是返回相同的结果。因此，尽管程序员知道 sqrt(x) 总是返回某个输入 x 的平方根，GCC 并不总会做出这样的假设。考虑 sqrt 函数会更新一个秘密的全局变量 g 的情形。在这种情况下，在循环外面调用一次 sqrt （对 g 更新 一次 ），与在循环的每次迭代中都调用它（对 g 更新 n 次）是不一样的。如果编译器无法确定一个函数总是返回相同的结果，它就不会自动把 sqrt 函数移到循环之外。 However, the compiler cannot always identify cases of loop-invariant code motion, especially in the case of function calls. Since function calls can inadvertently cause side effects (unintended behavior), most compilers will avoid trying to determine whether a function call consistently returns the same result. Thus, even though the programmer knows that sqrt(x) always returns the square root of some input x , GCC will not always make that assumption. Consider the case where the sqrt function updates a secret global variable, g . In that case, calling sqrt once outside of the function ( one update to g ) is not the same as calling it every iteration of the loop ( n updates to g ). If a compiler cannot determine that a function always returns the same result, it will not automatically move the sqrt function outside the loop. 然而，程序员知道，把计算 sqrt(x) + 1 移到 for 循环之外不会影响循环的行为。更新后的函数如下，也可以在 这个文件 中获取： However, the programmer knows that moving the computation sqrt(x) + 1 outside the for loop does not effect the loop’s behavior. The updated function is shown here and is available in the following file : //helper function: checks to see if a number is prime int isPrime(int x) { int i; int max = sqrt(x)+1; for (i = 2; i < max; i++) { //no prime number is less than 2 if (x % i == 0) { //if the number is divisible by i return 0; //it is not prime } } return 1; //otherwise it is prime } 表 2 显示，即使还没有使用编译选项，这个简单的改动就让 optExample2 的运行时间减少了整整两秒（47%）。此外，编译器优化 optExample2 似乎也稍微容易一些。 Table 2 shows that this simple change shaves off a full two seconds (47%) of the runtime of optExample2 , even before using compiler flags. This number corresponds to the number of times the isPrime function is called, confirming that the sqrt function executes only once with every invocation of the isPrime function. 注意，在指定了优化选项时，即使程序员没有手动外提代码，编译器也能进行相当程度的优化。在这个例子中，原因是 x86 ISA 规定了一条名为 fsqrt 的特殊指令。打开优化选项时，编译器会用 fsqrt 指令替换所有 sqrt 函数的实例。这个过程称为 内联 （inlining），我们会在下一节中更详细地介绍它。由于 fsqrt 不再是一个函数，编译器更容易识别出它的循环不变性质，并把它移到循环体之外。 Note that the compiler was able to perform significant levels of optimization when optimization flags were specified, even if the programmer does not manually perform code motion. In this case, the reason is due to a special instruction called fsqrt that is specified by the x86 ISA. When optimization flags are turned on, the compiler replaces all instances of the sqrt function with the fsqrt instruction. This process is known as inlining , and we cover it greater detail in the following section. Memory Considerations 程序员应当特别注意内存的使用，尤其是在使用矩阵和数组这类占用大量内存的数据结构时。尽管编译器提供了强大的优化功能，但编译器并不总能做出改善程序内存使用的优化。在本节中，我们用一个矩阵-向量程序的实现（ matrixVector.c ）来引导对改善内存使用的技术和工具的讨论。 Programmers should pay special attention to memory use, especially when employing memory-intensive data structures such as matrices and arrays. Although compilers offer powerful optimization features, the compiler cannot always make optimizations that improve a program’s memory use. In this section, we use an implementation of a matrix-vector program ( matrixVector.c ) to guide discussion of techniques and tools for improving memory use. 这个程序的 main 函数执行两个步骤。首先，它分配并初始化输入矩阵、输入向量和输出矩阵。然后，它执行矩阵-向量乘法。在 10,000 × 10,000 的矩阵-向量规模上运行代码，可以看到 matrixVectorMultiply 函数占用了大部分时间： The main function of the program performs two steps. First, it allocates and initializes the input matrix, the input vector, and the output matrix. Next, it performs matrix-vector multiplication. Running the code on matrix-vector dimensions of 10,000 × 10,000 reveals that the matrixVectorMultiply function takes up the majority of the time: $ gcc -o matrixVector matrixVector.c $ ./matrixVector 10000 10000 Time to allocate and fill matrices: 1.2827 Time to allocate vector: 9.6e-05 Time to matrix-vector multiply: 1.98402 因此，我们的讨论将集中在 matrixVectorMultiply 函数上。 Our discussion will thus focus on the matrixVectorMultiply function. 12.3.1. 循环交换 12.3.1. Loop Interchange 循环交换（loop interchange）优化交换嵌套循环中内外层循环的顺序，以最大化缓存局部性。编译器很难自动完成这项任务。GCC 中虽然有 -floop-interchange 编译选项，但目前默认不开启。因此，程序员最好留意自己的代码是如何访问数组和矩阵这类复合内存数据结构的。举个例子，我们来仔细看看 matrixVector.c 中的 matrixVectorMultiply 函数： Loop interchange optimizations switch the order of inner and outer loops in nested loops in order to maximize cache locality. Automatically performing this task is difficult for compilers to do. In GCC, the -floop-interchange compiler flag exists but is currently not available by default. Therefore, it is a good idea for programmers to pay attention to how their code is accessing memory-composite data structures like arrays and matrices. As an example, let’s take a closer look at the matrixVectorMultiply function in matrixVector.c : 现代更新（截至 2026-11）· GCC 的循环交换 按当前的 GCC 手册， -O3 会开启 -floop-interchange （手册的描述是：在 graphite 框架之外执行循环交换，可以改善循环嵌套的缓存性能，并让向量化等进一步的循环优化得以进行）， -O3 同时还开启 -floop-unroll-and-jam 、 -ftree-loop-distribution （即本节后面讲的循环分裂）等相关的循环变换。不过，表 2 的数据说明，对本节这种由指针数组构成的「数组的数组」矩阵，编译器并没有替你把循环换过来，手动调整循环顺序依然必要。 GCC 手册：Optimize Options 表 1. 对 matrixVectorMultiply() 函数进行循环交换 Table 1. Loop interchange on the matrixVectorMultiply() function. 原始版本（matrixVector.c） Original Version (matrixVector.c) void matrixVectorMultiply(int **m, int *v, int **res, int row, int col) { int i, j; //cycles through every matrix column //in inner-most loop (inefficient) for (j = 0; j < col; j++){ for (i = 0; i < row; i++){ res[i][j] = m[i][j] * v[j]; } } } 循环交换版本（matrixVector2.c） Loop interchange version (matrixVector2.c) void matrixVectorMultiply(int **m, int *v, int **res, int row, int col) { int i, j; //cycles through every row of matrix //in inner-most loop for (i = 0; i < row; i++){ for (j = 0; j < col; j++){ res[i][j] = m[i][j] * v[j]; } } } 输入矩阵和输出矩阵是动态分配的（C 语言章节讨论的第二种方法）。因此，矩阵的各行彼此不连续，而每一行中的元素是连续的。当前的循环顺序使程序逐列而不是逐行地遍历矩阵。回想一下， 数据是以 块 而不是元素为单位加载到缓存中的 。因此，当访问 res 或 m 中某个数组的元素 x 时， 与 x 相邻的元素 也会被加载到缓存中。逐「列」遍历矩阵会导致更多的缓存未命中，因为每次访问都迫使缓存加载新的块。 表 2 显示，加上优化选项并没有缩短这个函数的运行时间。然而，只要交换一下循环的顺序（如前面的代码示例以及 matrixVector2.c 所示），函数就能快将近八倍，并让编译器能够进行更多的优化。 The input and output matrices are dynamically allocated (second method discussed in C chapter). As a result, the rows in the matrices are not contiguous to one another, whereas the elements in every row are contiguous. The current ordering of the loops causes the program to cycle through each column instead of every row. Recall that data is loaded into cache in blocks not elements. As a result, when an element x in an array in either res or m is accessed, the elements adjacent to x are also loaded into cache. Cycling through every “column” of the matrix causes more cache misses, as the cache is forced to load new blocks with every access. Table 2 shows that adding optimization flags does not decrease the runtime of the function. However, simply switching the order of the loops (as shown in the previous code examples and in matrixVector2.c ) makes the function nearly eight times faster and allows the compiler to perform additional optimizations. 表 2. 在 10,000 × 10,000 个元素上执行矩阵乘法所用的时间（秒） Table 2. Some Other Compiler Optimizations for Improving Locality: Fission and Fusion 在 10,000 × 10,000 个元素上重新运行改进后的程序，得到下面的运行时间： Rerunning the improved program on 10,000 × 10,000 elements yields the following runtime numbers: $ gcc -o matrixVector2 matrixVector2.c $ ./matrixVector2 10000 10000 Time to allocate and fill matrices: 1.29203 Time to allocate vector: 0.000107 Time to matrix-vector multiply: 0.271369 现在，分配和填充矩阵所花的时间最多。进一步的计时表明，实际上最耗时的是填充矩阵。我们来仔细看看那段代码： Now, matrix allocation and filling takes the most time. Additional timing reveals that it is the filling of the matrices that in fact takes the most time. Let’s take a closer look at that code: //fill matrices for (i = 0; i < rows; i++){ fillArrayRandom(matrix[i], cols); fillArrayZeros(result[i], cols); } 为了填充输入矩阵和输出矩阵，一个 for 循环遍历所有行，并对每个矩阵调用 fillArrayRandom 和 fillArrayZeros 函数。在某些情况下，编译器把单个循环拆成两个独立的循环可能会更有利（称为 循环分裂 ，loop fission），如 表 3 所示。 To fill the input and output matrices, a for loop cycles through all the rows, and calls the fillArrayRandom and fillArrayZeros functions on each matrix. In some scenarios, it may be advantageous for the compiler to split the single loop into two separate loops (known as loop fission ), as shown in Table 3 . 表 3. 对 main 中填充矩阵的 for 循环进行循环分裂的示例 Table 3. Loop fission example on fill matrices for loop in main . 原始版本 Original Version for (i = 0; i < rows; i++) { fillArrayRandom(matrix[i], cols); fillArrayZeros(result[i], cols); } 循环分裂后 With loop fission for (i = 0; i < rows; i++) { fillArrayRandom(matrix[i], cols); } for (i = 0; i < rows; i++) { fillArrayZeros(result[i], cols); } 把在同一范围上运行的两个循环的内容合并到一个循环中（即循环分裂的逆过程），称为 循环融合 （loop fusion）。循环分裂和循环融合都是编译器为改善数据局部性而可能执行的优化。面向多核处理器的编译器也可能利用循环分裂或融合，让循环能在多个核心上高效执行。例如，编译器可能用循环分裂把两个循环分配给不同的核心。同样，编译器可能用循环融合把相互依赖的操作合并到循环体中，再把循环迭代的一个子集分配给每个核心（假设各次迭代之间的数据是独立的）。 The process of taking two loops that operate over the same range and combining their contents into a single loop (i.e., the opposite of loop fission) is called loop fusion . Loop fission and fusion are examples of optimizations a compiler might perform to try to improve data locality. Compilers for multicore processors may also use loop fission or fusion to enable loops to execute efficiently on multiple cores. For example, a compiler may use loop fission to assign two loops to different cores. Likewise, a compiler may use loop fusion to combine together dependent operations into the body of the loop and distribute to each core a subset of the loop iterations (assuming data between iterations are independent). 在我们的例子中，手动应用循环分裂并不能直接提高程序性能；填充数组所需的时间几乎没有变化。不过，它可能会让一个更隐蔽的优化显现出来：包含 fillArrayZeros 的那个循环是不必要的。 matrixVectorMultiply 函数会给 result 数组中的每个元素赋值，事先把它们全部初始化为零是多余的。 In our case, applying loop fission manually does not directly improve program performance; there is virtually no change in the amount of time required to fill the array. However, it may make clear a more subtle optimization: the loop containing fillArrayZeros is not necessary. The matrixVectorMultiply function assigns values to each element in the result array; a prior initialization to all zeros is unnecessary. 表 4. 去掉对 fillArrayZeros 的多余调用 Table 4. Memory Profiling with Massif 做了上面的改动之后，运行时间只略有下降。尽管它省去了把结果矩阵所有元素填充为零的步骤，但用随机数填充输入矩阵仍需要相当多的时间： Making the previous change results in only a slight decrease in runtime. Although it eliminates the step of filling in all elements in the result matrix with zeros, a significant amount of time is still required to fill the input matrix with random numbers: $ gcc -o matrixVector3 matrixVector3.c $ ./matrixVector3 10000 10000 Time to allocate matrices: 0.049073 Time to fill matrices: 0.946801 Time to allocate vector: 9.3e-05 Time to matrix-vector multiply: 0.359525 尽管各个数组在内存中并不连续存放，但每个数组都占 10,000 × sizeof(int) 字节，即 40,000 字节。由于总共分配了 20,000 个数组（初始矩阵和结果矩阵各 10,000 个），这相当于 8 亿字节，即大约 762 MB 的空间。用随机数填满 762 MB 的空间，花很多时间也就不难理解了。对于矩阵，内存使用量随输入规模呈平方增长，可能对性能产生很大影响。 Even though each array is stored noncontiguously in memory, each one takes up 10,000 × sizeof(int) bytes, or 40,000 bytes. Because there is a total of 20,000 (10,000 each for the initial matrix and the result matrix) arrays allocated, this corresponds to 800 million bytes, or roughly 762 MB of space. Filling 762 MB with random numbers understandably takes a lot of time. With matrices, memory use increases quadratically with the input size, and can play a large role in performance. Valgrind 的 massif 工具可以帮助你剖析内存使用情况。与本书介绍过的其他 Valgrind 工具（ memcheck 、 cachegrind 和 callgrind ）一样， massif 作为程序可执行文件的包装器运行。具体来说， massif 在程序运行过程中给程序的内存使用拍快照，剖析内存使用量如何波动。程序员可能会发现 massif 工具很适合用来跟踪程序如何使用堆内存，以及找出改善内存使用的机会。我们在 matrixVector3 可执行文件上运行 massif 工具： Valgrind’s massif tool can help you profile memory use. Like the other Valgrind tools we covered in this book ( memcheck , cachegrind , and callgrind ), massif runs as a wrapper around a program’s executable. Specifically, massif takes snapshots of program memory use throughout the program, and profiles how memory usage fluctuates. Programmers may find the massif tool useful for tracking how their programs use heap memory, and for identifying opportunities to improve memory use. Readers will likely find massif a useful tool for identifying areas of high heap memory use in their programs, which often slows a program down. For example, memory leaks can occur in programs when programmers frequently call malloc without calling free at the first correct opportunity. The massif tool is incredibly useful for detecting such leaks.

Other Compiler Optimizations: Loop Unrolling and Function Inlining 上一节介绍的循环不变量外提优化是一个简单的改动，却大幅缩短了执行时间。然而，这类优化取决于具体情况，并不总能提高性能。在大多数情况下，循环不变量外提由编译器负责完成。 The loop-invariant code motion optimization described in the previous section was a simple change that resulted in a massive reduction in execution time. However, such optimizations are situationally dependent, and may not always result in improvements to performance. In most cases, loop-invariant code motion is taken care of by the compiler. 如今，代码被阅读的次数比被编写的次数多。在大多数情况下，为了微小的性能提升而损害代码的可读性是不值得的。一般来说，程序员应当尽可能让编译器去做优化。在本节中，我们介绍一些以前由程序员手动实现、如今通常由编译器实现的优化技术。 Code today is more often read than it is written. In most cases, fractional performance gains are not worth the hit to code readability. In general, a programmer should let the compiler optimize whenever possible. In this section, we cover some optimization techniques that were previously manually implemented by programmers but are today commonly implemented by compilers. 网上有一些资料提倡手动实现我们在接下来几节中描述的技术。不过，我们鼓励读者在尝试于代码中手动实现这些优化之前，先检查自己的编译器是否支持它们。本节描述的所有优化 GCC 都已实现，但较老的编译器中可能没有。 There are several sources online that advocate for the manual implementation of the techniques we describe in the following sections. However, we encourage readers to check whether their compilers support the following optimizations before attempting to manually implement them in their code. All the optimizations described in this section are implemented in GCC, but may not be available in older compilers. 12.2.1. 函数内联 12.2.1. Function Inlining 编译器试图执行的一个优化步骤是 函数内联 （function inlining），即用函数体替换对函数的调用。例如，在 main 函数中，对 allocateArray 函数进行内联的编译器，会把对 allocateArray 的调用替换为对 malloc 的直接调用： One optimization step that compilers attempt to perform is function inlining , which replaces calls to a function with the body of the function. For example, in the main function, a compiler inlining the allocateArray function will replace the call to allocateArray with a direct call to malloc : 表 1. 编译器内联 allocateArray 函数的示例 Table 1. Example of compiler inlining the allocateArray function. 原始版本 Original Version int main(int argc, char **argv) { // omitted for brevity // some variables shortened for space considerations int lim = strtol(argv[1], NULL, 10); // allocation of array int *a = allocateArray(lim); // generates sequence of primes int len = genPrimeSequence(a, lim); return 0; } 内联了 allocateArray 的版本 Version with allocateArray in-lined int main(int argc, char **argv) { // omitted for brevity // some variables shortened for space considerations int lim = strtol(argv[1], NULL, 10); // allocation of array (in-lined) int *a = malloc(lim * sizeof(int)); // generates sequence of primes int len = genPrimeSequence(a, lim); return 0; } 内联函数可以为程序节省一些运行时间。回想一下，程序每次调用函数时，都必然会生成许多与函数的建立和销毁相关的指令。内联函数让编译器能消除这些多余的调用，并让编译器更容易发现其他可能的改进，包括常量传播、常量折叠和死代码消除。在 optExample 程序的例子中，内联很可能让编译器得以用 fsqrt 指令替换对 sqrt 的调用，进而把它移到循环之外。 Inlining functions can result in some runtime savings for a program. Recall that every time a program calls a function, many instructions associated with function creation and destruction are necessarily generated. Inlining functions enables the compiler to eliminate these excessive calls, and makes it easier for the compiler to identify other potential improvements, including constant propagation, constant folding, and dead code elimination. In the case of the optExample program, inlining likely allows the compiler to replace the call to sqrt with the fsqrt instruction, and subsequently move it outside the loop. -finline-functions 选项建议 GCC 对函数进行内联。这项优化在 3 级优化时开启。尽管 -finline-functions 可以独立于 -O3 选项使用，但它只是给编译器的一个 建议 ，让编译器去寻找可以内联的函数。同样，可以用 static inline 关键字建议编译器内联某个特定的函数。记住，编译器不会内联所有函数，函数内联也不能保证让代码更快。 The -finline-functions flag suggests to GCC that functions should be inlined. This optimization is turned on at level 3. Even though -finline-functions can be used independently of the -O3 flag, it is a suggestion to the compiler to look for functions to inline. Likewise, the static inline keyword can be used to suggest to the compiler that a particular function should be inlined. Keep in mind that the compiler will not inline all functions, and that function inlining is not guaranteed to make code faster. 译注 按当前的 GCC 手册， -finline-functions 在 -O2 级别就已开启（见本章开头的现代更新）。另外，上一段提到的 fsqrt 在 x86-64 上实际是 SSE2 的 sqrtsd ，见上一节的译注。 程序员一般应当避免手动内联函数。手动内联函数很可能会大大降低代码的可读性，增加出错的可能，并使函数更难更新和维护。例如，试图把 isPrime 函数内联到 getNextPrime 函数中，会大大降低 getNextPrime 的可读性。 Programmers should generally avoid inlining functions manually. Inlining functions carries a high risk of significantly reducing the readability of code, increasing the likelihood of errors, and making it harder to update and maintain functions. For example, trying to inline the isPrime function in the getNextPrime function will greatly reduce the readability of getNextPrime . 12.2.2. 循环展开 12.2.2. Loop Unrolling 本节讨论的最后一种编译器优化策略是循环展开。我们再来看 isPrime 函数： The last compiler optimization strategy we discuss in this section is loop unrolling. Let’s revisit the isPrime function: // helper function: checks to see if a number is prime int isPrime(int x) { int i; int max = sqrt(x) + 1; // no prime number is less than 2 for (i = 2; i < max; i++) { // if the number is divisible by i if (x % i == 0) { return 0; // it's not prime } } return 1; // otherwise it is } for 循环总共执行 max 次，其中 max 比整数 x 的平方根大一。在汇编层面，循环的每次执行都要检查 i 是否小于 max 。如果是，指令指针就跳到计算取模运算的循环体。如果取模运算的结果为 0，程序立即退出循环并返回 0；否则，循环继续执行。尽管分支预测器很擅长预测条件表达式的求值结果（尤其是在循环内部），但一旦猜错，就会打乱指令流水线，造成性能损失。 The for loop executes a total of max times, where max is one more than the square root of integer x . At the assembly level, every execution of the loop checks to see whether i is less than max . If so, the instruction pointer jumps to the body of the loop, which computes the modulo operation. If the modulo operation results in 0, the program immediately exits the loop and returns 0. Otherwise, the loop continues execution. While branch predictors are fairly good at predicting what a conditional expression evaluates to (especially inside loops), wrong guesses can result in a hit to performance, due to disruptions in the instruction pipeline. 循环展开 （loop unrolling）是编译器为减少猜错的影响而进行的一种优化。循环展开的目标是把每次迭代完成的工作量增加到 n 倍，从而把循环的迭代次数减少到 1/ n 。当一个循环按 2 倍展开时，循环的迭代次数减为 一半 ，而每次迭代完成的工作量 翻倍 。 Loop unrolling is an optimization that compilers perform to reduce the impact of wrong guesses. In loop unrolling, the goal is to reduce the number of iterations of a loop by a factor of n by increasing the workload that each iteration performs by a factor of n . When a loop is unrolled by a factor of 2, the number of iterations in the loop is cut by half , whereas the amount work performed per iteration is doubled . 我们来手动对 isPrime 函数应用 2 倍循环展开（见 optExample3.c ）： Let’s manually apply 2-factor loop unrolling to our isPrime function (available in optExample3.c ): // helper function: checks to see if a number is prime int isPrime(int x) { int i; int max = sqrt(x)+1; // no prime number is less than 2 for (i = 2; i < max; i+=2) { // if the number is divisible by i or i+1 if ( (x % i == 0) || (x % (i+1) == 0) ) { return 0; // it's not prime } } return 1; // otherwise it is } 注意，尽管我们把 for 循环的迭代次数减半了，但循环的每次迭代现在要做两次取模检查，每次迭代的工作量翻了一番。重新编译并运行程序，运行时间略有改善（见 表 2 ）。代码的可读性也降低了。使用循环展开的更好方式，是调用 -funroll-loops 编译优化选项，它告诉编译器展开那些迭代次数可以在编译时确定的循环。 -funroll-all-loops 编译选项是一个更激进的选项，无论编译器能否确定迭代次数，它都会展开所有循环。 表 2 展示了手动 2 倍循环展开（见 optExample3.c ）的运行时间，并与在前一个程序（ optExample2.c ）上加 -funroll-loops 和 -funroll-all-loops 编译优化选项的运行时间进行比较。 Notice that even though we have halved the number of iterations that the for loop takes, each iteration of the loop now performs two modulo checks, doubling the amount of work per iteration. Recompiling and rerunning the program results in marginally improved times (see Table 2 ). The readability of the code is also reduced. A better way to utilize loop unrolling is to invoke the -funroll-loops compiler optimization flag, which tells the compiler to unroll loops whose iterations can be determined at compile time. The -funroll-all-loops compiler flag is a more aggressive option that unrolls all loops whether or not the compiler is certain of the number of iterations. Table 2 shows the runtimes of the manual 2-factor loop unrolling (available in optExample3.c ) compared to adding the -funroll-loops and -funroll-all-loops compiler optimization flags to the previous program ( optExample2.c ). 表 2. 生成 5,000,000 个素数所用的时间（秒） Table 2. Time in Seconds to Produce 5,000,000 Prime Numbers 译注 表中前两行与 12.1 节表 2 完全相同，可见这里沿用的是同一个实验，即生成 2 到 5,000,000 之间的素数，而不是「5,000,000 个素数」。 版本 未优化 -O1 -O2 -O3 原始版本（ optExample.c ） 3.86 2.32 2.14 2.15 循环不变量外提后（ optExample2.c ） 1.83 1.63 1.71 1.63 手动 2 倍循环展开（ optExample3.c ） 1.65 1.53 1.45 1.45 加 -funroll-loops （ optExample2.c ） 1.82 1.48 1.46 1.46 加 -funroll-all-loops （ optExample2.c ） 1.81 1.47 1.47 1.46 Version Unoptimized -O1 -O2 -O3 Original ( optExample.c ) 3.86 2.32 2.14 2.15 With loop-invariant code motion ( optExample2.c ) 1.83 1.63 1.71 1.63 With manual 2-factor loop unrolling ( optExample3.c ) 1.65 1.53 1.45 1.45 With -funroll-loops ( optExample2.c ) 1.82 1.48 1.46 1.46 With -funroll-all-loops ( optExample2.c ) 1.81 1.47 1.47 1.46 尽管手动循环展开确实带来了一些性能提升，但编译器内建的循环展开选项与其他优化选项结合使用时，能获得相当的性能。如果程序员想在代码中加入循环展开优化，默认应当使用相应的编译选项，而 不是 自己手动展开循环。 While manual loop unrolling does result in some performance improvement, the compiler’s built-in loop unrolling flags when combined with the other optimization flags yield comparable performance. If a programmer wants to incorporate loop unrolling optimizations into their code, they should default to using the appropriate compiler flags, and not manually unroll loops themselves.
