For convenience, the function is reproduced below. int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if ( x > y ) { smallest = y; } else { smallest = x; } return smallest; } 从 GDB 中取出的对应汇编代码类似下面这样： The corresponding assembly code extracted from GDB looks similar to the following: (gdb) disas getSmallest Dump of assembler code for function getSmallest: 0x40059a <+4>: mov %edi,-0x14(%rbp) 0x40059d <+7>: mov %esi,-0x18(%rbp) 0x4005a0 <+10>: mov -0x14(%rbp),%eax 0x4005a3 <+13>: cmp -0x18(%rbp),%eax 0x4005a6 <+16>: jle 0x4005b0 <getSmallest+26> 0x4005a8 <+18>: mov -0x18(%rbp),%eax 0x4005ae <+24>: jmp 0x4005b9 <getSmallest+35> 0x4005b0 <+26>: mov -0x14(%rbp),%eax 0x4005b9 <+35>: pop %rbp 0x4005ba <+36>: retq 这是一种与我们之前见过的不同的汇编代码视图。在这里，我们能看到每条指令对应的 地址 ，但看不到 字节 。注意，为了简单起见，这段汇编代码经过了少许编辑：去掉了通常属于函数开头的那些指令（即 push %rbp 、 mov %rsp, %rbp ）。按照惯例，GCC 把函数的第一个和第二个参数分别放在寄存器 %rdi 和 %rsi 中。由于 getSmallest 的参数是 int 类型，编译器把参数分别放在组成部分寄存器 %edi 和 %esi 中。为了清楚起见，我们把这两个参数分别称为 x 和 y 。 This is a different view of the assembly code than we have seen before. Here, we can see the address associated with each instruction, but not the bytes . Note that this assembly segment has been lightly edited for the sake of simplicity. The instructions that are normally part of function creation (i.e., push %rbp , mov %rsp, %rbp ) are removed. By convention, GCC places the first and second parameters of a function in registers %rdi and %rsi , respectively. Since the parameters to getSmallest are of type int , the compiler places the parameters in the respective component registers %edi and %esi instead. For the sake of clarity, we refer to these parameters as x and y , respectively. 我们来跟踪上面这段汇编代码的前几行。注意，在这个例子中我们不会明确地画出栈。我们把它留作读者的练习，鼓励你自己画一画，练习跟踪栈的技能。 Let’s trace through the first few lines of the previous assembly code snippet. Note that we will not draw out the stack explicitly in this example. We leave this as an exercise for the reader, and encourage you to practice your stack tracing skills by drawing it out yourself. 第一条 mov 指令复制寄存器 %edi 中的值（第一个参数 x ），把它放到调用栈上的内存位置 %rbp-0x14 处。指令指针（ %rip ）被设为下一条指令的地址，即 0x40059d。 The first mov instruction copies the value located in register %edi (the first parameter, x ) and places it at memory location %rbp-0x14 on the call stack. The instruction pointer ( %rip ) is set to the address of the next instruction, or 0x40059d. 第二条 mov 指令复制寄存器 %esi 中的值（第二个参数 y ），把它放到调用栈上的内存位置 %rbp-0x18 处。指令指针（ %rip ）更新为指向下一条指令的地址，即 0x4005a0。 The second mov instruction copies the value located in register %esi (the second parameter, y ) and places it at memory location %rbp-0x18 on the call stack. The instruction pointer ( %rip ) updates to point to the address of the next instruction, or 0x4005a0. 第三条 mov 指令把 x 复制到寄存器 %eax 。寄存器 %rip 更新为指向顺序中下一条指令的地址。 The third mov instruction copies x to register %eax . Register %rip updates to point to the address of the next instruction in sequence. cmp 指令把位置 %rbp-0x18 处的值（第二个参数 y ）与 x 进行比较，并设置相应的条件码标志寄存器。寄存器 %rip 前进到下一条指令的地址，即 0x4005a6。 The cmp instruction compares the value at location %rbp-0x18 (the second parameter, y ) to x and sets appropriate condition code flag registers. Register %rip advances to the address of the next instruction, or 0x4005a6. 地址 0x4005a6 处的 jle 指令表示：如果 x 小于或等于 y ，下一条应当执行的指令位于 <getSmallest+26> ， %rip 应当被设为地址 0x4005b0；否则， %rip 被设为顺序中的下一条指令，即 0x4005a8。 The jle instruction at address 0x4005a6 indicates that if x is less than or equal to y , the next instruction that should execute should be at location <getSmallest+26> and that %rip should be set to address 0x4005b0. Otherwise, %rip is set to the next instruction in sequence, or 0x4005a8. 接下来要执行哪些指令，取决于程序是否在地址 0x4005a6 处走了分支（即执行了跳转）。我们先假设 没有 走分支。这种情况下， %rip 被设为 0x4005a8（即 <getSmallest+18> ），接着执行下面的指令序列： The next instructions to execute depend on whether the program follows the branch (i.e., executes the jump) at address 0x4005a6. Let’s first suppose that the branch was not followed. In this case, %rip is set to 0x4005a8 (i.e., <getSmallest+18> ) and the following sequence of instructions executes: <getSmallest+18> 处的 mov -0x18(%rbp), %eax 指令把 y 复制到寄存器 %eax 。寄存器 %rip 前进到 0x4005ae。 The mov -0x18(%rbp), %eax instruction at <getSmallest+18> copies y to register %eax . Register %rip advances to 0x4005ae. <getSmallest+24> 处的 jmp 指令把寄存器 %rip 设为地址 0x4005b9。 The jmp instruction at <getSmallest+24> sets register %rip to address 0x4005b9. 最后执行的是 pop %rbp 指令和 retq 指令，它们清理栈并从函数调用返回。在这种情况下， y 位于返回寄存器中。 The last instructions to execute are the pop %rbp instruction and the retq instruction, which cleans up the stack and returns from the function call. In this case, y is in the return register. 现在，假设在 <getSmallest+16> 处走了分支。换句话说， jle 指令把寄存器 %rip 设为 0x4005b0（ <getSmallest+26> ）。那么，接下来执行的指令是： Now, suppose that the branch was taken at <getSmallest+16> . In other words, the jle instruction sets register %rip to 0x4005b0 ( <getSmallest+26> ). Then, the next instructions to execute are: 地址 0x4005b0 处的 mov -0x14(%rbp),%eax 指令把 x 复制到寄存器 %eax 。寄存器 %rip 前进到 0x4005b9。 The mov -0x14(%rbp),%eax instruction at address 0x4005b0 copies x to register %eax . Register %rip advances to 0x4005b9. 最后执行的是 pop %rbp 和 retq ，它们清理栈并返回返回寄存器中的值。在这种情况下，组成部分寄存器 %eax 中存放的是 x ， getSmallest 返回 x 。 The last instructions that execute are pop %rbp and retq , which clean up the stack and returns the value in the return register. In this case, component register %eax contains x , and getSmallest returns x . 于是我们可以这样为上面的汇编加上注释： We can then annotate the preceding assembly as follows: 0x40059a <+4>: mov %edi,-0x14(%rbp) # copy x to %rbp-0x14 0x40059d <+7>: mov %esi,-0x18(%rbp) # copy y to %rbp-0x18 0x4005a0 <+10>: mov -0x14(%rbp),%eax # copy x to %eax 0x4005a3 <+13>: cmp -0x18(%rbp),%eax # compare x with y 0x4005a6 <+16>: jle 0x4005b0 <getSmallest+26> # if x<=y goto <getSmallest+26> 0x4005a8 <+18>: mov -0x18(%rbp),%eax # copy y to %eax 0x4005ae <+24>: jmp 0x4005b9 <getSmallest+35> # goto <getSmallest+35> 0x4005b0 <+26>: mov -0x14(%rbp),%eax # copy x to %eax 0x4005b9 <+35>: pop %rbp # restore %rbp (clean up stack) 0x4005ba <+36>: retq # exit function (return %eax) 把它翻译回 C 代码，得到： Translating this back to C code yields: 表 1. 把 getSmallest() 翻译成 C 的 goto 形式和 C 代码 Table 1. Translating getSmallest() into goto C form and C code. goto 形式 goto Form int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x <= y) { goto assign_x; } smallest = y; goto done; assign_x: smallest = x; done: return smallest; } 翻译出的 C 代码 Translated C code int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x <= y) { smallest = x; } else { smallest = y; } return smallest; } 在 表 1 中，变量 smallest 对应于寄存器 %eax 。如果 x 小于或等于 y ，代码执行语句 smallest = x ，在这个函数的 goto 形式中，它与 goto 标签 assign_x 相关联。否则，执行语句 smallest = y 。 goto 标签 done 用来表示应当返回 smallest 中的值。 In Table 1 , the variable smallest corresponds to register %eax . If x is less than or equal to y , the code executes the statement smallest = x , which is associated with the goto label assign_x in our goto form of this function. Otherwise, the statement smallest = y is executed. The goto label done is used to indicate that the value in smallest should be returned. 注意，上面由汇编代码翻译出的 C 代码与原来的 getSmallest 函数略有不同。这些差异无关紧要；仔细检查两个函数就会发现，这两个程序在逻辑上是等价的。不过，编译器首先会把任何 if 语句转换成等价的 goto 形式，这就产生了一个略有不同但等价的版本。 表 2 展示了标准的 if 语句格式及其等价的 goto 形式： Notice that the preceding C translation of the assembly code is a bit different from the original getSmallest function. These differences don’t matter; close inspection of both functions reveals that the two programs are logically equivalent. However, the compiler first converts any if statement into an equivalent goto form, which results in the slightly different, but equivalent, version. Table 2 shows the standard if statement format and its equivalent goto form: 表 2. 标准的 if 语句格式及其等价的 goto 形式 Table 2. Standard if statement format and its equivalent goto form. C 的 if 语句 C if statement if (condition) { then_statement; } else { else_statement; } 编译器的等价 goto 形式 Compiler’s equivalent goto form if (!condition) { goto else; } then_statement; goto done; else: else_statement; done: 编译器在把代码翻译成汇编时，指定的是条件为真时跳转。对比一下 if 语句的结构，它是在条件 不 为真时发生「跳转」（跳到 else ）。 goto 形式体现了这一逻辑上的差别。 Compilers translating code into assembly designate a jump when a condition is true. Contrast this behavior with the structure of an if statement, where a “jump” (to the else ) occurs when conditions are not true. The goto form captures this difference in logic. 考虑 getSmallest 函数原来的 goto 翻译，可以看出： Considering the original goto translation of the getSmallest function, we can see that: x <= y 对应于 !condition 。 x <= y corresponds to !condition . smallest = x 是 else_statement 。 smallest = x is the else_statement . smallest = y 这一行是 then_statement 。 The line smallest = y is the then_statement . 函数的最后一行是 return smallest 。 The last line in the function is return smallest . 按照上面的注解改写原来的函数，得到： Rewriting the original version of the function with the preceding annotations yields: int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x > y) { //!(x <= y) smallest = y; //then_statement } else { smallest = x; //else_statement } return smallest; } 这个版本与原来的 getSmallest 函数完全相同。记住，在 C 代码层面用不同方式编写的函数，可能会被翻译成同一组汇编指令。 This version is identical to the original getSmallest function. Keep in mind that a function written in different ways at the C code level can translate to the same set of assembly instructions. cmov 指令 The cmov Instructions 我们要介绍的最后一组条件指令是 条件传送 （conditional move， cmov ）指令。 cmp 、 test 和 jmp 指令在程序中实现的是 有条件的控制转移 。换句话说，程序的执行会向多个方向分支。这对于优化代码来说可能非常麻烦，因为这些分支的代价很高。 The last set of conditional instructions we cover are conditional move ( cmov ) instructions. The cmp , test , and jmp instructions implement a conditional transfer of control in a program. In other words, the execution of the program branches in many directions. This can be very problematic for optimizing code, because these branches are very expensive. 与之不同， cmov 指令实现的是 有条件的数据传送 。换句话说，条件的 then_statement 和 else_statement 都会被执行，然后根据条件的结果，把数据放到相应的寄存器中。 In contrast, the cmov instruction implements a conditional transfer of data . In other words, both the then_statement and else_statement of the conditional are executed, and the data is placed in the appropriate register based on the result of the condition. 使用 C 的 三元表达式 （ternary expression）常常会使编译器生成 cmov 指令来代替跳转。对于标准的 if-then-else 语句，三元表达式的形式是： The use of C’s ternary expression often results in the compiler generating a cmov instruction in place of jumps. For the standard if-then-else statement, the ternary expression has the form: result = (condition) ? then_statement : else_statement; 我们用这种格式把 getSmallest 函数改写成三元表达式。记住，这个新版本函数的行为与原来的 getSmallest 函数完全相同： Let’s use this format to rewrite the getSmallest function as a ternary expression. Since the program executes linearly, the program continues on to execute the code under the label done , which returns the value of smallest ( x ). 如果 x 大于 y ， smallest 被赋值为 y 。接着程序执行语句 goto done ，把控制转移到 done 标签处，返回 smallest 的值（ y ）。 If x is greater than y , smallest is assigned the value y . The program then executes the statement goto done , which transfers control to the done label, which returns the value of smallest ( y ). 虽然在编程的早期 goto 语句很常用，但在现代代码中使用 goto 语句被认为是不好的做法，因为它降低了代码整体的可读性。事实上，计算机科学家艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉（Edsger Dijkstra）曾写过一篇抨击使用 goto 语句的著名文章，题为《 Go To 语句有害论 》（ Go To Statement Considered Harmful ） 1 。 While goto statements were commonly used in the early days of programming, the use of goto statements in modern code is considered bad practice, as it reduces the overall readability of code. In fact, computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra wrote a famous paper lambasting the use of goto statements called Go To Statement Considered Harmful 1 . 一般来说，设计良好的 C 程序不使用 goto 语句，程序员也不被鼓励使用它，以免写出难以阅读、调试和维护的代码。不过，理解 C 的 goto 语句很重要，因为 GCC 在把含有条件语句的 C 代码（包括含有 if 语句和循环的代码）翻译成汇编之前，通常会先把它改写成 goto 形式。 In general, well-designed C programs do not use goto statements and programmers are discouraged from using them to avoid writing code that is difficult to read, debug, and maintain. However, the C goto statement is important to understand, as GCC typically changes C code with conditionals into a goto form prior to translating it to assembly, including code that contains if statements and loops. 接下来的几个小节更详细地介绍 if 语句和循环的汇编表示。 The following subsections cover the assembly representation of if statements and loops in greater detail. if 语句 If Statements 循环 Loops 参考文献 References Edsger Dijkstra. “Go To Statement Considered Harmful”. Communications of the ACM 11(3) pp. 147—​148. 1968.

x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C7-x86_64/loops.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 7.4.3. Loops in Assembly 与 if 语句一样，汇编中的循环也是用跳转指令实现的。不过，循环让指令可以根据对条件求值的结果被 重新执行 。 Like if statements, loops in assembly are also implemented using jump instructions. However, loops enable instructions to be revisited based on the result of an evaluated condition. 下例中的 sumUp 函数把从 1 到用户给定整数之间的所有正整数加起来。这段代码故意写得不够优化，以便演示 C 中的 while 循环。 The sumUp function shown in the following example sums up all the positive integers from 1 to a user-defined integer. This code is intentionally written suboptimally to illustrate a while loop in C. int sumUp(int n) { //initialize total and i int total = 0; int i = 1; while (i <= n) { //while i is less than or equal to n total += i; //add i to total i++; //increment i by 1 } return total; } 编译这段代码并用 GDB 反汇编，得到如下汇编代码： Compiling this code and disassembling it using GDB yields the following assembly code: Dump of assembler code for function sumUp: 0x400526 <+0>: push %rbp 0x400527 <+1>: mov %rsp,%rbp 0x40052a <+4>: mov %edi,-0x14(%rbp) 0x40052d <+7>: mov $0x0,-0x8(%rbp) 0x400534 <+14>: mov $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) 0x40053b <+21>: jmp 0x400547 <sumUp+33> 0x40053d <+23>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax 0x400540 <+26>: add %eax,-0x8(%rbp) 0x400543 <+29>: add $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) 0x400547 <+33>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax 0x40054a <+36>: cmp -0x14(%rbp),%eax 0x40054d <+39>: jle 0x40053d <sumUp+23> 0x40054f <+41>: mov -0x8(%rbp),%eax 0x400552 <+44>: pop %rbp 0x400553 <+45>: retq 同样，在这个例子中我们不会明确地画出栈。不过，我们鼓励读者自己把栈画出来。 Again, we will not draw out the stack explicitly in this example. However, we encourage readers to draw the stack out themselves. 前五条指令 The First Five Instructions 这个函数的前五条指令为函数的执行准备好栈，并为函数执行设置好临时值： The first five instructions of this function set the stack up for function execution and set up temporary values for function execution: 0x400526 <+0>: push %rbp # save %rbp onto the stack 0x400527 <+1>: mov %rsp,%rbp # update the value of %rbp (new frame) 0x40052a <+4>: mov %edi,-0x14(%rbp) # copy n to %rbp-0x14 0x40052d <+7>: mov $0x0,-0x8(%rbp) # copy 0 to %rbp-0x8 (total) 0x400534 <+14>: mov $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) # copy 1 to %rbp-0x4 (i) 回想一下，栈上的位置存放函数中的 临时变量 。为了简单起见，我们把 %rbp-0x8 所标记的位置称为 total ，把 %rbp - 0x4 称为 i 。 sumUp 的输入参数（ n ）被移到栈位置 %rbp-0x14 。尽管临时变量被放在了栈上，但要记住，执行完第一条指令（即 push %rbp ）之后，栈指针就没有再改变过。 Recall that stack locations store temporary variables in a function. For simplicity we will refer to the location marked by %rbp-0x8 as total and %rbp - 0x4 as i . The input parameter to sumUp ( n ) is moved to stack location %rbp-0x14 . Despite the placement of temporary variables on the stack, keep in mind that the stack pointer has not changed after the execution of the first instruction (i.e., push %rbp ). 译注 这里没有用 sub 移动 %rsp ，就把变量放在了 %rsp 下方，这是因为 sumUp 是叶子函数（不再调用其他函数）。x86-64 System V ABI 规定栈指针下方有 128 字节的「红区」（red zone），叶子函数可以直接使用而不必调整 %rsp 。 循环的核心 The Heart of the Loop sumUp 函数中接下来的七条指令构成了循环的核心： The next seven instructions in the sumUp function represent the heart of the loop: 0x40053b <+21>: jmp 0x400547 <sumUp+33> # goto <sumUp+33> 0x40053d <+23>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax # copy i to %eax 0x400540 <+26>: add %eax,-0x8(%rbp) # add i to total (total += i) 0x400543 <+29>: add $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) # add 1 to i (i += 1) 0x400547 <+33>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax # copy i to %eax 0x40054a <+36>: cmp -0x14(%rbp),%eax # compare i to n 0x40054d <+39>: jle 0x40053d <sumUp+23> # if (i <= n) goto <sumUp+23> 第一条指令是直接跳转到 <sumUp+33> ，它把指令指针（ %rip ）设为地址 0x400547。 The first instruction is a direct jump to <sumUp+33> , which sets the instruction pointer ( %rip ) to address 0x400547. 接下来执行的指令是 mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax ，它把 i 的值放到寄存器 %eax 中。寄存器 %rip 更新为 0x40054a。 The next instruction that executes is mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax , which places the value of i in register %eax . Register %rip is updated to 0x40054a. <sumUp+36> 处的 cmp 指令比较 i 和 n ，并设置相应的条件码寄存器。寄存器 %rip 被设为 0x40054d。 The cmp instruction at <sumUp+36> compares i to n and sets the appropriate condition code registers. Register %rip is set to 0x40054d. 然后执行 jle 指令。接下来执行哪些指令，取决于是否走分支。 The jle instruction then executes. The instructions that execute next depend on whether or not the branch is taken. 假设 走了 分支（即 i <= n 为真）。那么指令指针被设为 0x40053d，程序的执行跳到 <sumUp+23> 。接着依次执行以下指令： Suppose that the branch is taken (i.e., i <= n is true). Then the instruction pointer is set to 0x40053d and program execution jumps to <sumUp+23> . The following instructions then execute in sequence: <sumUp+23> 处的 mov 指令把 i 复制到寄存器 %eax 。 The mov instruction at <sumUp+23> copies i to register %eax . add %eax,-0x8(%rbp) 把 i 加到 total 上（即 total += i ）。 The add %eax,-0x8(%rbp) adds i to total (i.e., total += i ). 接着， <sumUp+29> 处的 add 指令把 i 加 1（即 i += 1 ）。 The add instruction at <sumUp+29> then adds 1 to i (i.e., i += 1 ). <sumUp+33> 处的 mov 指令把更新后的 i 值复制到寄存器 %eax 。 The mov instruction at <sumUp+33> copies the updated value of i to register %eax . 然后 cmp 指令比较 i 和 n ，并设置相应的条件码寄存器。 The cmp instruction then compares i to n and sets the appropriate condition code registers. 接着执行 jle 。如果 i 小于或等于 n ，程序的执行再次跳到 <sumUp+23> ，循环（定义在 <sumUp+23> 和 <sumUp+39> 之间）重复执行。 Next, jle executes. If i is less than or equal to n , program execution once again jumps to <sumUp+23> and the loop (defined between <sumUp+23> and <sumUp+39> ) repeats. 如果 没有 走分支（即 i 不 小于或等于 n ），则执行以下指令： If the branch is not taken (i.e., i is not less than or equal to n ), the following instructions execute: 0x40054f <+41>: mov -0x8(%rbp),%eax # copy total to %eax 0x400552 <+44>: pop %rbp # restore rbp 0x400553 <+45>: retq # return (total) 这些指令把 total 复制到寄存器 %eax ，把 %rbp 恢复为原来的值，然后退出函数。因此，函数在退出时返回 total 。 These instructions copy total to register %eax , restore %rbp to its original value, and exit the function. Thus, the function returns total upon exit. 表 1 展示了 sumUp 函数的汇编形式和 C 的 goto 形式： Table 1 shows the assembly and C goto forms of the sumUp function: 表 1. 把 sumUp 翻译成 C 的 goto 形式 Table 1. Translating sumUp into goto C form. 汇编 Assembly <sumUp>: <+0>: push %rbp <+1>: mov %rsp,%rbp <+4>: mov %edi,-0x14(%rbp) <+7>: mov $0x0,-0x8(%rbp) <+14>: mov $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) <+21>: jmp 0x400547 <sumUp+33> <+23>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax <+26>: add %eax,-0x8(%rbp) <+29>: add $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) <+33>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax <+36>: cmp -0x14(%rbp),%eax <+39>: jle 0x40053d <sumUp+23> <+41>: mov -0x8(%rbp),%eax <+44>: pop %rbp <+45>: retq 翻译出的 goto 形式 Translated goto Form int sumUp(int n) { int total = 0; int i = 1; goto start; body: total += i; i += 1; start: if (i <= n) { goto body; } return total; } 上面的代码也等价于下面这段不含 goto 语句的 C 代码： The preceding code is also equivalent to the following C code without goto statements: int sumUp(int n) { int total = 0; int i = 1; while (i <= n) { total += i; i += 1; } return total; } 汇编中的 for 循环 for Loops in Assembly sumUp 函数中的主循环也可以写成 for 循环： The primary loop in the sumUp function can also be written as a for loop: int sumUp2(int n) { int total = 0; //initialize total to 0 int i; for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) { //initialize i to 1, increment by 1 while i<=n total += i; //updates total by i } return total; } 这个版本生成的汇编代码与我们的 while 循环示例完全相同。下面再列出这段汇编代码，并为每一行加上英文注解： This version yields assembly code identical to our while loop example. We repeat the assembly code below and annotate each line with its English translation: Dump of assembler code for function sumUp2: 0x400554 <+0>: push %rbp #save %rbp 0x400555 <+1>: mov %rsp,%rbp #update %rpb (new stack frame) 0x400558 <+4>: mov %edi,-0x14(%rbp) #copy %edi to %rbp-0x14 (n) 0x40055b <+7>: movl $0x0,-0x8(%rbp) #copy 0 to %rbp-0x8 (total) 0x400562 <+14>: movl $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) #copy 1 to %rbp-0x4 (i) 0x400569 <+21>: jmp 0x400575 <sumUp2+33> #goto <sumUp2+33> 0x40056b <+23>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax #copy i to %eax [loop] 0x40056e <+26>: add %eax,-0x8(%rbp) #add i to total (total+=i) 0x400571 <+29>: addl $0x1,-0x4(%rbp) #add 1 to i (i++) 0x400575 <+33>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax #copy i to %eax [start] 0x400578 <+36>: cmp -0x14(%rbp),%eax #compare i with n 0x40057b <+39>: jle 0x40056b <sumUp2+23> #if (i <= n) goto loop 0x40057d <+41>: mov -0x8(%rbp),%eax #copy total to %eax 0x400580 <+44>: pop %rbp #prepare to leave the function 0x400581 <+45>: retq #return total 要理解为什么这段代码的 for 循环版本与 while 循环版本生成的汇编完全相同，回想一下， for 循环的表示形式是： To understand why the for loop version of this code results in identical assembly to the while loop version of the code, recall that the for loop has the following representation: for ( <initialization>; <boolean expression>; <step> ){ <body> } 它等价于下面的 while 循环表示形式： and is equivalent to the following while loop representation: <initialization> while (<boolean expression>) { <body> <step> } 由于 每个 for 循环都可以用 while 循环表示 ，下面两个 C 程序都是前面那段汇编的等价表示： Since every for loop can be represented by a while loop , the following two C programs are equivalent representations for the previous assembly: 表 2. 编写 sumUp 函数的两种等价方式 Table 2. Equivalent ways to write the sumUp function. for 循环 For loop int sumUp2(int n) { int total = 0; int i = 1; for (i; i <= n; i++) { total += i; } return total; } while 循环 While loop int sumUp(int n){ int total = 0; int i = 1; while (i <= n) { total += i; i += 1; } return total; }

x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C7-x86_64/recursion.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 7.6. Recursion 递归函数是一类特殊的函数，它们调用自身（也称为 自引用 函数，self-referential function）来计算一个值。和非递归的函数一样，递归函数的每次调用都会创建新的栈帧。与标准函数不同的是，递归函数中包含对自身的函数调用。 Recursive functions are a special class of functions that call themselves (also known as self-referential functions) to compute a value. Like their nonrecursive counterparts, recursive functions create new stack frames for each function call. Unlike standard functions, recursive functions contain function calls to themselves. 我们再来看把从 1 到 n 的正整数加起来的问题。在前面的小节中，我们讨论了完成这项任务的 sumUp 函数。 表 1 给出了一个相关的函数 sumDown ，它按相反的顺序（从 n 到 1 ）把数加起来，还给出了与之等价的递归版本 sumr ： Let’s revisit the problem of summing up the set of positive integers from 1 to n . In previous sections, we discussed the sumUp function to achieve this task. Table 1 shows a related function called sumDown that adds the numbers in reverse ( n to 1 ), and its recursive equivalent sumr : 表 1. 迭代版本（sumDown）与递归版本（sumr） Table 1. Iterative version (sumDown) and recursive version (sumr) 迭代版本 Iterative int sumDown(int n) { int total = 0; int i = n; while (i > 0) { total += i; i--; } return total; } 递归版本 Recursive int sumr(int n) { if (n <= 0) { return 0; } return n + sumr(n-1); } 递归函数 sumr 中的基本情况（base case）处理所有小于一的 n 值。递归步骤以值 n-1 调用 sumr ，并在返回之前把结果加到 n 上。编译 sumr 并用 GDB 反汇编，得到如下汇编代码： The base case in the recursive function sumr accounts for any values of n that are less than one. The recursive step calls sumr with the value n-1 and adds the result to n prior to returning. Compiling sumr and disassembling it with GDB yields the following assembly code: Dump of assembler code for function sumr: 0x400551 <+0>: push %rbp # save %rbp 0x400552 <+1>: mov %rsp,%rbp # update %rbp (new stack frame) 0x400555 <+4>: sub $0x10,%rsp # expand stack frame by 16 bytes 0x400559 <+8>: mov %edi,-0x4(%rbp) # move first param (n) to %rbp-0x4 0x40055c <+11>: cmp $0x0,-0x4(%rbp) # compare n to 0 0x400560 <+15>: jg 0x400569 <sumr+24> # if (n > 0) goto <sumr+24> [body] 0x400562 <+17>: mov $0x0,%eax # copy 0 to %eax 0x400567 <+22>: jmp 0x40057d <sumr+44> # goto <sumr+44> [done] 0x400569 <+24>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax # copy n to %eax (result = n) 0x40056c <+27>: sub $0x1,%eax # subtract 1 from %eax (result -= 1) 0x40056f <+30>: mov %eax,%edi # copy %eax to %edi 0x400571 <+32>: callq 0x400551 <sumr> # call sumr(result) 0x400576 <+37>: mov %eax,%edx # copy returned value to %edx 0x400578 <+39>: mov -0x4(%rbp),%eax # copy n to %eax 0x40057b <+42>: add %edx,%eax # add sumr(result) to n 0x40057d <+44>: leaveq # prepare to leave the function 0x40057e <+45>: retq # return result 上面汇编代码的每一行都加上了英文注解。 表 2 给出了对应的 goto 形式，以及不含 goto 语句的 C 程序： Each line in the preceding assembly code is annotated with its English translation. Table 2 shows the corresponding goto form and C program without goto statements: 表 2. sumr 汇编代码的 C goto 形式及其翻译 Table 2. C goto form and translation of sumr assembly code C goto 形式 C goto form int sumr(int n) { int result; if (n > 0) { goto body; } result = 0; goto done; body: result = n; result -= 1; result = sumr(result); result += n; done: return result; } 不含 goto 语句的 C 版本 C version without goto statements int sumr(int n) { int result; if (n <= 0) { return 0; } result = sumr(n-1); result += n; return result; } 尽管这个翻译乍一看与原来的 sumr 函数并不完全相同，但仔细检查就会发现，两个函数确实是等价的。 Although this translation may not initially appear to be identical to the original sumr function, close inspection reveals that the two functions are indeed equivalent. 7.6.1. 动画：观察调用栈如何变化 7.6.1. Animation: Observing How the Call Stack Changes 作为练习，我们鼓励你把栈画出来，看看其中的值是如何变化的。下面的动画描绘了用值 3 运行这个函数时栈是如何更新的。 As an exercise, we encourage you to draw out the stack and see how the values change. The animation below depicts how the stack is updated when we run this function with the value 3.

x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C7-x86_64/arrays.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 7.7. Arrays 回想一下， 数组 是由相同类型的数据元素组成、在内存中连续存放的有序集合。静态分配的 一维数组 的形式是 Type arr[N] ，其中 Type 是数据类型， arr 是与数组关联的标识符， N 是数据元素的个数。静态地声明数组 Type arr[N] ，或者动态地分配 arr = malloc(N * sizeof(Type)) ，都会分配总共 N x sizeof( Type ) 个字节的内存。 Recall that arrays are ordered collections of data elements of the same type that are contiguously stored in memory. Statically allocated single-dimension arrays have the form Type arr[N] where Type is the data type, arr is the identifier associated with the array, and N is the number of data elements. Declaring an array statically as Type arr[N] or dynamically as arr = malloc(N * sizeof(Type)) allocates N x sizeof( Type ) total bytes of memory. 要访问数组 arr 中下标为 i 的元素，使用语法 arr[i] 。编译器在翻译成汇编之前，通常会把数组引用转换成 指针运算 。所以， arr+i 等价于 &arr[i] ， *(arr+i) 等价于 arr[i] 。由于 arr 中的每个数据元素都是 Type 类型， arr+i 意味着元素 i 存放在地址 arr + sizeof(Type) * i 处。 To access the element at index i in array arr , use the syntax arr[i] . Compilers commonly convert array references into pointer arithmetic prior to translating to assembly. So, arr+i is equivalent to &arr[i] , and *(arr+i) is equivalent to arr[i] . Since each data element in arr is of type Type , arr+i implies that element i is stored at address arr + sizeof(Type) * i . 表 1 概括了一些常见的数组操作及其对应的汇编指令。在下面的例子中，假设我们声明了一个长度为 10 的 int 数组（ int arr[10] ）。假设寄存器 %rdx 存放 arr 的地址，寄存器 %rcx 存放 int 值 i ，寄存器 %rax 表示某个变量 x （也是 int 类型）。回想一下， int 变量占四个字节，而 int * 变量占八个字节。 Table 1 outlines some common array operations and their corresponding assembly instructions. In the examples that follow, suppose that we declare an int array of length 10 ( int arr[10] ). Functions in Assembly 在上一节中，我们跟踪了汇编中的一些简单函数。本节在一个较大程序的背景下，讨论汇编中多个函数之间的交互。我们还会介绍一些与函数管理有关的新指令。 In the previous section, we traced through simple functions in assembly. In this section, we discuss the interaction between multiple functions in assembly in the context of a larger program. We also introduce some new instructions involved with function management. 我们先复习一下调用栈是如何管理的。回想一下， %rsp 是 栈指针 ，总是指向栈顶。寄存器 %rbp 表示基址指针（也称 帧指针 ），指向当前栈帧的底部。 栈帧 （stack frame，也称 活动帧 或 活动记录 ）指的是栈中分配给单次函数调用的那一部分。当前正在执行的函数总是位于栈顶，它的栈帧称为 活动帧 （active frame）。活动帧的边界由栈指针（在栈顶）和帧指针（在帧底）界定。活动记录中通常存放着函数的局部变量。 Let’s begin with a refresher on how the call stack is managed. Recall that %rsp is the stack pointer and always points to the top of the stack. The register %rbp represents the base pointer (also known as the frame pointer ) and points to the base of the current stack frame. The stack frame (also known as the activation frame or the activation record ) refers to the portion of the stack allocated to a single function call. The currently executing function is always at the top of the stack, and its stack frame is referred to as the active frame . The active frame is bounded by the stack pointer (at the top of stack) and the frame pointer (at the bottom of the frame). The activation record typically holds local variables for a function. 图 1 展示了 main 及其调用的一个名为 fname 的函数的栈帧。我们把 main 函数称为 调用者 （caller）函数，把 fname 称为 被调用者 （callee）函数。 Figure 1 shows the stack frames for main and a function it calls named fname . We will refer to the main function as the caller function and fname as the callee function. 图 1. 栈帧的管理 Figure 1. Stack frame management 在 图 1 中，当前的活动帧属于被调用者函数（ fname ）。栈指针和帧指针之间的内存用于存放局部变量。随着局部值被压入和弹出栈，栈指针会移动。与之不同，帧指针相对保持不变，指向当前栈帧的开头（底部）。因此，像 GCC 这样的编译器通常相对于帧指针来引用栈上的值。在 图 1 中，活动帧的下边界是 fname 的基址指针，即栈地址 0x418。存放在地址 0x418 处的值是「保存的」 %rbp 值（0x42c），它本身是一个地址，表示 main 函数活动帧的底部。 main 活动帧的顶部以 返回地址 （return address）为界，返回地址表示被调用函数 fname 执行完毕后，程序在 main 函数中从哪里继续执行。 In Figure 1 , the current active frame belongs to the callee function ( fname ). The memory between the stack pointer and the frame pointer is used for local variables. The stack pointer moves as local values are pushed and popped from the stack. In contrast, the frame pointer remains relatively constant, pointing to the beginning (the bottom) of the current stack frame. As a result, compilers like GCC commonly reference values on the stack relative to the frame pointer. In Figure 1 , the active frame is bounded below by the base pointer of fname , which is stack address 0x418. The value stored at address 0x418 is the “saved” %rbp value (0x42c), which itself is an address that indicates the bottom of the activation frame for the main function. The top of the activation frame of main is bounded by the return address , which indicates where in the main function program execution resumes once the callee function fname finishes executing. 原书警示 · 返回地址指向代码段内存，而不是栈内存（The return address points to code segment memory, not stack memory） 回想一下，程序的调用栈区域（栈内存）与其代码区域（代码段内存）是不同的。 %rbp 和 %rsp 指向栈内存中的地址，而 %rip 指向 代码 段内存中的地址。换句话说，返回地址是代码段内存中的一个地址，而不是栈内存中的地址： 图示：程序地址空间的组成部分 Recall that the call stack region (stack memory) of a program is different from its code region (code segment memory). While %rbp and %rsp point to addresses in the stack memory, %rip points to an address in code segment memory. In other words, the return address is an address in code segment memory, not stack memory: Figure 2. The parts of a program’s address space 表 1 列出了编译器用于基本函数管理的另外几条指令。 Table 1 contains several additional instructions that the compiler uses for basic function management. 表 1. 常用的函数管理指令 Table 1. Common Function Management Instructions 指令 Instruction leaveq leaveq 含义 Translation 为离开函数准备好栈。等价于： Prepares the stack for leaving a function. Equivalent to: mov %rbp, %rsp pop %rbp 指令 Instruction callq addr <fname> callq addr <fname> 含义 Translation 把活动帧切换到被调用者函数。等价于： Switches active frame to callee function. Equivalent to: push %rip mov addr, %rip 指令 Instruction retq retq 含义 Translation 把活动帧恢复为调用者函数。等价于： Restores active frame to caller function. Equivalent to: pop %rip 例如， leaveq 指令是编译器在准备离开函数时，用来恢复栈指针和帧指针的简写形式。当被调用函数执行完毕时， leaveq 确保帧指针被 恢复 为之前的值。 For example, the leaveq instruction is a shorthand that the compiler uses to restore the stack and frame pointers as it prepares to leave a function. When the callee function finishes execution, leaveq ensures that the frame pointer is restored to its previous value. callq 和 retq 指令在一个函数调用另一个函数的过程中起着重要作用。两条指令都会修改指令指针（寄存器 %rip ）。当调用者函数执行 callq 指令时， %rip 的当前值被保存到栈上，作为返回地址，即被调用函数执行完毕后调用者继续执行的程序地址。 callq 指令还会用被调用函数的地址替换 %rip 的值。 The callq and retq instructions play a prominent role in the process where one function calls another. Both instructions modify the instruction pointer (register %rip ). When the caller function executes the callq instruction, the current value of %rip is saved on the stack to represent the return address, or the program address at which the caller resumes executing once the callee function finishes. The callq instruction also replaces the value of %rip with the address of the callee function. retq 指令把 %rip 的值恢复为保存在栈上的值，确保程序在调用者函数中指定的程序地址处继续执行。被调用者返回的任何值都存放在 %rax 或它的某个组成部分寄存器（例如 %eax ）中。 retq 指令通常是任何函数中执行的最后一条指令。 The retq instruction restores the value of %rip to the value saved on the stack, ensuring that the program resumes execution at the program address specified in the caller function. Any value returned by the callee is stored in %rax or one of its component registers (e.g., %eax ). The retq instruction is usually the last instruction that executes in any function. 7.5.1. 函数参数 7.5.1. Function Parameters 与 IA32 不同，函数参数通常在函数调用之前就被预先加载到寄存器中。 表 2 列出了函数的各个参数，以及在函数调用之前它们被加载到的寄存器（如果有的话）。 Unlike IA32, function parameters are typically preloaded into registers prior to a function call. Locations of Function Parameters. 参数 位置 参数 1 %rdi 参数 2 %rsi 参数 3 %rdx 参数 4 %rcx 参数 5 %r8 参数 6 %r9 参数 7 及以后 调用栈上 Parameter Location Parameter 1 %rdi Parameter 2 %rsi Parameter 3 %rdx Parameter 4 %rcx Parameter 5 %r8 Parameter 6 %r9 Parameter 7+ on call stack 函数的前六个参数依次被加载到寄存器 %rdi 、 %rsi 、 %rdx 、 %rcx 、 %r8 和 %r9 中。其余的参数按照各自的大小依次被加载到调用栈上（32 位数据以 4 字节为偏移，64 位数据以 8 字节为偏移）。 The first six parameters to a function are loaded into registers %rdi , %rsi , %rdx , %rcx , %r8 , and %r9 , respectively. Tracing Through an Example 运用关于函数管理的知识，我们来跟踪本章开头首次介绍的那个代码示例。注意，我们在每个函数定义的参数列表中加上了 void 关键字，指明这些函数不接收参数。这一改动不会改变程序的输出，但确实会简化对应的汇编。 Using our knowledge of function management, let’s trace through the code example first introduced at the beginning of this chapter. Data Alignment and structs 考虑下面这个修改过的 struct studentT 声明： Consider the following modified declaration of struct studentT : struct studentTM { char name[63]; //updated to 63 instead of 64 int age; int grad_yr; float gpa; }; struct studentTM student2; name 字段的大小被改成了 63 字节，而不是原来的 64 字节。想想这会如何影响 struct 在内存中的布局。你可能会想当然地把它想象成 图 2 那样。 The size of the name field is modified to be 63 bytes, instead of the original 64. Consider how this affects the way the struct is laid out in memory. It may be tempting to visualize it as in Figure 2 . 图 2. 更新后的 struct studentTM 的一种错误内存布局。注意结构体的「name」字段从 64 字节减少到了 63 字节。 Figure 2. An incorrect memory layout for the updated struct studentTM. Note that the struct’s “name” field is reduced from 64 to 63 bytes. 在这种描绘中， age 字段出现在紧跟 name 字段之后的那个字节。但这是错误的。 图 3 描绘了实际的内存布局。 In this depiction, the age field occurs in the byte immediately following the name field. But this is incorrect. Figure 3 depicts the actual layout in memory. 图 3. 更新后的 struct studentTM 的正确内存布局。字节 x 63 是编译器为满足内存对齐约束而添加的，它不对应任何字段。 Figure 3. The correct memory layout for the updated struct studentTM. Byte x 63 is added by the compiler to satisfy memory alignment constraints, but it doesn’t correspond to any of the fields. x64 的对齐策略要求：两字节的数据类型（即 short ）位于两字节对齐的地址上，四字节的数据类型（即 int 、 float 和 unsigned ）位于四字节对齐的地址上，而更大的数据类型（ long 、 double 和指针数据）位于八字节对齐的地址上。对于 struct ，编译器会在字段之间添加空字节作为 填充 （padding），以确保每个字段都满足其对齐要求。例如，在 图 3 所声明的 struct 中，编译器在字节 x 63 处添加了一个字节的填充，确保 age 字段从一个四的倍数的地址开始。在内存中正确对齐的值可以在单次操作中被读取或写入，从而提高效率。 x64’s alignment policy requires that two-byte data types (i.e., short ) reside at a two-byte-aligned address, four-byte data types (i.e., int , float , and unsigned ) reside at four-byte-aligned addresses, whereas larger data types ( long , double , and pointer data) reside at eight-byte-aligned addresses. For a struct , the compiler adds empty bytes as padding between fields to ensure that each field satisfies its alignment requirements. For example, in the struct declared in Figure 3 , the compiler adds a byte of padding at byte x 63 to ensure that the age field starts at an address that is at a multiple of four. Values aligned properly in memory can be read or written in a single operation, enabling greater efficiency. 考虑把 struct 定义成下面这样时会发生什么： Consider what happens when a struct is defined as follows: struct studentTM { int age; int grad_yr; float gpa; char name[63]; }; struct studentTM student3; 把 name 数组移到最后，就把那个填充字节移到了结构体的末尾，确保 age 、 grad_yr 和 gpa 都是四字节对齐的。 Moving the name array to the end moves the byte of padding to the end of the struct, ensuring that age , grad_yr , and gpa are four-byte aligned. 译注 结构体的总大小还会被补齐为其最大对齐要求的整数倍（这里是 4），所以这两种排列的 sizeof 都是 76：区别只是填充字节的位置。字段顺序真正影响大小的典型例子是 char 、 double 、 char 这样大小穿插的排列，可以用 sizeof 和 offsetof （ <stddef.h> ）自己试验。

x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C8-IA32/index.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 8. 32-bit x86 Assembly (IA32) 本章介绍 32 位 Intel 体系结构（IA32）的指令集架构。回想一下， 指令集架构 （ISA）定义了机器级程序的指令集合和二进制编码。要运行本章的示例，你需要一台装有 x86 处理器的机器，或者一个能生成 32 位可执行文件的编译器。「x86」这个术语常被用作 IA32 体系结构的同义词。x86 及其 64 位变体 x86-64 在现代计算机中无处不在。 In this chapter, we cover the Intel Architecture 32-bit (IA32) instruction set architecture. Recall that an instruction set architecture (or ISA) defines the set of instructions and binary encodings of a machine-level program. To run the examples in this chapter, you will need access to a machine with an x86 processor or a compiler that can create 32-bit executables. The term “x86” is often used synonymously with the IA32 architecture. The x86, and its 64-bit variant x86-64, are ubiquitous in modern computers. 如今很少有机器还使用 32 位处理器；2007 年以来生产的大多数 Intel 和 AMD 系统都是 64 位处理器。要检查你的处理器是什么类型，使用 uname -m 命令： Very few modern machines have 32-bit processors; most Intel and AMD systems produced since 2007 have 64-bit processors. To check what type of processor you have, use the uname -m command: $ uname -m i686 如果 uname -m 返回 i686 或 i386 ，你的系统是 32 位处理器。而如果返回 x86_64 ，你的系统就是较新的 64 位处理器。请注意，由于 x86-64 是较早的 IA32 ISA 的 扩展 ，几乎所有 64 位系统都包含一个 32 位子系统，可以执行 32 位可执行文件。 If typing uname -m returns either i686 or i386 , your system has a 32-bit processor. However, if the uname -m command returns x86_64 , your system has a newer 64-bit processor. Please note that since x86-64 is an extension of the older IA32 ISA, virtually all 64-bit systems contain a 32-bit subsystem that allows the execution of 32-bit executables. 现代更新（截至 2026-11）· 32 位 x86 正在退场 「几乎所有 64 位系统都能执行 32 位程序」在硬件层面仍大体成立，但操作系统正陆续放弃 32 位：Apple 从 macOS Catalina 10.15 起不再兼容 32 位应用； Windows 11 的系统要求是兼容的 64 位处理器； Arch Linux 从 2017 年 11 月起不再支持 i686。学习 IA32 仍有价值（大量旧代码、教材和安全研究资料都基于它），但要运行本章示例，最方便的是 64 位 Linux 加上 gcc -m32 所需的 multilib 软件包。 Apple：32-bit app compatibility with macOS ； Microsoft：Windows 11 Specs and System Requirements ； Arch Linux：Phasing out i686 support 如果你使用的是 64 位 Linux 系统，有时需要安装额外的软件包，才能像本章这样 生成 32 位可执行文件。例如，在 Ubuntu 机器上，你需要安装 32 位开发库和其他软件包，给 GCC 加上交叉编译功能： If you have a 64-bit Linux system, additional packages are sometimes required to allow users to create 32-bit executables, like we will be doing in this chapter. For example, on an Ubuntu machine you will need to install 32-bit development libraries and additional packages to augment GCC with cross-compiling features: 译注 Apple Silicon Mac（ uname -m 输出 arm64 ）无法运行 32 位 x86 程序。只想对照阅读汇编的话，可以用 clang -S -O0 -target i386-linux-gnu 文件.c 让 Clang 交叉生成 IA32 汇编（只能看，不能链接运行）；要真正运行，需要 x86 Linux 虚拟机或云服务器并安装上面的软件包。 sudo apt-get install libc6-dev-i386 gcc-multilib 原书旁注 · x86 语法的分支（x86 Syntax Branches） x86 体系结构通常遵循两种不同的语法分支之一。UNIX 机器通常使用 AT&T 语法，因为 UNIX 是在 AT&T 贝尔实验室开发的，对应的汇编器是 GNU 汇编器（GAS）。由于本书的大多数示例使用 GCC，本章介绍的是 AT&T 语法。Windows 机器通常使用 Intel 语法，微软的宏汇编器（MASM）使用的就是这种语法。Netwide 汇编器（NASM）是 Linux 上使用 Intel 语法的汇编器的一个例子。两种语法孰优孰劣的争论，是这个领域的「圣战」之一。不过，熟悉两种语法都是有价值的，因为程序员在不同场合可能会遇到其中任何一种。 x86 architectures typically follow one of two different syntax branches. UNIX machines commonly use the AT&T syntax, given that UNIX was developed at AT&T Bell Labs. The corresponding assembler is GNU Assembler (GAS). Since we use GCC for most examples in this book, we cover AT&T syntax in this chapter. Windows machines commonly use Intel syntax, which is used by Microsoft’s Macro Assembler (MASM). The Netwide Assembler (NASM) is an example of a Linux assembler that uses Intel syntax. The argument regarding the superiority of one syntax over the other is one of the “holy wars” of the discipline. However, there is value in being familiar with both syntaxes, as a programmer may encounter either in various circumstances.

x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C8-IA32/basics.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 8.1. Diving into Assembly: Basics 为了初步了解汇编，我们修改本章开头的 adder 函数，简化它的行为。修改后的函数（ adder2 ）如下： For a first look at assembly, we modify the adder function from the beginning of the chapter to simplify its behavior. Here’s the modified function ( adder2 ): #include <stdio.h> //adds two to an integer and returns the result int adder2(int a) { return a + 2; } int main(void) { int x = 40; x = adder2(x); printf("x is: %d\n", x); return 0; } 要编译这段代码，使用以下命令： To compile this code, use the following command: $ gcc -m32 -o modified modified.c -m32 选项告诉 GCC 把代码编译成 32 位可执行文件。忘了加这个选项，得到的汇编可能与本章所示的大相径庭；GCC 默认编译成 x86-64 汇编，即 x86 的 64 位变体。不过，几乎所有 64 位体系结构都有一个用于向后兼容的 32 位运行模式。本章介绍 IA32；其他章节介绍 x86-64 和 ARM。尽管年代久远，IA32 对于理解程序如何工作以及如何优化代码仍然非常有用。 The -m32 flag tells GCC to compile the code to a 32-bit executable. Forgetting to include this flag may result in assembly that is wildly different from the examples shown in this chapter; by default, GCC compiles to x86-64 assembly, the 64-bit variant of x86. However, virtually all 64-bit architectures have a 32-bit operating mode for backward compatibility. This chapter covers IA32; other chapters cover x86-64 and ARM. Despite its age, IA32 is still extremely useful for understanding how programs work and how to optimize code. 接下来，输入以下命令查看这段代码对应的汇编： Next, let’s view the corresponding assembly of this code by typing the following command: $ objdump -d modified > output $ less output 用 less 查看文件 output 时，输入 /adder2 搜索与 adder2 相关的代码片段。与 adder2 相关的部分应该类似下面这样： Search for the code snippet associated with adder2 by typing /adder2 while examining the file output using less . The section associated with adder2 should look similar to the following: adder2 函数的汇编输出 Assembly output for the adder2 function 0804840b <adder2>: 804840b: 55 push %ebp 804840c: 89 e5 mov %esp,%ebp 804840e: 8b 45 08 mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax 8048411: 83 c0 02 add $0x2,%eax 8048414: 5d pop %ebp 8048415: c3 ret 如果你还不明白这是怎么回事，不必担心。我们会在后面的小节中更详细地介绍汇编。目前，我们先来研究一下这些单独指令的结构。 Don’t worry if you don’t understand what’s going on just yet. We will cover assembly in greater detail in later sections. For now, we will study the structure of these individual instructions. 上例中的每一行都包含一条指令在程序内存中的地址、与这条指令对应的字节，以及指令本身的文本表示。例如， 55 是指令 push %ebp 的机器码表示，这条指令位于程序内存中的地址 0x804840b 处。 Each line in the preceding example contains an instruction’s address in program memory, the bytes corresponding to the instruction, and the plaintext representation of the instruction itself. For example, 55 is the machine code representation of the instruction push %ebp , and the instruction occurs at address 0x804840b in program memory. 译注 0x08048000 一带是非 PIE 的 32 位 x86 Linux 程序的传统加载地址。与第 7 章的译注一样，较新的 GCC 和发行版默认生成位置无关可执行文件（PIE），你用 objdump 看到的多半是从很小的值开始的相对地址，函数开头也可能多出 endbr32 等指令，不影响理解。 要注意，一行 C 代码常常会被翻译成多条汇编指令。运算 a + 2 用 mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax 和 add $0x2, %eax 两条指令表示。 It is important to note that a single line of C code often translates to multiple instructions in assembly. The operation a + 2 is represented by the two instructions mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax and add $0x2, %eax . 原书警示 · 你的汇编可能看起来不一样！（Your assembly may look different!） 如果你一边读一边跟着编译代码，可能会注意到你得到的一些汇编示例与书中所示的不同。任何编译器输出的确切汇编指令，都取决于编译器的版本和底层的操作系统。本书中的大多数汇编示例是在运行 Ubuntu 或红帽企业版 Linux（RHEL）的系统上生成的。 在接下来的示例中，我们不使用任何优化选项。例如，编译任何示例文件（ example.c ）都使用命令 gcc -m32 -o example example.c 。因此，接下来的示例中会有许多看似多余的指令。记住，编译器并不「聪明」——它只是遵循一系列规则，把人类可读的代码翻译成机器语言。在这个翻译过程中，出现一些冗余并不罕见。优化编译器在优化过程中会去掉许多这样的冗余，我们会在 后面的章节 中介绍优化。 If you are compiling your code along with us, you may notice that some of your assembly examples look different from what is shown in this book. The precise assembly instructions that are output by any compiler depend on that compiler’s version and the underlying operating system. Most of the assembly examples in this book were generated on systems running Ubuntu or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). In the examples that follow, we do not use any optimization flags. For example, we compile any example file ( example.c ) using the command gcc -m32 -o example example.c . Consequently, there are many seemingly redundant instructions in the examples that follow. Remember that the compiler is not “smart” — it simply follows a series of rules to translate human-readable code into machine language. During this translation process, it is not uncommon for some redundancy to occur. Optimizing compilers remove many of these redundancies during optimization, which is covered in a later chapter . 8.1.1. 寄存器 8.1.1. Registers 回想一下， 寄存器 是直接位于 CPU 上的、字大小的存储单元。可能会有分别用于数据、指令和地址的寄存器。例如，Intel CPU 共有八个用于存储 32 位数据的寄存器： Recall that a register is a word-sized storage unit located directly on the CPU. There may be separate registers for data, instructions, and addresses. For example, the Intel CPU has a total of eight registers for storing 32-bit data: %eax 、 %ebx 、 %ecx 、 %edx 、 %edi 、 %esi 、 %esp 和 %ebp 。 %eax , %ebx , %ecx , %edx , %edi , %esi , %esp , and %ebp . 程序可以读写全部八个寄存器。前六个寄存器都存放通用数据，而后两个通常由编译器保留，用来存放地址数据。尽管程序可能会把通用寄存器的内容解释为整数或地址，但寄存器本身并不加以区分。后两个寄存器（ %esp 和 %ebp ）分别称为 栈指针 （stack pointer）和 帧指针 （frame pointer）。编译器把这两个寄存器保留给维护程序栈布局的操作。通常， %esp 指向程序栈的栈顶，而 %ebp 指向当前栈帧的底部。我们会在讨论 函数 时更详细地介绍栈帧和这两个寄存器。 Programs can read from or write to all eight of these registers. The first six registers all hold general-purpose data, whereas the last two are typically reserved by the compiler to hold address data. While a program may interpret a general-purpose register’s contents as integers or as addresses, the register itself makes no distinction. The last two registers ( %esp and %ebp ) are known as the stack pointer and the frame pointer , respectively. The compiler reserves these registers for operations that maintain the layout of the program stack. Typically, %esp points to the top of the program stack, whereas %ebp points to the base of the current stack frame. We discuss stack frames and these two registers in greater detail in our discussion on functions . 最后一个值得一提的寄存器是 %eip ，即 指令指针 （instruction pointer），有时也称为 程序计数器 （PC）。它指向 CPU 要执行的下一条指令。与前面提到的八个寄存器不同，程序不能直接写寄存器 %eip 。 The last register worth mentioning is %eip or the instruction pointer , sometimes called the program counter (PC). It points to the next instruction to be executed by the CPU. Unlike the eight registers mentioned previously, programs cannot write directly to register %eip . 8.1.2. 寄存器的进阶记法 8.1.2. Advanced Register Notation 对于前面提到的前六个寄存器，ISA 提供了访问每个寄存器低 16 位的机制。对于其中前四个寄存器，ISA 还另外提供了访问其低 16 位中各个 8 位部分的机制。 表 1 列出了这六个寄存器，以及（如果有的话）访问其组成字节的 ISA 机制。 For the first six registers mentioned, the ISA provides a mechanism to access the lower 16 bits of each register. The ISA also provides a separate mechanism to access the 8-bit components of the lower 16 bits of the first four of these registers. Table 1 lists each of the six registers and the ISA mechanisms (if available) to access their component bytes. 表 1. x86 寄存器及访问其低位字节的方式 Table 1. x86 Registers and Mechanisms for Accessing Lower Bytes. 32 位寄存器（第 31–0 位） 低 16 位（第 15–0 位） 第 15–8 位 第 7–0 位 %eax %ax %ah %al %ebx %bx %bh %bl %ecx %cx %ch %cl %edx %dx %dh %dl %edi %di %esi %si 32-bit register (bits 31-0) Lower 16 bits (bits 15-0) Bits 15-8 Bits 7-0 %eax %ax %ah %al %ebx %bx %bh %bl %ecx %cx %ch %cl %edx %dx %dh %dl %edi %di %esi %si 要访问上述任一寄存器的低 16 位，就取寄存器名的最后两个字母。例如，用 %ax 访问 %eax 的低 16 位。 The lower 16 bits for any of the aforementioned registers can be accessed by referencing the last two letters in the register’s name. For example, use %ax to access the lower 16 bits of %eax . 要访问前四个寄存器低 16 位中的 高 字节和 低 字节，就取寄存器名的最后两个字母，并根据想要哪个字节，把最后一个字母换成 h （表示 高 ）或 l （表示 低 ）。例如， %al 引用寄存器 %ax 的低八位，而 %ah 引用寄存器 %ax 的高八位。编译器常用这些八位寄存器在某些运算中存放单字节的值，比如移位（32 位寄存器移位不能超过 32 位，而数字 32 只需要一个字节就能存下）。一般来说，编译器会使用完成运算所需的最小的组成部分寄存器。 The higher and lower bytes within the lower 16 bits of the first four listed registers can be accessed by taking the last two letters of the register name and replacing the last letter with either an h (for higher ) or an l (for lower ) depending on which byte is desired. For example, %al references the lower eight bits of register %ax , whereas %ah references the higher eight bits of register %ax . These eight bit registers are commonly used by the compiler for storing single-byte values for certain operations, such as bitwise shifts (a 32-bit register cannot be shifted more than 32 places and the number 32 requires only a single byte of storage). In general, the compiler will use the smallest component register needed to complete an operation. 8.1.3. 指令的结构 8.1.3. Instruction Structure 每条指令由一个指明它做什么的操作码（ opcode ）和一个或多个告诉指令如何去做的 操作数 （operand）组成。例如，指令 add $0x2, %eax 的操作码是 add ，操作数是 $0x2 和 %eax 。 Each instruction consists of an operation code (or opcode ) that specifies what it does, and one or more operands that tell the instruction how to do it. For example, the instruction add $0x2, %eax has the opcode add and the operands $0x2 and %eax . 每个操作数对应于某个特定运算的源位置或目标位置。操作数有多种类型： Each operand corresponds to a source or destination location for a specific operation. There are multiple types of operands: 常数（字面量） 值前面带有 $ 符号。例如，在指令 add $0x2, %eax 中， $0x2 是一个字面值，对应于十六进制值 0x2。 Constant (literal) values are preceded by the $ sign. For example in the instruction add $0x2, %eax , $0x2 is a literal value that corresponds to the hexadecimal value 0x2. 寄存器 形式指单个寄存器。指令 add $0x2, %eax 指定寄存器 %eax 为目标位置， add 运算的结果将存放在那里。 Register forms refer to individual registers. The instruction add $0x2, %eax specifies register %eax as the destination location where the result %of the add operation will be stored. 内存 形式对应于主存（RAM）中的某个值，常用于地址查找。内存地址形式可以包含寄存器和常数值的组合。例如，在指令 mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax 中，操作数 0x8(%ebp) 就是内存形式的一个例子。它大致可以翻译为：「把 0x8 加到寄存器 %ebp 中的值上，然后执行一次内存查找」。如果这听起来像是指针解引用，那是因为它就是！ Memory forms correspond to some value inside main memory (RAM) and are commonly used for address lookups. Memory address forms can contain a combination of registers and constant values. For example, in the instruction mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax , the operand 0x8(%ebp) is an example of a memory form. It loosely translates to “add 0x8 to the value in register %ebp , and then perform a memory lookup.” If this sounds like a pointer dereference, that’s because it is! 8.1.4. 一个关于操作数的例子 8.1.4. An Example with Operands 详细解释操作数的最好方式是举一个简短的例子。假设内存中包含以下值： The best way to explain operands in detail is to present a quick example. Each row of the table matches an operand with its form (e.g. constant, register, memory), how it is translated, and its value. Note that the notation M[x] in this context denotes the value at the memory location specified by address x. 表 2. 操作数示例 Table 2. Example operands 操作数 形式 含义 值 %ecx 寄存器 %ecx 0x4 (%eax) 内存 M[%eax] 即 M[0x804] 0xCA $0x808 常数 0x808 0x808 0x808 内存 M[0x808] 0xFD 0x8(%eax) 内存 M[%eax + 8] 即 M[0x80c] 0x12 (%eax, %ecx) 内存 M[%eax + %ecx] 即 M[0x808] 0xFD 0x4(%eax, %ecx) 内存 M[%eax + %ecx + 4] 即 M[0x80c] 0x12 0x800(,%edx,4) 内存 M[0x800 + %edx*4] 即 M[0x804] 0xCA (%eax, %edx, 8) 内存 M[%eax + %edx*8] 即 M[0x80c] 0x12 Operand Form Translation Value %ecx Register %ecx 0x4 (%eax) Memory M[%eax] or M[0x804] 0xCA $0x808 Constant 0x808 0x808 0x808 Memory M[0x808] 0xFD 0x8(%eax) Memory M[%eax + 8] or M[0x80c] 0x12 (%eax, %ecx) Memory M[%eax + %ecx] or M[0x808] 0xFD 0x4(%eax, %ecx) Memory M[%eax + %ecx + 4] or M[0x80c] 0x12 0x800(,%edx,4) Memory M[0x800 + %edx*4] or M[0x804] 0xCA (%eax, %edx, 8) Memory M[%eax + %edx*8] or M[0x80c] 0x12 在 表 2 中，记号 %ecx 表示寄存器 %ecx 中存放的值。与之不同，M[ %eax ] 表示应当把 %eax 中的值当作一个地址，并对它解引用（查找该地址处的值）。因此，操作数 (%eax) 对应于 M[0x804]，也就是值 0xCA。 In Table 2 , the notation %ecx indicates the value stored in register %ecx . Real World: Buffer Overflow C 语言不会自动做数组越界检查。访问数组边界以外的内存是有问题的，常常导致段错误之类的错误。然而，聪明的攻击者可以注入恶意代码，故意越过数组（也称为 缓冲区 ，buffer）的边界，迫使程序以非预期的方式执行。在最坏的情况下，攻击者可以运行代码获得 root 权限 ，也就是对计算机系统的操作系统级访问权。利用程序中已知的缓冲区越界错误来达到目的的软件，称为 缓冲区溢出攻击 （buffer overflow exploit）。 The C language does not perform automatic array bounds checking. Accessing memory outside of the bounds of an array is problematic and often results in errors such as segmentation faults. However, a clever attacker can inject malicious code that intentionally overruns the boundary of an array (also known as a buffer ) to force the program to execute in an unintended manner. In the worst cases, the attacker can run code that allows them to gain root privilege , or OS-level access to the computer system. A piece of software that takes advantage of the existence of a known buffer overrun error in a program is known as a buffer overflow exploit . 本节我们使用 GDB 和汇编语言，完整剖析缓冲区溢出攻击的机制。阅读本章之前，建议先看看讲解 用 GDB 检查汇编代码 的那一章。 In this section, we use GDB and assembly language to fully characterize the mechanics of a buffer overflow exploit. Prior to reading this chapter we encourage you to explore the chapter discussing GDB for inspecting assembly code . 8.10.1. 著名的缓冲区溢出案例 8.10.1. Famous Examples of Buffer Overflow 缓冲区溢出攻击出现于 20 世纪 80 年代，直到 21 世纪头几年一直是计算机行业的头号祸害。虽然许多现代操作系统已经能防御最简单的缓冲区溢出攻击，但粗心的编程错误仍然可能让现代程序门户大开。最近在 Skype 1 、Android 2 、Google Chrome 3 等软件中都发现过缓冲区溢出漏洞。 Buffer overflow exploits emerged in the 1980s and remained a chief scourge of the computing industry through the early parts of the 2000s. While many modern operating systems have protections against the simplest buffer overflow attacks, careless programming errors can still leave modern programs wide open to attack. Buffer overflow exploits have recently been discovered in Skype 1 , Android 2 , Google Chrome 3 , and others. 下面是几个著名的历史案例。 Here are some notable historic examples of buffer overflow exploits. 莫里斯蠕虫 （The Morris Worm） 莫里斯蠕虫 4 于 1988 年从 MIT 释放到 ARPANet 上（为的是掩盖它出自康奈尔大学一名学生之手），它利用了 UNIX finger 守护进程（ fingerd ）中的一个缓冲区越界漏洞。在 Linux 和其他类 UNIX 系统中， 守护进程 （daemon）是一类在后台持续运行的进程，通常执行清理和监控任务。 fingerd 守护进程返回关于某台计算机或某个人的友好报告。最要命的是，这个蠕虫的复制机制会把它多次发送到同一台计算机上，把系统拖到无法使用的地步。尽管作者声称这个蠕虫只是一次无害的智力练习，但复制机制让它极易传播，也很难清除。此后多年，还有其他蠕虫利用缓冲区溢出攻击未经授权进入系统，著名的有 Code Red（2001）、MS-SQLSlammer（2003）和 W32/Blaster（2003）。 The Morris Worm The Morris Worm 4 was released in 1988 on ARPANet from MIT (to hide that it was written by a student at Cornell) and exploited a buffer overrun vulnerability that existed in the Unix finger daemon ( fingerd ). In Linux and other Unix-like systems, a daemon is a type of process that continuously executes in the background, usually performing clean-up and monitoring tasks. The fingerd daemon returns a user-friendly report on a computer or person. Most crucially, the worm had a replication mechanism that caused it to be sent to the same computer multiple times, bogging down the system to an unusable state. Although the author claimed that the worm was meant as a harmless intellectual exercise, the replication mechanism enabled the worm to spread easily and made it difficult to remove. In future years, other worms would employ buffer overflow exploits to gain unauthorized access into systems. Notable examples include Code Red (2001), MS-SQLSlammer (2003), and W32/Blaster (2003). AOL 聊天大战 （AOL Chat Wars） 前微软工程师 David Auerbach 5 详细讲述了他在 20 世纪 90 年代末把微软的 Messenger Service（MMS）与 AOL Instant Messenger 打通时遭遇的一次缓冲区溢出。那时，想和亲友即时通信（IM），AOL Instant Messenger（AIM）是 不二之选 。微软想在这个市场站稳脚跟，就在 MMS 中设计了一个功能，让 MMS 用户能和他们的 AIM「好友」聊天。AOL 很不高兴，给服务器打了补丁，让 MMS 无法再连上。微软工程师想出办法让 MMS 客户端模仿 AIM 客户端发给 AOL 服务器的消息，使 AOL 难以区分消息来自 MMS 还是 AIM。AOL 的回应是改变 AIM 发送消息的方式，MMS 工程师则相应地修改客户端消息，使之再次与 AIM 的一致。这场「聊天大战」一直持续，直到 AOL 开始利用 自家客户端里 的一个缓冲区溢出错误来验证发来的消息是否来自 AIM 客户端。由于 MMS 客户端没有同样的漏洞，聊天大战就此结束，AOL 获胜。 AOL Chat Wars David Auerbach 5 , a former Microsoft engineer, detailed his experience with a buffer overflow during his efforts to integrate Microsoft’s Messenger Service (MMS) with AOL Instant Messenger in the late 1990s. Back then, AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) was the service to use if you wanted to instant message (or IM) friends and family. Microsoft tried to gain a foothold in this market by designing a feature in MMS that enabled MMS users to talk to their AIM “buddies.” Displeased, AOL patched their servers so that MMS could no longer connect to them. Microsoft engineers figured out a way for MMS clients to mimic the messages sent by AIM clients to AOL servers, making it difficult for AOL to distinguish between messages received by MMS and AIM. AOL responded by changing the way AIM sent messages, and MMS engineers duly changed their client’s messages to once again match AIM’s. This “chat war” continued until AOL started using a buffer overflow error in their own client to verify that sent messages came from AIM clients. Since MMS clients did not have the same vulnerability, the chat wars ended, with AOL as the victor. 8.10.2. 初探：猜谜游戏 8.10.2. A First Look: The Guessing Game 为了帮助你理解缓冲区溢出攻击的机制，我们提供了一个简单程序的 32 位可执行文件，用户可以和它玩猜谜游戏。在 这个链接 下载 secret 可执行文件，并用 tar 命令解压： To help you understand the mechanism of the buffer overflow attack, we provide a 32-bit executable of a simple program that enables the user to play a guessing game with the program. "); exit(0); } /*main function of the game*/ int main(void) { int guess, secret, len; char buf[12]; //buffer (12 bytes long) printf("Enter secret number:

"); } else { printf("You are so wrong!

The header file other.h contains the definition of the getSecretCode and calculateValue functions, but it is unavailable to us. How then can a user beat the program? Brute forcing the solution will take too long. One strategy is to analyze the secret executable in GDB and step through the assembly to reveal the secret number and string. The process of examining assembly code to reveal knowledge of how it works is commonly referred to as reverse engineering . A sample string that can force secret to execute the endGame function 同样，由于 x86 是 小端 系统，并且栈向低地址方向增长，返回地址中的字节看起来是倒序的。 Again, since x86 is a little endian system in which the stack grows toward lower addresses, the bytes in the return address appear to be in reverse order. 译注 · 为什么是 32 字节 main 开头执行了 sub $0x38,%esp ，所以 %esp = %ebp - 0x38； buf 位于 0x1c(%esp) ，也就是 %ebp - 0x1c。从 buf 起始处到保存的 %ebp 有 28 字节，再加上保存的 %ebp 本身 4 字节，共 32 字节，紧接着就是返回地址。这正是下面程序中 30 + 2 字节的垃圾值。 下面的程序演示了攻击者可以如何构造前面那个攻击字符串： The following program illustrates how an attacker could construct the preceding exploit: #include <stdio.h> char ebuff[]= "\x31\x32\x33\x34\x35\x36\x37\x38\x39\x30" /*first 10 bytes of junk*/ "\x31\x32\x33\x34\x35\x36\x37\x38\x39\x30" /*next 10 bytes of junk*/ "\x31\x32\x33\x34\x35\x36\x37\x38\x39\x30" /*following 10 bytes of junk*/ "\x31\x32" /*last 2 bytes of junk*/ "\x64\x85\x04\x08" /*address of endGame (little endian)*/ ; int main(void) { int i; for (i = 0; i < sizeof(ebuff); i++) { /*print each character*/ printf("%c", ebuff[i]); } return 0; } 每个数字前面的 \x 表示该数字是一个字符的十六进制表示。定义了 ebuff[] 之后， main 函数只是逐个字符地把它打印出来。要得到对应的字节串，像下面这样编译并运行这个程序： The \x before each number indicates that the number is formatted as the hexadecimal representation of a character. Common Instructions 本节讨论几条常用的 x86 汇编指令。 表 1 列出了 x86 汇编中最基础的指令。 In this section, we discuss several common x86 assembly instructions. Table 1 lists the most foundational instructions in x86 assembly. 表 1. 最常用的指令 Table 1. Most Common Instructions 指令 含义 mov S, D S → D（把 S 的值复制到 D） add S, D S + D → D（把 S 加到 D 上，结果存入 D） sub S, D D - S → D（ 从 D 中减去 S，结果存入 D） Instruction Translation mov S, D S → D (copies value of S into D) add S, D S + D → D (adds S to D and stores result in D) sub S, D D - S → D (subtracts S from D and stores result in D) 因此，指令序列 Therefore, the sequence of instructions mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax add $0x2,%eax 的含义是： translates to: 把 内存 中位置 %ebp + 0x8 处的值（即 M[ %ebp + 0x8]）复制到寄存器 %eax 。 Copy the value at location %ebp + 0x8 in memory (or M[ %ebp + 0x8]) to register %eax . 把值 0x2 加到寄存器 %eax 上，结果存入寄存器 %eax 。 Add the value 0x2 to register %eax , and store the result in register %eax . 表 1 中的三条指令也是维护程序栈（即 调用栈 ，call stack）组织结构的那些指令的构建基础。回想一下，寄存器 %ebp 和 %esp 分别指 帧 指针和 栈 指针，由编译器保留用于调用栈管理。回想我们之前对 程序内存 的讨论：调用栈存放局部变量和参数，并帮助程序跟踪自身的执行（见 图 1 ）。 The three instructions shown in Table 1 also form the building blocks for instructions that maintain the organization of the program stack (i.e., the call stack ). Recall that registers %ebp and %esp refer to the frame pointer and stack pointer, respectively, and are reserved by the compiler for call stack management. Recall from our earlier discussion on program memory that the call stack stores local variables and parameters and helps the program track its own execution (see Figure 1 ). 图 1. 程序地址空间的组成部分 Figure 1. The parts of a program’s address space 在 IA32 系统上，执行栈向 低 地址方向增长。和所有栈数据结构一样，操作都发生在栈的「顶部」。x86 ISA 提供了两条指令（ 表 2 ）来简化调用栈的管理。 On IA32 systems, the execution stack grows toward lower addresses. Like all stack data structures, operations occur at the “top” of the stack. The x86 ISA provides two instructions ( Table 2 ) to simplify call stack management. 表 2. 栈管理指令 Table 2. Stack Management Instructions 指令 Instruction push S push S 含义 Translation 把 S 的一个副本压到栈顶。等价于： Pushes a copy of S onto the top of the stack. Equivalent to: sub $4, %esp mov S, (%esp) 指令 Instruction pop D pop D 含义 Translation 从栈顶弹出元素，并把它放到位置 D 中。等价于： Pops the top element off the stack and places it in location D . Equivalent to: mov (%esp), D add $4, %esp 注意， 表 1 中的三条指令需要两个操作数，而 表 2 中的 push 和 pop 指令各只需要一个操作数。 Notice that while the three instructions in [Basic] require two operands, the push and pop instructions in [Stack] require only one operand apiece. 译注 原书网页此处的两个交叉引用渲染成了 [Basic] 和 [Stack] ，指的就是本节的表 1 和表 2。 8.2.1. 综合运用：一个更具体的例子 8.2.1. Putting It All Together: A More Concrete Example 我们来仔细看看 adder2 函数： Let’s take a closer look at the adder2 function: //adds two to an integer and returns the result int adder2(int a) { return a + 2; } 以及它对应的汇编代码： and its corresponding assembly code: 0804840b <adder2>: 804840b: 55 push %ebp 804840c: 89 e5 mov %esp,%ebp 804840e: 8b 45 08 mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax 8048411: 83 c0 02 add $0x2,%eax 8048414: 5d pop %ebp 8048415: c3 ret 这段汇编代码由一条 push 指令、随后的两条 mov 指令、一条 add 指令、一条 pop 指令，以及最后一条 ret 指令组成。要理解 CPU 如何执行这组指令，我们需要重温 程序内存 的结构。回想一下，程序每次执行时，操作系统都会为新程序分配地址空间（也称为 虚拟内存 ）。 虚拟内存 以及与之相关的 进程 概念会在第 13 章中详细介绍；目前，只需把进程看作正在运行的程序的抽象，把虚拟内存看作分配给单个进程的内存。每个进程都有自己的一块称为 调用栈 的内存区域。记住，调用栈位于进程/虚拟内存中，这与寄存器（位于 CPU 上）不同。 The assembly code consists of a push instruction, followed by a couple of mov instructions, an add instruction, a pop instruction, and finally a ret instruction. To understand how the CPU executes this set of instructions, we need to revisit the structure of program memory . Recall that every time a program executes, the operating system allocates the new program’s address space (also known as virtual memory ). Virtual memory and the related concept of processes are covered in greater detail in chapter 13; for now, it suffices to think of a process as the abstraction of a running program and virtual memory as the memory that is allocated to a single process. Every process has its own region of memory called the call stack . Keep in mind that the call stack is located in process/virtual memory, unlike registers (which are located on the CPU). 图 2 描绘了执行 adder2 函数之前调用栈和寄存器的一个示例状态。 Figure 2 depicts a sample state of the call stack and registers prior to the execution of the adder2 function. 图 2. 执行之前的执行栈 Figure 2. Execution stack prior to execution 注意，栈向 低 地址方向增长。寄存器 %eax 和 %edx 当前存放的是垃圾值。为了让图更易读，程序内存代码段中各条指令的地址（0x804840b–0x8048415）被缩写为 0x40b–0x415。同样，程序内存调用栈段的地址从 0xffffd108–0xffffd110 缩写为 0x108–0x110。实际上，调用栈地址在程序内存中位于比代码段地址更高的位置。 Notice that the stack grows toward lower addresses. Registers %eax and %edx currently contain junk values. The addresses associated with the instructions in the code segment of program memory (0x804840b-0x8048415) have been shortened to (0x40b-0x415) to improve figure readability. Likewise, the addresses associated with the call stack segment of program memory have been shortened to 0x108-0x110 from 0xffffd108-0xffffd110. In truth, call stack addresses occur at higher addresses in program memory than code segment addresses. 请留意寄存器 %esp 和 %ebp 的初始值（虚构的）：它们分别是 0x10c 和 0x12a 。调用栈当前在栈地址 0x110 处存放着值 0x28 （即 40 ）（它为什么、又是如何出现在这里的，我们会在讨论 函数 时介绍）。下面各图中左上角的箭头直观地标出当前正在执行的指令。 %eip 寄存器（即指令指针）显示下一条要执行的指令。最初， %eip 存放的是地址 0x40b ，对应于 adder2 函数中的第一条指令。 Pay close attention to the initial (made up) values of registers %esp and %ebp : they are 0x10c and 0x12a , respectively. The call stack currently has the value 0x28 (or 40 ) at stack address 0x110 (why and how this got here will be covered in our discussion on functions ). The upper-left arrow in the following figures visually indicates the currently executing instruction. The %eip register (or instruction pointer) shows the next instruction to execute. Initially, %eip contains address 0x40b which corresponds to the first instruction in the adder2 function. 第一条指令（ push %ebp ）把 %ebp 中值的一个副本（即 0x12a）放到栈顶。它执行之后， %eip 寄存器前进到下一条要执行的指令的地址（即 0x40c）。 push 指令把栈指针减 4（让栈「增长」4 个字节），得到新的 %esp 值 0x108 。回想一下， push %ebp 指令等价于： The first instruction ( push %ebp ) places a copy of the value in %ebp (or 0x12a) on top of the stack. After it executes, the %eip register advances to the address of the next instruction to execute (or 0x40c). The push instruction decrements the stack pointer by 4 (“growing” the stack by 4 bytes), resulting in a new %esp value of 0x108 . Recall that the push %ebp instruction is equivalent to: sub $4, %esp mov %ebp, (%esp) 换句话说，就是把栈指针减 4，再把 %ebp 内容的一个副本放到对栈指针解引用所指向的位置 (%esp) 。 In other words, subtract 4 from the stack pointer and place a copy of the contents of %ebp in the location pointed to by the dereferenced stack pointer, (%esp) . 回想一下， mov 指令的结构是 mov S,D ，其中 S 是源位置， D 是目标位置。因此，下一条指令（ mov %esp, %ebp ）把 %ebp 的值更新为 0x108。寄存器 %eip 前进到下一条要执行的指令的地址，即 0x40e。 Recall that the structure of the mov instruction is mov S,D , where S is the source location, and D is the destination. Thus, the next instruction ( mov %esp, %ebp ) updates the value of %ebp to 0x108. The register %eip advances to the address of the next instruction to execute, or 0x40e. 接下来执行 mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax 。这条指令比上一条 mov 指令要复杂一些。我们参照上一节的操作数表来解析它。首先， 0x8(%ebp) 翻译为 M[ %ebp + 0x8]。由于 %ebp 存放的值是 0x108，加上 8 得到 0x110。在 0x110 处执行一次（栈）内存查找，得到值 0x28（回想一下，0x28 是之前的代码放到栈上的）。于是，值 0x28 被复制到寄存器 %eax 中。指令指针前进到地址 0x411，即下一条要执行的指令的地址。 Next, mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax is executed. This is a bit more complicated than the last mov instruction. Let’s parse it by consulting the operand table from the previous section. First, 0x8(%ebp) translates to M[ %ebp + 0x8]. Function labels tend to be global and usually consist of the function name and a colon. For example, main: (or <main>: ) is used to label a user-defined main function. By convention, labels whose scope are local are preceded by a period. One may encounter a local label with a name like .L1 in the context of an if statement or loop. 所有标签都有一个对应的地址。当 CPU 执行 jmp 指令时，它修改 %eip ，使其反映标签 L 所指定的程序地址。编写汇编的程序员也可以用 jmp * 指令指定一个要跳转到的具体地址。有时，局部标签显示为相对于函数起始处的偏移量。因此，地址距离 main 起始处 28 字节的指令可能用标签 <main+28> 表示。 All labels have an associated address. When the CPU executes a jmp instruction, it modifies %eip to reflect the program address specified by label L . A programmer writing assembly can also specify a particular address to jump to using the jmp * instruction. Sometimes, local labels are shown as an offset from the start of a function. Therefore, an instruction whose address is 28 bytes away from the start of main may be represented with the label <main+28> . 例如，指令 jmp 0x8048427 <main+28> 表示跳转到地址 0x8048427，与之关联的标签是 <main+28> ，表示它距离 main 函数的起始地址 28 字节。执行这条指令会把 %eip 设为 0x8048427。 For example, the instruction jmp 0x8048427 <main+28> indicates a jump to address 0x8048427, which has the associated label <main+28> , representing that it is 28 bytes away from the starting address of the main function. Executing this instruction sets %eip to 0x8048427. 条件跳转指令 Conditional jump instructions 条件跳转指令的行为取决于 cmp 指令设置的条件码寄存器。 表 4 列出了常用的条件跳转指令。每条指令都以字母 j 开头，表示它是一条跳转指令。每条指令的后缀表示跳转的 条件 。跳转指令的后缀还决定了把数值比较解释为有符号还是无符号。 The behavior of conditional jump instructions depends on the condition code registers set by the cmp instruction. Table 4 lists the set of common conditional jump instructions. Each instruction starts with the letter j denoting that it is a jump instruction. The suffix of each instruction indicates the condition for the jump. The jump instruction suffixes also determine whether to interpret numerical comparisons as signed or unsigned. 表 4. 条件跳转指令；括号中为同义指令 Table 4. Conditional Jump Instructions; Synonyms Shown in Parentheses 有符号比较 无符号比较 说明 je ( jz ) 相等（==）或为零时跳转 jne ( jnz ) 不相等（!=）时跳转 js 为负时跳转 jns 非负时跳转 jg ( jnle ) ja ( jnbe ) 大于（>）时跳转 jge ( jnl ) jae ( jnb ) 大于等于（>=）时跳转 jl ( jnge ) jb ( jnae ) 小于（<）时跳转 jle ( jng ) jbe ( jna ) 小于等于（<=）时跳转 Signed Comparison Unsigned Comparison Description je ( jz ) jump if equal (==) or jump if zero jne ( jnz ) jump if not equal (!=) js jump if negative jns jump if non-negative jg ( jnle ) ja ( jnbe ) jump if greater (>) jge ( jnl ) jae ( jnb ) jump if greater than or equal (>=) jl ( jnge ) jb ( jnae ) jump if less (<) jle ( jng ) jbe ( jna ) jump if less than or equal (<=) 与其死记这些不同的条件跳转指令，不如把指令后缀「读出来」更有帮助。 表 5 列出了跳转指令中常见的字母及其对应的单词。 Instead of memorizing these different conditional jump instructions, it is more helpful to sound out the instruction suffixes. Table 5 lists the letters commonly found in jump instructions and their word correspondence. 表 5. 跳转指令后缀 Table 5. Jump Instruction Suffixes. 字母 单词 j jump（跳转） n not（不） e equal（等于） s signed（有符号，指符号位为负） g greater（大于，有符号解释） l less（小于，有符号解释） a above（高于，无符号解释） b below（低于，无符号解释） Letter Word j jump n not e equal s signed g greater (signed interpretation) l less (signed interpretation) a above (unsigned interpretation) b below (unsigned interpretation) 这样读出来，就能看出 jg 对应于 jump greater （大于则跳转），它的有符号同义指令 jnl 代表 jump not less （不小于则跳转）。同样，无符号版本 ja 代表 jump above （高于则跳转），它的同义指令 jnbe 代表 jump not below or equal （不低于也不等于则跳转）。 Sounding it out, we can see that jg corresponds to jump greater and that its signed synonym jnl stands for jump not less . Likewise, the unsigned version ja stands for jump above , while its synonym jnbe stands for jump not below or equal . 译注 与第 7 章相同的笔误：按上面的表 4， jg 的同义指令是 jnle （jump not less or equal，不小于等于则跳转）； jnl （不小于则跳转）是 jge 的同义指令。 如果把指令读出来，就有助于理解为什么某些同义指令对应于特定的指令。另一件要记住的事是：术语 greater （大于）和 less （小于）指示 CPU 把数值比较解释为有符号值，而 above （高于）和 below （低于）表示数值比较是无符号的。 If you sound out the instructions, it helps to explain why certain synonyms correspond to particular instructions. The other thing to remember is that the terms greater and less instruct the CPU to interpret the numerical comparison as a signed value, whereas above and below indicate that the numerical comparison is unsigned. goto 语句 The goto Statement 在接下来的几个小节中，我们会考察汇编中的条件语句和循环，并把它们逆向还原成 C。把条件语句和循环的汇编代码翻译回 C 时，理解对应的 C 语言 goto 形式会很有帮助。 goto 语句是 C 的一种原语，它强制程序的执行切换到代码中的另一行。与 goto 语句对应的汇编指令是 jmp 。 In the following subsections, we look at conditionals and loops in assembly and reverse engineer them back to C. When translating assembly code of conditionals and loops back into C, it is useful to understand the corresponding C language goto forms. The goto statement is a C primitive that forces program execution to switch to another line in the code. The assembly instruction associated with the goto statement is jmp . goto 语句由 goto 关键字后跟一个 goto 标签 （goto label）组成，goto 标签是一种指明执行应当在哪里继续的程序标签。所以， goto done 表示程序的执行应当跳到标记为 done 的那一行。C 中程序标签的其他例子包括第 2 章介绍过的 switch 语句标签 。 The goto statement consists of the goto keyword followed by a goto label , a type of program label that indicates where execution should continue. So, goto done means that the program execution should jump to the line marked by label done . Other examples of program labels in C include the switch statement labels previously covered in Chapter 2. 表 6. 一个 C 函数与其对应的 goto 形式的比较 Table 6. Comparison of a C function and its associated goto form. 普通的 C 版本 Regular C version int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if ( x > y ) { //if (conditional) smallest = y; //then statement } else { smallest = x; //else statement } return smallest; } goto 版本 Goto version int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x <= y ) { //if (!conditional) goto else_statement; } smallest = y; //then statement goto done; else_statement: smallest = x; //else statement done: return smallest; } 表 6 描绘了用普通 C 代码编写的函数 getSmallest() ，以及它在 C 中对应的 goto 形式。 getSmallest() 函数比较两个整数（ x 和 y ）的值，并把较小的值赋给变量 smallest 。 Table 6 depicts a function getSmallest() written in regular C code and its associated goto form in C. The getSmallest() function compares the value of two integers ( x and y ), and assigns the smaller value to variable smallest . 这个函数的 goto 形式可能显得有违直觉，我们来讨论一下到底发生了什么。条件检查变量 x 是否小于或等于 y 。 The goto form of this function may seem counterintuitive, but let’s discuss what exactly is going on. The conditional checks to see whether variable x is less than or equal to y . 如果 x 小于或等于 y ，程序把控制转移到标记为 else_statement 的标签处，那里只有一条语句 smallest = x 。由于程序是线性执行的，程序接着执行标签 done 下面的代码，返回 smallest 的值（ x ）。 If x is less than or equal to y , the program transfers control to the label marked by else_statement , which contains the single statement smallest = x . Since the program executes linearly, the program continues on to execute the code under the label done , which returns the value of smallest ( x ). 如果 x 大于 y ， smallest 被赋值为 y 。接着程序执行语句 goto done ，把控制转移到 done 标签处，返回 smallest 的值（ y ）。 If x is greater than y , then smallest is assigned the value y . The program then executes the statement goto done , which transfers control to the done label, which returns the value of smallest ( y ). 虽然在编程的早期 goto 语句很常用，但在现代代码中使用 goto 语句被认为是不好的做法，因为它降低了代码整体的可读性。事实上，计算机科学家艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉（Edsger Dijkstra）写过一篇抨击使用 goto 语句的著名文章，题为《 Go To 语句有害论 》（ Go To Statement Considered Harmful ） 1 。 Although goto statements were commonly used in the early days of programming, their use in modern code is considered bad practice, because it reduces the overall readability of code. In fact, computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra wrote a famous paper lambasting the use of goto statements called Go To Statement Considered Harmful 1 . 一般来说，设计良好的 C 程序不使用 goto 语句，程序员也不被鼓励使用它，以免写出难以阅读、调试和维护的代码。不过，理解 C 的 goto 语句很重要，因为 GCC 在把含有条件语句的 C 代码（包括含有 if 语句和循环的代码）翻译成汇编之前，通常会先把它改写成 goto 形式。 In general, well-designed C programs do not use goto statements, and programmers are discouraged from using them to avoid writing code that is difficult to read, debug, and maintain. However, the C goto statement is important to understand, as GCC typically changes C code with conditionals into a goto form prior to translating it to assembly, including code that contains if statements and loops. 接下来的几个小节更详细地介绍 if 语句和循环的汇编表示。 The following subsections cover the assembly representation of if statements and loops in greater detail. if 语句 If Statements 循环 loops 参考文献 References Edsger Dijkstra. “Go To Statement Considered Harmful”. Communications of the ACM 11(3) pp. 147—​148. 1968.
