For convenience, the function is reproduced here. int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if ( x > y ) { smallest = y; } else { smallest = x; } return smallest; } 从 GDB 中取出的对应汇编代码类似下面这样： The corresponding assembly code extracted from GDB looks similar to the following: (gdb) disas getSmallest Dump of assembler code for function getSmallest: 0x8048411 <+6>: mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax 0x8048414 <+9>: cmp 0xc(%ebp),%eax 0x8048417 <+12>: jle 0x8048421 <getSmallest+22> 0x8048419 <+14>: mov 0xc(%ebp),%eax 0x804841f <+20>: jmp 0x8048427 <getSmallest+28> 0x8048421 <+22>: mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax 0x8048427 <+28>: ret 这是一种与我们之前见过的不同的汇编代码视图。在这里，我们能看到每条指令对应的 地址 ，但看不到 字节 。注意，为了简单起见，这段汇编代码经过了少许编辑：去掉了通常属于函数建立/结束的那些指令（即 push %ebp 和 mov %esp, %ebp ）以及在栈上分配空间的指令。按照惯例，GCC 把函数的第一个和第二个参数分别放在位置 %ebp+8 和 %ebp+0xc （即 %ebp+12 ）处。为了清楚起见，我们把这两个参数分别称为 x 和 y 。 This is a different view of the assembly code than we have seen before. Here, we can see the address associated with each instruction, but not the bytes . Note that this assembly segment has been lightly edited for the sake of simplicity. The instructions that are normally part of function creation/termination (i.e., push %ebp and mov %esp, %ebp ) and for allocating space on the stack are removed. By convention, GCC places the first and second parameters of a function at locations %ebp+8 and %ebp+0xc (or %ebp+12 ), respectively. For the sake of clarity, we refer to these parameters as x and y respectively. 我们来跟踪上面这段汇编代码的前几行。注意，在这个例子中我们不会明确地画出栈。我们把它留作读者的练习，鼓励你自己画一画，练习跟踪栈的技能。 Let’s trace through the first few lines of the previous assembly code snippet. Note that we will not draw out the stack explicitly in this example. We leave this as an exercise for the reader, and encourage you to practice your stack tracing skills by drawing it out yourself. mov 指令把位于地址 %ebp+8 处的值（第一个参数 x ）复制到寄存器 %eax 中。指令指针（ %eip ）被设为下一条指令的地址，即 0x08048414。 The mov instruction copies the value located at address %ebp+8 (the first parameter, x ) and places it in register %eax . The instruction pointer ( %eip ) is set to the address of the next instruction, or 0x08048414. cmp 指令把位置 %ebp+12 处的值（第二个参数 y ）与 x 进行比较，并设置相应的条件码标志寄存器。寄存器 %eip 前进到下一条指令的地址，即 0x08048417。 The cmp instruction compares the value at location %ebp+12 (the second parameter, y ) to x and sets appropriate condition code flag registers. Register %eip advances to the address of the next instruction, or 0x08048417. 第三行的 jle 指令表示：如果 x 小于或等于 y ，下一条执行的指令位于 <getSmallest+22> （即 mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax ）， %eip 应当被设为地址 0x8048421；否则， %eip 被设为顺序中的下一条指令，即 0x8048419。 The jle instruction on the third line indicates that if x is less than or equal to y , the next instruction that executes is at location <getSmallest+22> (or mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax ) and that %eip should be set to address 0x8048421. Otherwise, %eip is set to the next instruction in sequence, or 0x8048419. 接下来执行哪些指令，取决于程序在第 3 行（ <getSmallest+12> ）是否走了分支（即是否执行了跳转）。我们先假设 没有 走分支。在这种情况下， %eip 被设为 0x8048419（即 <getSmallest+14> ），接下来执行下面这串指令： The next instructions to execute depend on whether the program follows the branch (i.e., executes the jump) on line 3 ( <getSmallest+12> ). Let’s first suppose that the branch was not followed. In this case, %eip is set to 0x8048419 (i.e., <getSmallest+14> ) and the following sequence of instructions executes: <getSmallest+14> 处的 mov 0xc(%ebp),%eax 指令把 y 复制到寄存器 %eax 。寄存器 %eip 前进到 0x804841f。 The mov 0xc(%ebp),%eax instruction at <getSmallest+14> copies y to register %eax . Register %eip advances to 0x804841f. jmp 指令把寄存器 %eip 设为地址 0x8048427。 The jmp instruction sets register %eip to address 0x8048427. 最后执行的是 ret 指令，表示函数结束。在这种情况下， %eax 中存放的是 y ， getSmallest 返回 y 。 The last instruction to execute is the ret instruction, signifying the end of the function. In this case, %eax contains y , and getSmallest returns y . 现在，假设在 <getSmallest+12> 处走了分支。换句话说， jle 指令把寄存器 %eip 设为 0x8048421（即 <getSmallest+22> ）。那么，接下来执行的指令是： Now, suppose that the branch was taken at <getSmallest+12> . In other words, the jle instruction sets register %eip to 0x8048421 (i.e., <getSmallest+22> ). Then, the next instructions to execute are: 地址 0x8048421 处的 mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax 指令，它把 x 复制到寄存器 %eax 。寄存器 %eip 前进到 0x8048427。 The mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax instruction at address 0x8048421, which copies the x to register %eax . Register %eip advances to 0x8048427. 最后执行的是 ret ，表示函数结束。在这种情况下， %eax 中存放的是 x ， getSmallest 返回 x 。 The last instruction that executes is ret , signifying the end of the function. In this case, %eax contains x , and getSmallest returns x . 于是我们可以这样为上面的汇编加上注释： We can then annotate the preceding assembly as follows: 0x8048411 <+6>: mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax #copy x to %eax 0x8048414 <+9>: cmp 0xc(%ebp),%eax #compare x with y 0x8048417 <+12>: jle 0x8048421 <getSmallest+22> #if x<=y goto<getSmallest+22> 0x8048419 <+14>: mov 0xc(%ebp),%eax #copy y to %eax 0x804841f <+20>: jmp 0x8048427 <getSmallest+28> #goto <getSmallest+28> 0x8048421 <+22>: mov 0x8(%ebp),%eax #copy x to %eax 0x8048427 <+28>: ret #exit function (return %eax) 把它翻译回 C 代码，得到： Translating this back to C code yields: 表 1. 把 getSmallest 翻译成 goto 形式的 C 代码和普通 C 代码 Table 1. Translating getSmallest into goto C form and C code. goto 形式 goto Form int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x <= y) { goto assign_x; } smallest = y; goto done; assign_x: smallest = x; done: return smallest; } 翻译出的 C 代码 Translated C code int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x <= y) { smallest = x; } else { smallest = y; } return smallest; } 在 表 1 中，变量 smallest 对应于寄存器 %eax 。如果 x 小于或等于 y ，代码执行语句 smallest = x ，在这个函数的 goto 形式中，它与 goto 标签 assign_x 相关联。否则，执行语句 smallest = y 。 goto 标签 done 用来表示应当返回 smallest 中的值。 In Table 1 , the variable smallest corresponds to register %eax . If x is less than or equal to y , the code executes the statement smallest = x , which is associated with the goto label assign_x in our goto form of this function. Otherwise, the statement smallest = y is executed. The goto label done is used to indicate that the value in smallest should be returned. 注意，上面由汇编代码翻译出的 C 代码与原来的 getSmallest 函数略有不同。这些差异无关紧要；仔细检查两个函数就会发现，这两个程序在逻辑上是等价的。不过，编译器首先会把任何 if 语句转换成等价的 goto 形式，这就产生了一个略有不同但等价的版本。 表 2 展示了标准的 if 语句格式及其等价的 goto 形式： Notice that the preceding C translation of the assembly code is a bit different from the original getSmallest function. These differences don’t matter; a close inspection of both functions reveals that the two programs are logically equivalent. However, the compiler first converts any if statement into an equivalent goto form, which results in the slightly different, but equivalent, version. Table 2 shows the standard if statement format and its equivalent goto form: 表 2. 标准的 if 语句格式及其等价的 goto 形式 Table 2. Standard if -statement format and its equivalent goto form. C 的 if 语句 C if-statement if (condition) { then_statement; } else { else_statement; } 编译器的等价 goto 形式 Compiler’s equivalent goto form if (!condition) { goto else; } then_statement; goto done; else: else_statement; done: 编译器在把代码翻译成汇编时，指定的是条件为真时跳转。对比一下 if 语句的结构，它是在条件 不 为真时发生「跳转」（跳到 else ）。 goto 形式体现了这一逻辑上的差别。 Compilers translating code into assembly designate a jump when a condition is true. Contrast this behavior with the structure of an if statement, where a “jump” (to the else ) occurs when conditions are not true. The goto form captures this difference in logic. 考虑 getSmallest 函数原来的 goto 翻译，可以看出： Considering the original goto translation of the getSmallest function, we can see that: x <= y 对应于 !condition 。 x <= y corresponds to !condition . smallest = x 是 else_statement 。 smallest = x is the else_statement . smallest = y 这一行是 then_statement 。 The line smallest = y is the then_statement . 函数的最后一行是 return smallest 。 The last line in the function is return smallest . 按照上面的注解改写原来的函数，得到： Rewriting the original version of the function with the preceding annotations yields: int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x > y) { //!(x <= y) smallest = y; //then_statement } else { smallest = x; //else_statement } return smallest; } 这个版本与原来的 getSmallest 函数完全相同。记住，在 C 语言中用不同方式编写的函数，可能会被翻译成同一组汇编指令。 This version is identical to the original getSmallest function. Keep in mind that a function written in different ways in the C language can translate to the same set of assembly instructions. cmov 指令 The cmov Instructions 我们要介绍的最后一组条件指令是 条件传送 （conditional move， cmov ）指令。 cmp 、 test 和 jmp 指令在程序中实现的是 有条件的控制转移 。换句话说，程序的执行会向多个方向分支。这对于优化代码来说可能非常麻烦，因为这些分支的代价很高。 The last set of conditional instructions we cover are conditional move ( cmov ) instructions. The cmp , test , and jmp instructions implement a conditional transfer of control in a program. In other words, the execution of the program branches in many directions. This can be very problematic for optimizing code, because these branches are very expensive. 与之不同， cmov 指令实现的是 有条件的数据传送 。换句话说，条件的 then 语句和 else 语句都会被执行，然后根据条件的结果，把数据放到相应的寄存器中。 In contrast, the cmov instruction implements a conditional transfer of data . In other words, both the then -statement` and else -statement` of the conditional are executed, and the data is placed in the appropriate register based on the result of the condition. 使用 C 的 三元表达式 （ternary expression）常常会使编译器生成 cmov 指令来代替跳转。对于标准的 if-then-else 语句，三元表达式的形式是： The use of C’s ternary expression often results in the compiler generating a cmov instruction in place of jumps. For the standard if-then-else statement, the ternary expression has the form: result = (condition) ? then_statement : else_statement; 我们用这种格式把 getSmallest 函数改写成三元表达式。记住，这个新版本函数的行为与原来的 getSmallest 函数完全相同： Let’s use this format to rewrite the getSmallest function as a ternary expression. Keep in mind that this new version of the function behaves exactly as the original getSmallest function: int getSmallest_cmov(int x, int y) { return x > y ? y : x; } 这看起来也许不是什么大的改动，但我们来看看生成的汇编。回想一下，第一个和第二个参数（ x 和 y ）分别存放在栈地址 %ebp+0x8 和 %ebp+0xc 处。 Although this may not seem like a big change, let’s look at the resulting assembly. Recursion 递归函数是一类特殊的函数，它们调用自身（也称为 自引用 函数，self-referential function）来计算一个值。和非递归的函数一样，递归函数的每次调用都会创建新的栈帧。与标准函数不同的是，递归函数中包含对自身的函数调用。 Recursive functions are a special class of functions that call themselves (also known as self-referential functions) to compute a value. Like their nonrecursive counterparts, recursive functions create new stack frames for each function call. Unlike standard functions, recursive functions contain function calls to themselves. 我们再来看把从 1 到 n 的正整数加起来的问题。在前面的小节中，我们讨论了实现这一任务的 sumUp 函数。 表 1 展示了一个相关的函数 sumDown ，它倒序（从 n 到 1 ）累加这些数，以及与它等价的递归函数 sumr ： Let’s revisit the problem of summing up the set of positive integers from 1 to n . In previous sections, we discussed the sumUp function to achieve this task. Table 1 shows a related function called sumDown , which adds the numbers in reverse ( n to 1 ), and its recursive equivalent sumr : 表 1. 迭代版本（sumDown）与递归版本（sumr） Table 1. Iterative version (sumDown) and recursive version (sumr) 迭代版本 Iterative int sumDown(int n) { int total = 0; int i = n; while (i > 0) { total += i; i--; } return total; } 递归版本 Recursive int sumr(int n) { if (n <= 0) { return 0; } return n + sumr(n-1); } 递归函数 sumr 中的基本情形处理所有小于 1 的 n 值，递归步骤则把 n 的当前值加到以 n-1 调用 sumr 的结果上。用 -m32 选项编译 sumr 并用 GDB 反汇编，得到下面的汇编代码： The base case in the recursive function sumr accounts for any values of n that are less than one, and the recursive step adds the current value of n to the result of the function call to sumr with the value n-1 . Functions in Assembly 在上一节中，我们跟踪了汇编中的一些简单函数。本节在一个较大程序的背景下，讨论汇编中多个函数之间的交互。我们还会介绍一些与函数管理有关的新指令。 In the previous section, we traced through simple functions in assembly. In this section, we discuss the interaction between multiple functions in assembly in the context of a larger program. We also introduce some new instructions involved with function management. 我们先复习一下调用栈是如何管理的。回想一下， %esp 是 栈指针 ，总是指向栈顶。寄存器 %ebp 表示基址指针（也称 帧指针 ），指向当前栈帧的底部。 栈帧 （stack frame，也称 活动帧 或 活动记录 ）指的是栈中分配给单次函数调用的那一部分。当前正在执行的函数总是位于栈顶，它的栈帧称为 活动帧 （active frame）。活动帧的边界由栈指针（在栈顶）和帧指针（在帧底）界定。活动记录中通常存放着函数的局部变量和参数。 Let’s begin with a refresher on how the call stack is managed. Recall that %esp is the stack pointer and always points to the top of the stack. The register %ebp represents the base pointer (also known as the frame pointer ) and points to the base of the current stack frame. The stack frame (also known as the activation frame or the activation record ) refers to the portion of the stack allocated to a single function call. The currently executing function is always at the top of the stack, and its stack frame is referred to as the active frame . The active frame is bounded by the stack pointer (at the top of stack) and the frame pointer (at the bottom of the frame). The activation record typically holds local variables and parameters for a function. 图 1 展示了 main 及其调用的一个名为 fname 的函数的栈帧。我们把 main 函数称为 调用者 （caller）函数，把 fname 称为 被调用者 （callee）函数。 Figure 1 shows the stack frames for main and a function it calls named fname . We will refer to the main function as the caller function and fname as the callee function. 图 1. 栈帧的管理 Figure 1. Stack frame management 在 图 1 中，当前的活动帧属于被调用者函数（ fname ）。栈指针和帧指针之间的内存用于存放局部变量。随着局部值被压入和弹出栈，栈指针会移动。与之不同，帧指针相对保持不变，指向当前栈帧的开头（底部）。因此，像 GCC 这样的编译器通常相对于帧指针来引用栈上的值。在 图 1 中，活动帧的下边界是 fname 的基址指针，即栈地址 0x418。存放在这个地址处的值是「保存的」 %ebp 值（0x42c），它本身表示 main 函数活动帧的底部。 main 活动帧的顶部以 返回地址 （return address）为界，返回地址表示被调用函数执行完毕后， main 从哪个程序地址继续执行。 In Figure 1 , the current active frame belongs to the callee function ( fname ). The memory between the stack pointer and the frame pointer is used for local variables. The stack pointer moves as local values are pushed and popped from the stack. In contrast, the frame pointer remains relatively constant, pointing to the beginning (the bottom) of the current stack frame. As a result, compilers like GCC commonly reference values on the stack relative to the frame pointer. In Figure 1 , the active frame is bounded below by the base pointer of fname , which contains the stack address 0x418. The value stored at this address is the “saved” %ebp value (0x42c), which itself indicates the bottom of the activation frame for the main function. The top of the activation frame of main is bounded by the return address , which indicates the program address at which main resumes execution once the callee function finishes executing. 原书警示 · 返回地址指向代码段内存，而不是栈内存（The return address points to program memory, not stack memory） 回想一下，程序的调用栈区域（栈内存）与其代码区域（代码段内存）是不同的。 %ebp 和 %esp 指向栈内存中的位置，而 %eip 指向 代码 段内存中的位置。换句话说，返回地址是代码段内存中的一个地址，而不是栈内存中的地址： 图示：程序地址空间的组成部分 Recall that the call stack region (stack memory) of a program is different from its code region (code memory). Whereas %ebp and %esp point to locations in the stack memory, %eip points to a location in code memory. In other words, the return address is an address in code memory, not stack memory: Figure 2. Common Function Management Instructions 指令 Instruction leave 含义 Translation 为离开函数准备好栈。等价于： Prepares the stack for leaving a function. Equivalent to: mov %ebp, %esp pop %ebp 指令 Instruction call addr <fname> 含义 Translation 把活动帧切换到被调用者函数。等价于： Switches active frame to callee function. Equivalent to: push %eip mov addr, %eip 指令 Instruction ret 含义 Translation 把活动帧恢复为调用者函数。等价于： Restores active frame to caller function. Equivalent to: pop %eip 例如， leave 指令是编译器在准备离开函数时，用来恢复栈指针和帧指针的简写形式。当被调用函数执行完毕时， leave 确保帧指针被 恢复 为之前的值。 For example, the leave instruction is a shorthand that the compiler uses to restore the stack and frame pointers as it prepares to leave a function. When the callee function finishes execution, leave ensures that the frame pointer is restored to its previous value. call 和 ret 指令在一个函数调用另一个函数的过程中起着重要作用。两条指令都会修改指令指针（寄存器 %eip ）。当调用者函数执行 call 指令时， %eip 的当前值被保存到栈上，作为返回地址，即被调用函数执行完毕后调用者继续执行的程序地址。 call 指令还会用被调用函数的地址替换 %eip 的值。 The call and ret instructions play a prominent role in the process where one function calls another. Both instructions modify the instruction pointer (register %eip ). When the caller function executes the call instruction, the current value of %eip is saved on the stack to represent the return address, or the program address at which the caller resumes executing once the callee function finishes. The call instruction also replaces the value of %eip with the address of the callee function. ret 指令把 %eip 的值恢复为保存在栈上的值，确保程序在调用者函数中指定的程序地址处继续执行。被调用者返回的任何值都存放在 %eax 中。 ret 指令通常是任何函数中执行的最后一条指令。 The ret instruction restores the value of %eip to the value saved on the stack, ensuring that the program resumes execution at the program address specified in the caller function. Any value returned by the callee is stored in %eax . The ret instruction is usually the last instruction that executes in any function. 8.5.1. 跟踪一个例子 8.5.1. The compiler must therefore multiply the index by the size of the data type to compute the correct offset. Recall also that memory is byte-addressable; offsetting by the correct number of bytes is the same as computing an address. 举个例子，考虑一个含有五个整数元素的示例数组（ array ）（ 图 1 ）： As an example, consider a sample array ( array ) with five integer elements ( Figure 1 ): 图 1. 一个五元素整数数组在内存中的布局。每个标为 x i 的方框代表一个字节，每个 int 占四个字节。 Figure 1. The layout of a five-integer array in memory. Each x i -labeled box represents one byte, each int is four bytes. 注意，由于 array 是一个整数数组，每个元素恰好占四个字节。因此，一个含五个元素的整数数组占用 20 字节的连续内存。 Notice that since array is an array of integers, each element takes up exactly four bytes. The operand 0x0(,%eax,4) translates to %eax*4 + 0x0 . Since %eax holds the value i , this operation copies the value i*4 to %edx . At this point, %edx contains the number of bytes that must be added to calculate the correct offset of array[i] . 下一条指令（ mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax ）把第一个参数（ array 的基地址）复制到 %eax 中。下一条指令把 %edx 加到 %eax 上，使 %eax 存放 array+i*4 。回想一下， array 中下标为 i 的元素存放在地址 array + sizeof(T) * i 处。因此， %eax 现在存放的是在汇编层面计算出的地址 &array[i] 。 The next instruction ( mov 0x8(%ebp), %eax ) copies the first argument (the base address of array ) into %eax . Lastly, %eax is added to the value in %ebp-8 , or total . x: 说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C9-ARM64/basics.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 9.1. Diving into Assembly: Basics 为了初步了解汇编，我们修改 汇编入门章节 中的 adder 函数，简化它的行为。修改后的函数（ adder2 ）如下： For a first look at assembly, we modify the adder function from the assembly introduction chapter to simplify its behavior. The modified function ( adder2 ) is shown here: #include <stdio.h> //adds two to an integer and returns the result int adder2(int a) { return a + 2; } int main(void) { int x = 40; x = adder2(x); printf("x is: %d\n", x); return 0; } 要编译这段代码，使用以下命令： To compile this code, use the following command: $ gcc -o adder adder.c 接下来，用 objdump 命令查看这段代码对应的汇编： Next, let’s view the corresponding assembly of this code by using the objdump command: $ objdump -d adder > output $ less output 用 less 查看文件 output 时，输入 /adder 搜索与 adder2 相关的代码片段。与 adder 相关的部分应该类似下面这样： Search for the code snippet associated with adder2 by typing /adder while examining the file output using less . The section associated with adder should look similar to the following: adder2 函数的汇编输出 Assembly output for the adder2 function 0000000000000724 <adder2>: 724: d10043ff sub sp, sp, #0x10 728: b9000fe0 str w0, [sp, #12] 72c: b9400fe0 ldr w0, [sp, #12] 730: 11000800 add w0, w0, #0x2 734: 910043ff add sp, sp, #0x10 738: d65f03c0 ret 如果你还不明白这是怎么回事，不必担心。我们会在后面的小节中更详细地介绍汇编。目前，我们先来研究一下这些单独指令的结构。 Don’t worry if you don’t understand what’s going on just yet. We will cover assembly in greater detail in future sections. For now, let’s study the structure of these individual instructions. 上例中的每一行都包含一条指令在程序内存中的 64 位地址（为节省空间，只保留最低三位数字）、与这条指令对应的字节，以及指令本身的文本表示。例如， d10043ff 是指令 sub sp, sp, #0x10 的机器码表示，这条指令位于代码段内存中的地址 0x724 处。注意， 0x724 是与 sub sp, sp #0x10 指令相关的完整 64 位地址的缩写；为了便于阅读， objdump 省略了前导零。 Each line in the preceding example contains the instruction’s 64-bit address in program memory (shortened to the lowest three digits to save space), the bytes corresponding to the instruction, and the plain-text representation of the instruction itself. For example, d10043ff is the machine code representation of the instruction sub sp, sp, #0x10 , and the instruction occurs at address 0x724 in code memory. Note that 0x724 is an abbreviation of the full 64-bit address associated with the sub sp, sp #0x10 instruction; objdump omits the leading zeros to help with readability. 译注 A64 的每条指令都固定为 4 字节，所以清单中的地址每行恰好加 4（0x724、0x728、0x72c……），这与 x86 的变长指令形成鲜明对比。 要注意，一行 C 代码常常会被翻译成多条汇编指令。运算 a + 2 由代码段内存地址 0x728 到 0x730 处的三条指令表示： str w0, [sp, #12] 、 ldr w0, [sp, #12] 和 add w0, w0, #0x2 。 It is important to note that a single line of C code often translates to multiple instructions in assembly. The operation a + 2 is represented by the three instructions at code memory addresses 0x728 through 0x730 : str w0, [sp, #12] , ldr w0, [sp, #12] , and add w0, w0, #0x2 . 原书警示 · 你的汇编可能看起来不一样！（Your assembly may look different!） 如果你一边读一边跟着编译代码，可能会注意到你得到的一些汇编示例与书中的不同。编译器输出的确切汇编指令，取决于生成它的编译器的版本、具体的体系结构以及底层的操作系统。本章的大多数汇编示例是在运行 64 位 Ubuntu Mate 操作系统的树莓派 3B+ 上用 GCC 生成的。如果你使用不同的操作系统、不同的编译器，或者不同的树莓派或单板计算机，你得到的汇编输出可能会有所不同。 在接下来的示例中，我们不使用任何优化选项。例如，编译任何示例文件（如 example.c ）都使用命令 gcc -o example example.c 。因此，接下来的示例中会有许多看似多余的指令。记住，编译器并不「聪明」——它只是遵循一系列规则，把人类可读的代码翻译成机器语言。在这个翻译过程中，出现一些冗余并不罕见。优化编译器在优化过程中会去掉许多这样的冗余，我们会在 后面的章节 中介绍优化。 If you are compiling your code along with us, you may notice that some of your assembly examples look different. The precise assembly instructions that are output by a compiler depend on the generating compiler’s version, the precise architecture, and the underlying operating system. Most of the assembly examples in this chapter were generated on a Raspberry Pi 3B+ running the 64-bit Ubuntu Mate operating system and using GCC. If you use a different operating system, a different compiler, or a different Raspberry Pi or single-board computer, your assembly output may vary. In the examples that follow, we do not use any optimization flags. For example, we compile any example file (e.g. example.c ) using the command gcc -o example example.c . Consequently, there are many seemingly redundant instructions in the examples that follow. Remember that the compiler is not “smart” — it simply follows a series of rules to translate human-readable code into machine language. During this translation process, it is not uncommon for some redundancy to occur. Optimizing compilers remove many of these redundancies during optimization, which is covered in a later chapter . 9.1.1. 寄存器 9.1.1. Registers 回想一下， 寄存器 是直接位于 CPU 上的、字大小的存储单元。ARMv8 CPU 共有 31 个用于存储 64 位通用数据的寄存器： x0 到 x30 。尽管程序可能会把寄存器的内容解释为整数或地址，但寄存器本身并不加以区分。程序可以读写全部 31 个寄存器。 Recall that a register is a word-sized storage unit located directly on the CPU. The ARMv8 CPU has a total of 31 registers for storing general-purpose 64-bit data: x0 to x30 . Whereas a program may interpret a register’s contents as integers or as addresses, the register itself makes no distinction. Programs can read from or write to all 31 registers. ARMv8-A ISA 还规定了一些专用寄存器。首先值得注意的两个是 栈指针 寄存器（ sp ）和 程序计数器 寄存器（ pc ）。编译器把 sp 寄存器保留给维护程序栈布局的操作。 pc 寄存器指向 CPU 要执行的下一条指令；与其他寄存器不同，程序不能直接写 pc 寄存器。其次， 零寄存器 zr 永远存放值 0，只在作为源寄存器时有用。 The ARMv8-A ISA also specifies special-purpose registers. The first two worth noting are the stack pointer register ( sp ) and the program counter register ( pc ). The compiler reserves the sp register for maintaining the layout of the program stack. The pc register points to the next instruction to be executed by the CPU; unlike the other registers, programs cannot write directly to the pc register. Next, the zero register zr permanently stores the value 0, and is only useful as a source register. 译注 · 零寄存器 在汇编中零寄存器写作 xzr （64 位）或 wzr （32 位）。它也可以出现在目标位置，写入的结果会被直接丢弃：例如比较指令 cmp x0, x1 实际上就是 subs xzr, x0, x1 （只要标志位、扔掉差值）。译者用 Clang 汇编这两条指令，得到的机器码完全相同（ eb01001f ）。 9.1.2. 寄存器的进阶记法 9.1.2. Advanced Register Notation 由于 ARMv8-A 是 32 位 ARMv7-A 体系结构的扩展，A64 ISA 提供了访问每个通用寄存器低 32 位的机制，即 w0 到 w30 。 图 1 展示了寄存器 x0 的一个示例布局。如果把 32 位数据存到组成部分寄存器 w0 中，寄存器的高 32 位就无法访问，并且会被清零。 Since ARMv8-A is an extension of the 32-bit ARMv7-A architecture, the A64 ISA provides mechanisms to access the lower 32 bits of each of the general-purpose registers, or w0 through w30 . Figure 1 shows a sample layout of register x0 . If 32-bit data is stored in component register w0 , then the upper 32 bits of the register become inaccessible, and are zeroed out. 图 1. 寄存器 %x0 的组成部分寄存器布局 Figure 1. Component register layout of register %x0. 原书警示 · 编译器可能会根据类型选用寄存器的组成部分（The compiler may choose component registers depending on type） 阅读汇编代码时要记住，编译器在处理 64 位值（例如指针或 long 类型）时通常使用 64 位寄存器，在处理 32 位类型（例如 int ）时则使用 32 位的组成部分寄存器。在 A64 中，32 位的组成部分寄存器与完整的 64 位寄存器混合使用是非常常见的。例如，在前面的 adder2 函数中，编译器引用的是组成部分寄存器 w0 而不是 x0 ，因为在 64 位系统上 int 类型通常占 32 位（四个字节）。如果 adder2 函数的参数是 long 而不是 int ，编译器就会把 a 存放在寄存器 x0 而不是组成部分寄存器 w0 中。 When reading assembly code, keep in mind that the compiler typically uses the 64-bit registers when dealing with 64-bit values (e.g., pointers or long types) and the 32-bit component registers when dealing with 32-bit types (e.g., int ). In A64, it is very common to see 32-bit component registers intermixed with the full 64-bit registers. For example, in the adder2 function shown earlier, the compiler references component register w0 instead of x0 given that int types typically take up 32 bits (four bytes) of space on 64-bit systems. If the adder2 function had a long parameter instead of an int parameter, the compiler would store a in register x0 instead of component register w0 . 对于之前熟悉 A32 ISA 的读者，需要注意 A32 ISA 中的 32 位通用寄存器 r0 到 r12 映射到 A64 的组成部分寄存器 w0 到 w12 。A64 ISA 可用的寄存器数量是原来的两倍多。 For readers previously familiar with the A32 ISA, it is important to note that the 32-bit general-purpose registers r0 to r12 from the A32 ISA map to the A64 component registers w0 to w12 . The A64 ISA more than doubles the number of available registers. 9.1.3. 指令的结构 9.1.3. Instruction Structure 每条指令由一个指明它做什么的操作码（ opcode ）和一个或多个告诉指令如何去做的 操作数 （operand）组成。大多数 A64 指令通常采用下面的格式： Each instruction consists of an operation code (or opcode ) that specifies what it does, and one or more operands that tells the instruction how to do it. For most A64 instructions, the following format is typically used: opcode D, O1, O2 其中 opcode 是操作码， D 是目标寄存器， O1 是第一个操作数， O2 是第二个操作数。例如，指令 add w0, w0, #0x2 的操作码是 add ，目标寄存器是 w0 ，两个操作数是 w0 和 #0x2 。操作数有多种类型： Where opcode is the operation code, D is the destination register, O1 is the first operand, and O2 the second operand. For example, the instruction add w0, w0, #0x2 has the opcode add , a destination register of w0 , and the two operands w0 and #0x2 . There are multiple types of operands: 译注 注意 ARM 汇编的目标在 前 （ add D, O1, O2 ），与第 7、8 章 x86 的 AT&T 语法（目标在后）正好相反。 常数（字面量） 值前面带有 # 符号。例如，在指令 add w0, w0, #0x2 中，操作数 #0x2 是一个字面值，对应于十六进制值 0x2。 Constant (literal) values are preceded by the # sign. For example, in the instruction add w0, w0, #0x2 , the operand #0x2 is a literal value that corresponds to the hexadecimal value 0x2. 寄存器 形式指单个寄存器。指令 add sp, sp, #0x10 用栈指针寄存器 sp 来指定目标寄存器，以及 add 指令所需两个操作数中的第一个。 Register forms refer to individual registers. The instruction add sp, sp, #0x10 uses the stack pointer register sp to designate the destination register and the first of the two operands needed for the add instruction. 内存 形式对应于主存（RAM）中的某个值，常用于地址查找。内存地址形式可以包含寄存器和常数值的组合。例如，在指令 str w0, [sp, #12] 中，操作数 [sp, #12] 就是内存形式的一个例子。它大致可以翻译为：「把 12 加到寄存器 sp 中的值上，然后对得到的地址执行一次内存查找」。如果这听起来像是指针解引用，那是因为它就是！ Memory forms correspond to some value inside main memory (RAM) and are commonly used for address lookups. Memory address forms can contain a combination of registers and constant values. For example, in the instruction str w0, [sp, #12] , the operand [sp, #12] is an example of a memory form. It loosely translates to “add 12 to the value in register sp , and then perform a memory lookup on the corresponding address.” If this sounds like a pointer dereference, that’s because it is! 9.1.4. 一个关于操作数的例子 9.1.4. An Example with Operands 详细解释操作数的最好方式是举一个简短的例子。假设内存中包含以下值： The best way to explain operands in detail is to present a quick example. Suppose that memory contains the following values: 地址 值 0x804 0xCA 0x808 0xFD 0x80c 0x12 0x810 0x1E Address Value 0x804 0xCA 0x808 0xFD 0x80c 0x12 0x810 0x1E 我们再假设下面这些寄存器中存放着所示的值： Let’s also assume that the following registers contain the values: 寄存器 值 x0 0x804 x1 0xC x2 0x2 w3 0x4 Register Value x0 0x804 x1 0xC x2 0x2 w3 0x4 那么， 表 1 中的操作数会求值为表中所示的值。表中的每一行把一个操作数与它的形式（例如常数、寄存器、内存）、它的含义以及它的值对应起来。 Then the operands in Table 1 evaluate to the values shown there. Each row of the table matches an operand with its form (e.g., constant, register, memory), how it is translated, and its value. 表 1. 操作数示例 Table 1. Example Operands 操作数 形式 含义 值 x0 寄存器 x0 0x804 [x0] 内存 *(0x804) 0xCA #0x804 常数 0x804 0x804 [x0, #8] 内存 *( x0 + 8) 即 *(0x80c) 0x12 [x0, x1] 内存 *( x0 + x1 ) 即 *(0x810) 0x1E [x0, w3, SXTW] （符号扩展）内存 *( x0 + SignExtend( w3 )) 即 *(0x808) 0xFD [x0, x2, LSL, #2] 带比例的内存 *( x0 + ( x2 << 2 )) 即 *(0x80c) 0x12 [x0, w3, SXTW, #1] （符号扩展）带比例的内存 *( x0 + SignExtend( w3 << 1 )) 即 *(0x80c) 0x12 Operand Form Translation Value x0 Register x0 0x804 [x0] Memory *(0x804) 0xCA #0x804 Constant 0x804 0x804 [x0, #8] Memory *( x0 + 8) or *(0x80c) 0x12 [x0, x1] Memory *( x0 + x1 ) or *(0x810) 0x1E [x0, w3, SXTW] (Sign-Extend) Memory *( x0 + SignExtend( w3 )) or *(0x808) 0xFD [x0, x2, LSL, #2] Scaled Memory *( x0 + ( x2 << 2 )) or *(0x80c) 0x12 [x0, w3, SXTW, #1] (Sign-Extend) Scaled Memory *( x0 + SignExtend( w3 << 1 )) or *(0x80c) 0x12 译注 · 表中两处写法 实际汇编语法中移位说明符与移位量之间没有逗号：应写作 [x0, x2, lsl #2] 、 [x0, w3, sxtw #1] 。译者用 Clang 汇编 ldr w1, [x0, x2, lsl, #2] 会报错，去掉逗号后通过。 寄存器偏移的移位量不能随意选：它只能是 0 或「访问宽度的 log₂」。所以 ldr w1, [x0, w3, sxtw #1] （4 字节加载配 #1 ）会被汇编器拒绝，只有 2 字节加载 ldrh w1, [x0, w3, sxtw #1] 才合法；4 字节加载只能用 #2 （或不移位）。表中按「 w3 左移 1 位」算出的 0x80c 只是演示寻址计算。 在 表 1 中，记号 x0 表示 64 位寄存器 x0 中存放的值，而 w3 表示组成部分寄存器 w3 中存放的 32 位值。操作数 [x0] 表示应当把 x0 中的值当作一个地址，并对它解引用（查找该地址处的值）。因此，操作数 [x0] 对应于 *(0x804)，即值 0xCA。可以用字的符号扩展（ SXTW ）指令把对 32 位寄存器的操作与 64 位寄存器结合起来。所以， [x0, w3, SXTW] 先把 w3 符号扩展为 64 位值，再把它加到 x0 上并执行内存查找。最后，带比例的内存类型可以通过左移来计算偏移量。 In Table 1 , the notation x0 indicates the value stored in 64-bit register x0 , whereas w3 indicates a 32-bit value stored in component register w3 . The operand [x0] indicates that the value inside x0 should be treated as an address, and to dereference (look up) the value at that address. Therefore, the operand [x0] corresponds to *(0x804) or the value 0xCA. An operation on a 32-bit register can be combined with a 64-bit register using the sign-extend word ( SXTW ) instruction. So, [x0, w3, SXTW] sign extends w3 into a 64-bit value before adding it to x0 and performing a memory lookup. Lastly, scaled memory types enable the calculation of offsets through the use of a left shift. 在继续之前，有几点重要说明。尽管 表 1 列出了许多合法的操作数形式，但并不是所有形式在所有情况下都可以互换使用。 A few important notes before continuing. Although Table 1 shows many valid operand forms, not all forms can be used interchangeably in all circumstances. 具体来说： Specifically: 不能直接对内存中的数据进行读写运算；ARM 遵循加载/存储（load/store）模型，要求数据在寄存器中进行运算。因此，数据必须先被传送到寄存器才能参与运算，运算完成后再传送回内存。 Data cannot be read or written to memory directly; instead, ARM follows a load/store model, which requires data to be operated on in registers. Thus, data must be transferred to registers before being operated on, and transferred back to memory after the operations are complete. 指令的目标部分必须始终是寄存器。 The destination component of an instruction must always be a register. 表 1 是供参考的；不过，理解关键的操作数形式会帮助读者更快地读懂汇编语言。 Table 1 is provided as a reference; however, understanding key operand forms will help improve the reader’s speed in parsing assembly language.

说明 本文是个人学习用的 非官方 中英对照译文，原文： https://diveintosystems.org/book/C9-ARM64/buffer_overflow.html 。 原书采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可（禁止演绎）， 请勿公开传播本译文 。 标为「译注」「现代更新」的内容是译者补充，不代表原书作者观点；代码与原文逐字一致，未作改动。 9.10. Real World: Buffer Overflow C 语言不会自动做数组越界检查。访问数组边界以外的内存是有问题的，常常导致段错误之类的错误。然而，聪明的攻击者可以注入恶意代码，故意越过数组（也称为 缓冲区 ，buffer）的边界，迫使程序以非预期的方式执行。在最坏的情况下，攻击者可以运行代码获得 root 权限 ，也就是对计算机系统的操作系统级访问权。利用程序中已知的缓冲区越界错误来达到目的的软件，称为 缓冲区溢出攻击 （buffer overflow exploit）。 The C language does not perform automatic array bounds checking. Accessing memory outside of the bounds of an array is problematic and often results in errors such as segmentation faults. However, a clever attacker can inject malicious code that intentionally overruns the boundary of an array (also known as a buffer ) to force the program to execute in an unintended manner. In the worst cases, the attacker can run code that allows them to gain root privilege , or OS-level access to the computer system. A piece of software that takes advantage of the existence of a known buffer overrun error in a program is known as a buffer overflow exploit . 本节我们使用 GDB 和汇编语言，完整剖析缓冲区溢出攻击的机制。阅读本章之前，建议先看看讲解 用 GDB 检查汇编代码 的那一章。 In this section, we use GDB and assembly language to fully characterize the mechanics of a buffer overflow exploit. Prior to reading this chapter we encourage you to explore the chapter discussing GDB for inspecting assembly code . 9.10.1. 著名的缓冲区溢出案例 9.10.1. Famous Examples of Buffer Overflow 缓冲区溢出攻击出现于 20 世纪 80 年代，直到 21 世纪头几年一直是计算机行业的头号祸害。虽然许多现代操作系统已经能防御最简单的缓冲区溢出攻击，但粗心的编程错误仍然可能让现代程序门户大开。最近在 Skype 1 、Android 2 、Google Chrome 3 等软件中都发现过缓冲区溢出漏洞。 Buffer overflow exploits emerged in the 1980s and remained a chief scourge of the computing industry through the early parts of the 2000s. While many modern operating systems have protections against the simplest buffer overflow attacks, careless programming errors can still leave modern programs wide open to attack. Buffer overflow exploits have recently been discovered in Skype 1 , Android 2 , Google Chrome 3 , and others. 下面是几个著名的历史案例。 Here are some notable historic examples of buffer overflow exploits. 莫里斯蠕虫 （The Morris Worm） 莫里斯蠕虫 4 于 1988 年从 MIT 释放到 ARPANet 上（为的是掩盖它出自康奈尔大学一名学生之手），它利用了 UNIX finger 守护进程（ fingerd ）中的一个缓冲区越界漏洞。在 Linux 和其他类 UNIX 系统中， 守护进程 （daemon）是一类在后台持续运行的进程，通常执行清理和监控任务。 fingerd 守护进程返回关于某台计算机或某个人的友好报告。最要命的是，这个蠕虫的复制机制会把它多次发送到同一台计算机上，把系统拖到无法使用的地步。尽管作者声称这个蠕虫只是一次无害的智力练习，但复制机制让它极易传播，也很难清除。此后多年，还有其他蠕虫利用缓冲区溢出攻击未经授权进入系统，著名的有 Code Red（2001）、MS-SQLSlammer（2003）和 W32/Blaster（2003）。 The Morris Worm The Morris Worm 4 was released in 1988 on ARPANet from MIT (to hide that it was written by a student at Cornell) and exploited a buffer overrun vulnerability that existed in the Unix finger daemon ( fingerd ). In Linux and other Unix-like systems, a daemon is a type of process that continuously executes in the background, usually performing clean-up and monitoring tasks. The fingerd daemon returns a user-friendly report on a computer or person. Most crucially, the worm had a replication mechanism that caused it to be sent to the same computer multiple times, bogging down the system to an unusable state. While the author claimed that the worm was meant as a harmless intellectual exercise, the replication mechanism enabled the worm to spread easily and made it difficult to remove. In future years, other worms would employ buffer overflow exploits to gain unauthorized access into systems. Notable examples include Code Red (2001), MS-SQLSlammer (2003), and W32/Blaster (2003). AOL 聊天大战 （AOL Chat Wars） 前微软工程师 David Auerbach 5 详细讲述了他在 20 世纪 90 年代末把微软的 Messenger Service（MMS）与 AOL Instant Messenger 打通时遭遇的一次缓冲区溢出。那时，想和亲友即时通信（IM），AOL Instant Messenger（AIM）是 不二之选 。微软想在这个市场站稳脚跟，就在 MMS 中设计了一个功能，让 MMS 用户能和他们的 AIM「好友」聊天。AOL 很不高兴，给服务器打了补丁，让 MMS 无法再连上。微软工程师想出办法让 MMS 客户端模仿 AIM 客户端发给 AOL 服务器的消息，使 AOL 难以区分消息来自 MMS 还是 AIM。AOL 的回应是改变 AIM 发送消息的方式，MMS 工程师则相应地修改客户端消息，使之再次与 AIM 的一致。这场「聊天大战」一直持续，直到 AOL 开始利用 自家客户端里 的一个缓冲区溢出错误来验证发来的消息是否来自 AIM 客户端。由于 MMS 客户端没有同样的漏洞，聊天大战就此结束，AOL 获胜。 AOL Chat Wars David Auerbach 5 , a former Microsoft engineer, detailed his experience with a buffer overflow during his efforts to integrate Microsoft’s Messenger Service (MMS) with AOL Instant Messenger in the late 1990s. Back then, AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) was the service to use if you wanted to instant message (or IM) friends and family. Microsoft tried to gain a foothold in this market by designing a feature in MMS that enabled MMS users to talk to their AIM “buddies.” Displeased, AOL patched their servers so that MMS could no longer connect to them. Microsoft engineers figured out a way for MMS clients to mimic the messages sent by AIM clients to AOL servers, making it difficult for AOL to distinguish between messages received by MMS and AIM. AOL responded by changing the way AIM sent messages, and MMS engineers duly changed their client’s messages to once again match AIM’s. This “chat war” continued until AOL started using a buffer overflow error in their own client to verify that sent messages came from AIM clients. Since MMS clients did not have the same vulnerability, the chat wars ended, with AOL as the victor. 9.10.2. 初探：猜谜游戏 9.10.2. A First Look: The Guessing Game 为了帮助你理解缓冲区溢出攻击的机制，我们提供了一个简单程序的可执行文件，用户可以和它玩猜谜游戏。在 这个链接 下载 secret 可执行文件，并用 tar 命令解压： To help you understand the mechanism of the buffer overflow attack, we provide an executable of a simple program that enables the user to play a guessing game with the program. Download the secret executable at this link and extract it using the tar command: $ tar -xzvf secretARM64.tar.gz 下面给出与该可执行文件对应的主文件 main.c （ main.c ）的副本： In the following, we provide a copy of main.c ( main.c ), the main file associated with the executable: #include <stdio.h> #include <stdlib.h> #include "other.h" int endGame(void){ printf("You win!
"); exit(0); } int playGame(void){ int guess, secret, len, x=3; char buf[12]; printf("Enter secret number:
"); scanf("%s", buf); guess = atoi(buf); secret=getSecretCode(); if (guess == secret) printf("You got it right!
"); else{ printf("You are so wrong!
"); return 1; } printf("Enter the secret string to win:
"); scanf("%s", buf); guess = calculateValue(buf, strlen(buf)); if (guess != secret){ printf("You lose!
"); return 2; } endGame(); return 0; } int main(void) { int res = playGame(); return res; } 这个游戏先提示用户输入一个秘密数字，再输入一个秘密字符串，两者都对才能赢。头文件 other.h 包含 getSecretCode 和 calculateValue 函数的定义，但我们拿不到它。那么用户怎样才能打败这个程序？暴力穷举会花太长时间。一种策略是在 GDB 中分析 secret 可执行文件，单步执行汇编代码，找出秘密数字和字符串。通过检查汇编代码来弄清它如何工作的过程，通常称为 逆向工程 （reverse engineering）。对 GDB 和阅读汇编足够熟练的读者，应该能用 GDB 逆向出秘密数字和秘密字符串。 This game prompts the user to enter first a secret number and then a secret string to win the guessing game. The header file other.h contains the definition of the getSecretCode and calculateValue functions, but it is unavailable to us. How then can a user beat the program? Brute forcing the solution will take too long. One strategy is to analyze the secret executable in GDB and step through the assembly to reveal the secret number and string. The process of examining assembly code to reveal knowledge of how it works is commonly referred to as reverse engineering . Readers comfortable enough with GDB and reading assembly should be able to use GDB to reverse engineer the secret number and the secret string. 不过，还有另一种更狡猾的取胜方法。 However, there is a different, sneakier way to win. 9.10.3. 仔细看看（C 之下） 9.10.3. Taking a Closer Look (Under the C) 程序在第一次调用 scanf 处有一个潜在的缓冲区越界漏洞。为了弄清发生了什么，我们用 GDB 查看 main 函数的汇编代码。我们还在地址 0x0000aaaaaaaaa92c 处设一个断点，它是调用 scanf 之前那条指令的地址（如果把断点设在 scanf 的地址上，程序会停在 scanf 调用 内部 ，而不是 main 中），然后用 ni 向前执行一条指令： The program contains a potential buffer overrun vulnerability at the first call to scanf . To understand what is going on, let’s inspect the assembly code of the main function using GDB. Let’s also place a breakpoint at address 0x0000aaaaaaaaa92c, which is the address of the instruction right before the call to scanf (placing the breakpoint at the address for scanf causes program execution to halt inside the call to scanf , not in main ) and then use ni to advance forward one instruction: Dump of assembler code for function playGame: 0x0000aaaaaaaaa908 <+0>: stp x29, x30, [sp, #-48]! 0x0000aaaaaaaaa90c <+4>: mov x29, sp 0x0000aaaaaaaaa910 <+8>: mov w0, #0x3 0x0000aaaaaaaaa914 <+12>: str w0, [x29, #44] 0x0000aaaaaaaaa918 <+16>: adrp x0, 0xaaaaaaaaa000 0x0000aaaaaaaaa91c <+20>: add x0, x0, #0xac0 0x0000aaaaaaaaa920 <+24>: bl 0xaaaaaaaaa730 <puts@plt> 0x0000aaaaaaaaa924 <+28>: add x1, x29, #0x18 0x0000aaaaaaaaa928 <+32>: adrp x0, 0xaaaaaaaaa000 0x0000aaaaaaaaa92c <+36>: add x0, x0, #0xad8 => 0x0000aaaaaaaaa930 <+40>: bl 0xaaaaaaaaa740 <__isoc99_scanf@plt> 图 1 描绘了调用 scanf 之前那一刻的栈。 Figure 1 depicts the stack immediately before the call to scanf . 图 1. 调用 scanf 之前那一刻的调用栈 Figure 1. The call stack immediately before the call to scanf 调用 scanf 之前，它的前两个参数被分别预先加载到寄存器 x0 和 x1 中。数组 buf 的地址存放在栈位置 x29+0x18 处（见 <playGame+28> ）。 Prior to the call to scanf , the first two arguments for scanf are preloaded into registers x0 and x1 , respectively. Recall that scanf terminates all strings with a null byte. 当然， 1234567890 不是秘密数字。下面是用输入字符串 1234567890 运行 secret 时的输出： Of course, 1234567890 is not the secret number. Here is the output when we try to run secret with input string 1234567890 : $ ./secret $ ./secret Enter secret number: 1234567890 You are so wrong! $ echo $? 1 echo $? 命令打印 shell 中上一条命令的返回值。在这里，程序返回了 1，因为我们输入的秘密数字是错的。回想一下，按照惯例，程序在没有错误时返回 0。接下来我们的目标是骗程序以返回值 0 退出，表示我们赢了游戏。 The echo $? command prints out the return value of the last executed command in the shell. In this case, the program returned 1, because the secret number we entered is wrong. Recall that by convention, programs return 0 when there are no errors. Our goal going forward is to trick the program to exit with a 0 return value, indicating that we won the game. 9.10.4. 缓冲区溢出：第一次尝试 9.10.4. Bus error $ echo $? 139 有意思！现在程序因总线错误（bus error，另一种内存错误）崩溃了，返回码是 139。 图 3 展示了用这个新输入调用 scanf 刚完成时 main 的调用栈。 Interesting! A Smarter Buffer Overflow: Second Attempt 第一个例子用垃圾数据覆盖了 main 保存的 x29 寄存器和返回地址，粉碎了栈，导致程序崩溃。如果攻击者的目的只是让程序崩溃，到这一步就已经满意了。但我们的目标是骗猜谜游戏返回 0，表示我们赢了。为此，我们要用比垃圾值更有意义的数据填充调用栈。例如，可以覆盖栈，把返回地址替换成 endGame 的地址。这样，当程序试图从 main 返回时，它会去执行 endGame ，而不是崩溃。 Our first example smashed the stack by overwriting the saved x29 register and return address for main with junk, causing the program to crash. An attacker whose goal is to simply crash a program would be satisfied at this point. However, our goal is to trick the guessing game to return 0, indicating that we won the game. We accomplish this by filling the call stack with data more meaningful than junk values. For example, we could overwrite the stack so that the return address is replaced with the address of endGame . Common Instructions 本节讨论几条常用的 ARM 汇编指令。 表 1 列出了 ARM 汇编中最基础的指令。 In this section, we discuss several common ARM assembly instructions. Table 1 lists the most foundational instructions in ARM assembly. 表 1. 最常用的指令 Table 1. Most Common Instructions 指令 含义 ldr D, [addr] D = *(addr)（把内存中的值加载到寄存器 D） str S, [addr] *(addr) = S（把 S 存入内存位置 *(addr)） mov D, S D = S（把 S 的值复制到 D） add D, O1, O2 D = O1 + O2（把 O1 与 O2 相加，结果存入 D） sub D, O1, O2 D = O1 - O2（从 O1 中减去 O2，结果存入 D） Instruction Translation ldr D, [addr] D = *(addr) (loads the value in memory into register D) str S, [addr] *(addr) = S (stores S into memory location *(addr) ) mov D, S D = S (copies value of S into D) add D, O1, O2 D = O1 + O2 (adds O1 to O2 and stores result in D) sub D, O1, O2 D = O1 - O2 (subtracts O2 from O1 and stores result in D) 因此，指令序列 Therefore, the sequence of instructions str w0, [sp, #12] ldr w0, [sp, #12] add w0, w0, #0x2 的含义是： translates to: 把寄存器 w0 中的值存入由 sp + 12 指定的 内存 位置（即 *(sp + 12) ）。 Store the value in register w0 in the memory location specified by sp + 12 (or *(sp + 12) ). 从 内存位置 sp + 12（即 *(sp + 12) ）加载值到寄存器 w0 。 Load the value from memory location sp + 12 (or *(sp + 12) ) into register w0 . 把值 0x2 加到寄存器 w0 上，并把结果存入寄存器 w0 （即 w0 = w0 + 0x2）。 Add the value 0x2 to register w0 , and store the result in register w0 (or w0 = w0 + 0x2). 表 1 中的 add 和 sub 指令也协助维护程序栈（即 调用栈 ，call stack）的组织结构。回想一下， 栈指针 （ sp ）由编译器保留用于调用栈管理。再回想我们之前对 程序内存 的讨论：调用栈通常存放局部变量和参数，并帮助程序跟踪自身的执行（见 图 1 ）。在 ARM 系统上，执行栈向 低 地址方向增长。和所有栈数据结构一样，操作都发生在调用栈的「顶部」；因此 sp 「指向」栈顶，它的值就是栈顶的地址。 The add and sub instructions shown in Table 1 also assist with maintaining the organization of the program stack (i.e., the call stack ). Recall that the stack pointer ( sp ) is reserved by the compiler for call stack management. Recall also from our earlier discussion on program memory that the call stack typically stores local variables and parameters and helps the program track its own execution (see Figure 1 ). On ARM systems, the execution stack grows toward lower addresses. Like all stack data structures, operations occur at the “top” of the call stack; sp therefore “points” to the top of the stack, and its value is the address of top of the stack. 图 1. 程序地址空间的组成部分 Figure 1. The parts of a program’s address space 表 2 中的 ldp 和 stp 指令协助一次移动多个内存位置的数据，通常是压入或弹出程序栈。在 表 2 中，寄存器 x0 存放的是一个内存地址。 The ldp and stp instructions shown in Table 2 assist with moving multiple memory locations, usually either on or off the program stack. In Table 2 , the register x0 holds a memory address. 表 2. 访问多个内存位置的几条指令 Table 2. Some Instructions for Accessing Multiple Memory Locations 指令 含义 ldp D1, D2, [x0] D1 = *(x0)，D2 = *(x0+8)（把 x0 和 x0+8 处的值分别加载到寄存器 D1 和 D2） ldp D1, D2, [x0, #0x10]! x0 = x0 + 0x10， 然后 令 D1 = *(x0)，D2 = *(x0+8) ldp D1, D2, [x0], #0x10 D1 = *(x0)，D2 = *(x0+8)， 然后 令 x0 = x0 + 0x10 stp S1, S2, [x0] *(x0) = S1，*(x0+8) = S2（把 S1 和 S2 分别存到位置 *(x0) 和 *(x0+8)） stp S1, S2, [x0, #-16]! 令 x0 = x0 - 16， 然后 存储 *(x0) = S1，*(x0+8) = S2 stp S1, S2, [x0], #-16 存储 *(x0) = S1，*(x0+8) = S2， 然后 令 x0 = x0 - 16 Instruction Translation ldp D1, D2, [x0] D1 = *(x0), D2 = *(x0+8) (loads the value at x0 and x0+8 into registers D1 and D2, respectively) ldp D1, D2, [x0, #0x10]! x0 = x0 + 0x10, then sets D1 = *(x0), D2 = *(x0+8) ldp D1, D2, [x0], #0x10 D1 = *(x0), D2 = *(x0+8), then sets x0 = x0 + 0x10 stp S1, S2, [x0] *(x0) = S1, *(x0+8) = S2 (stores S1 and S2 at locations *(x0) and *(x0+8), respectively) stp S1, S2, [x0, #-16]! sets x0 = x0 - 16, then stores *(x0) = S1, *(x0+8) = S2 stp S1, S2, [x0], #-16 stores *(x0) = S1, *(x0+8) = S2 then sets x0 = x0 - 16 简而言之， ldp 指令从寄存器 x0 中存放的内存位置，以及距该位置偏移 8 的位置（即 x0 + 0x8），加载一对值，分别放入目标寄存器 D1 和 D2。而 stp 指令把源寄存器 S1 和 S2 中的一对值，存到寄存器 x0 中存放的内存位置以及距该地址偏移 8 的位置（即 x0 + 0x8）。注意，这里假设寄存器中的值是 64 位的量。如果使用的是 32 位寄存器，内存偏移就分别变为 x0 和 x0 + 0x4。 In short, the ldp instruction loads a pair of values from the memory locations held in register x0 and at an offset of eight from that memory location (i.e., x0 + 0x8) into the destination registers D1 and D2, respectively. Meanwhile, the stp instruction stores the pair of values in source registers S1 and S2 to the memory locations held in register x0 and at an offset of eight from that address (i.e., x0 + 0x8). Note that the assumption here is that values in the registers are 64-bit quantities. If 32-bit registers are being used instead, the memory offsets change to x0 and x0 + 0x4 respectively. ldp 和 stp 指令还有两种特殊形式，可以同时更新 x0 。例如，指令 stp S1, S2, [x0, #-16]! 表示 先 从 x0 中减去 16 字节，然后才把 S1 和 S2 存到偏移 [x0] 和 [x0+0x8] 处。与之相反，指令 ldp D1, D2, [x0], #0x10 表示先把偏移 [x0] 和 [x0+8] 处的值存入目标寄存器 D1 和 D2， 然后 才给 x0 加上 16 字节。正如我们 后面 将看到的，这两种特殊形式常用在包含多次函数调用的函数的开头和结尾。 There are also two special forms of the ldp and stp instructions that enable simultaneous updates to x0 . For example, the instruction stp S1, S2, [x0, #-16]! implies that 16 bytes should first be subtracted from x0 , and only afterward should S1 and S2 be stored at the offsets [x0] and [x0+0x8] . In contrast, the instruction ldp D1, D2, [x0], #0x10 states that the values at offsets [x0] and [x0+8] should first be stored in destination registers D1 and D2 and only afterward should x0 have 16 bytes added to it. These special forms are commonly used at the beginning and end of functions that have multiple function calls, as we will see later . 译注 带 ! 的形式叫 前变址 （pre-index，先改基址再访问）， [x0], #imm 的形式叫 后变址 （post-index，先访问再改基址）。函数开头常见的 stp x29, x30, [sp, #-32]! 就是前变址：一条指令同时完成「栈指针下移」和「保存帧指针与返回地址」。 9.2.1. 综合运用：一个更具体的例子 9.2.1. Putting It All Together: A More Concrete Example 我们来仔细看看 adder2 函数 Let’s take a closer look at the adder2 function //adds two to an integer and returns the result int adder2(int a) { return a + 2; } 以及它对应的汇编代码： and its corresponding assembly code: 0000000000000724 <adder2>: 724: d10043ff sub sp, sp, #0x10 728: b9000fe0 str w0, [sp, #12] 72c: b9400fe0 ldr w0, [sp, #12] 730: 11000800 add w0, w0, #0x2 734: 910043ff add sp, sp, #0x10 738: d65f03c0 ret 这段汇编代码由一条 sub 指令、随后的 str 和 ldr 指令、两条 add 指令，以及最后一条 ret 指令组成。要理解 CPU 如何执行这组指令，我们需要重温 程序内存 的结构。回想一下，程序每次执行时，操作系统都会为新程序分配地址空间（也称为 虚拟内存 ）。 虚拟内存 以及与之相关的 进程 概念会在第 13 章中详细介绍；目前，只需把进程看作正在运行的程序的抽象，把虚拟内存看作分配给单个进程的内存。每个进程都有自己的一块称为 调用栈 的内存区域。记住，调用栈位于进程/虚拟内存中，这与寄存器（位于 CPU 中）不同。 The assembly code consists of a sub instruction, followed by str and ldr instructions, two add instructions, and finally a ret instruction. To understand how the CPU executes this set of instructions, we need to revisit the structure of program memory . Recall that every time a program executes, the operating system allocates the new program’s address space (also known as virtual memory ). Virtual memory and the related concept of processes are covered in greater detail in Chapter 13; for now, it suffices to think of a process as the abstraction of a running program and virtual memory as the memory that is allocated to a single process. Every process has its own region of memory called the call stack . Keep in mind that the call stack is located in process/virtual memory, unlike registers (which are located in the CPU). 图 2 描绘了执行 adder2 函数之前调用栈和寄存器的一个示例状态。 Figure 2 depicts a sample state of the call stack and registers prior to the execution of the adder2 function. 图 2. 执行之前的执行栈 Figure 2. Execution stack prior to execution 注意，栈向 低 地址方向增长。按照惯例， adder2 函数的参数（即 a ）存放在寄存器 x0 中。由于 a 是 int 类型，它存放在组成部分寄存器 w0 中，如 图 2 所示。同样，由于 adder2 函数返回 int ，返回值使用组成部分寄存器 w0 而不是 x0 。 Notice that the stack grows toward lower addresses. The parameter to the adder2 function (or a ) is stored in register x0 by convention. Since a is of type int , it is stored in component register w0 , as shown in Figure 2 . Likewise, since the adder2 function returns an int , component register w0 is used for the return value instead of x0 . 为了让图更易读，程序内存代码段中各条指令的地址被缩写为 0x724–0x738。同样，程序内存调用栈段的地址从 0xffffffffee40–0xffffffffee50 缩写为 0xe40–0xe50。实际上，调用栈地址在程序内存中位于比代码段地址高得多的位置。 The addresses associated with the instructions in the code segment of program memory have been shortened to 0x724-0x738 to improve figure readability. Likewise, the addresses associated with the call stack segment of program memory have been shortened to 0xe40-0xe50 from a range of 0xffffffffee40 to 0xffffffffee50. In truth, call stack addresses occur at much higher addresses in program memory than code segment addresses. 请留意寄存器 sp 和 pc 的初始值：它们分别是 0xe50 和 0x724。 pc 寄存器（即程序计数器）指示下一条要执行的指令，地址 0x724 对应于 adder2 函数中的第一条指令。下面各图中红色（左上角）的箭头直观地标出当前正在执行的指令。 Pay close attention to the initial values of registers sp and pc : they are 0xe50 and 0x724, respectively. The pc register (or program counter) indicates the next instruction to execute, and the address 0x724 corresponds to the first instruction in the adder2 function. Preliminaries 条件比较指令 Conditional Comparison Instructions 比较指令执行一次算术运算，目的是引导程序的条件执行。 表 1 列出了与条件控制相关的基本指令。 Comparison instructions perform an arithmetic operation for the purpose of guiding the conditional execution of a program. Table 1 lists the basic instructions associated with conditional control. 表 1. 条件控制指令 Table 1. Conditional Control Instructions 指令 含义 cmp O1, O2 比较 O1 与 O2（计算 O1 - O2） tst O1, O2 计算 O1 & O2 Instruction Translation cmp O1, O2 Compares O1 with O2 (computes O1 - O2) tst O1, O2 Computes O1 & O2 cmp 指令比较两个操作数 O1 和 O2 的值，具体来说，就是从 O1 中减去 O2。 tst 指令执行按位与。常常会看到这样一条指令： The cmp instruction compares the value of two operands, O1 and O2. Specifically, it subtracts O2 from O1. The tst instruction performs bitwise AND. It is common to see an instruction like: tst x0, x0 在这个例子中， x0 与自身按位与的结果，只有在 x0 为零时才为零。换句话说，这是检测值是否为零，等价于： In this example, the bitwise AND of x0 with itself is zero only when x0 contains zero. In other words, this is a test for a zero value and is equivalent to: cmp x0, #0 与迄今介绍的算术指令不同， cmp 和 tst 不修改目标寄存器，而是修改一系列称为 条件码标志 （condition code flag）的单位值。例如， cmp 会根据 O1 - O2 的结果是正（大于）、负（小于）还是零（等于）来修改条件码标志。回想一下， 条件码 的值编码了 ALU 中一次运算的相关信息。条件码标志是 ARM 处理器状态（ PSTATE ）的一部分， PSTATE 取代了 ARMv7-A 系统中的当前程序状态寄存器（ CPSR ）。 Unlike the arithmetic instructions covered thus far, cmp and tst do not modify a destination register. Instead, both instructions modify a series of single-bit values known as condition code flags . For example, cmp will modify condition code flags based on whether the value O1 - O2 results in a positive (greater), negative (less), or zero (equal) value. Recall that condition code values encode information about an operation in the ALU. The condition code flags are part of the ARM processor state ( PSTATE ), which replaces the current program status register ( CPSR ) from ARMv7-A systems. 表 2. 常用的条件码标志 Table 2. Common Condition Code Flags 标志 含义 Z 是否等于零（1：是，0：否） N 是否为负（1：是，0：否） V 是否发生了有符号溢出（1：是，0：否） C 是否发生了算术进位/无符号溢出（1：是，0：否） Flag Translation Z Is equal to zero (1: yes, 0: no) N Is negative (1: yes, 0: no) V Signed overflow has occurred (1: yes, 0: no) C Arithmetic carry/unsigned overflow has occurred (1: yes, 0: no) 表 2 描绘了用于条件码运算的常用标志。回到 cmp O1, O2 指令： Table 2 depicts the common flags used for condition code operations. Revisiting the cmp O1, O2 instruction: 如果 O1 和 O2 相等， Z 标志被置为 1。 The Z flag is set to 1 if O1 and O2 are equal. 如果 O1 小于 O2（即 O1 - O2 的结果为负）， N 标志被置为 1。 The N flag is set to 1 if O1 is less than O2 (i.e. O1 - O2 results in a negative value). 如果运算 O1 - O2 导致溢出， V 标志被置为 1（用于有符号比较）。 The V flag is set to 1 if the operation O1 - O2 results in overflow (useful for signed comparisons). 如果运算 O1 - O2 产生算术进位， C 标志被置为 1（用于无符号比较）。 The C flag is set to 1 if the operation O1 - O2 results in an arithmetic carry operation (useful for unsigned comparisons). 译注 · ARM 的 C 标志与 x86 相反 做减法（包括 cmp ）时，ARM 的 C 标志表示「 没有 借位」：当 O1 ≥ O2（按无符号比较）时 C = 1，O1 < O2 时 C = 0。这与 x86 恰好相反（x86 的 CF = 1 表示发生了借位）。下面表 4 中无符号「大于或等于」对应的后缀 cs （carry set）就是这个原因。译者在 Apple Silicon Mac 上用内联汇编执行 cmp 后再用 cset ..., cs 读出 C ： cmp 5,3 得 1， cmp 4,4 得 1， cmp 3,5 得 0。 尽管深入讨论条件码标志超出了本书的范围，但正是 cmp 和 tst 对这些标志的设置，使我们接下来要介绍的那组指令（ 分支 指令）能够正确运作。 While an in-depth discussion of condition code flags is beyond the scope of this book, the setting of these registers by cmp and tst enables the next set of instructions we cover (the branch instructions) to operate correctly. 分支指令 The Branch Instructions 分支指令让程序的执行能「跳」到代码中的一个新位置。在我们迄今跟踪过的汇编程序中， pc 总是指向程序内存中的下一条指令。分支指令使 pc 能被设置为一条还没见过的新指令（例如 if 语句的情形），或者一条之前执行过的指令（例如循环的情形）。 A branch instruction enables a program’s execution to “jump” to a new position in the code. In the assembly programs we have traced through thus far, pc always points to the next instruction in program memory. The branch instructions enable pc to be set to either a new instruction not yet seen (as in the case of an if statement) or to a previously executed instruction (as in the case of a loop). 直接分支指令 Direct branch instructions 表 3. 常用的分支指令 Table 3. Common Branch Instructions 指令 说明 b addr L pc = addr br A pc = A cbz R, addr L 如果 R 等于 0， pc = addr（条件分支） cbnz R, addr L 如果 R 不等于 0， pc = addr（条件分支） b.c addr L 如果条件 c 成立， pc = addr（条件分支） Instruction Description b addr L pc = addr br A pc = A cbz R, addr L If R is equal to 0, pc = addr (conditional branch) cbnz R, addr L If R is not equal to 0, pc = addr (conditional branch) b.c addr L If c, pc = addr (conditional branch) 表 3 列出了常用的分支指令； L 指一个 符号标签 （symbolic label），它在程序的目标文件中充当标识符。所有标签都由一些字母和数字后跟一个冒号组成。标签相对于目标文件的作用域可以是 局部 的或 全局 的。函数标签通常是 全局 的，一般由函数名加冒号组成。例如， main: （或 <main>: ）用来标记用户定义的 main 函数。按照惯例，作用域为 局部 的标签通常以句点开头。在 if 语句或循环中，可能会遇到名为 .L1 这样的局部标签。 Table 3 lists the set of common branch instructions; L refers to a symbolic label , which serves as an identifier in the program’s object file. All labels consist of some letters and digits followed by a colon. Labels can be local or global to an object file’s scope. Function labels tend to be global and usually consist of the function name and a colon. For example, main: (or <main>: ) is used to label a user-defined main function. By convention, labels whose scope are local are typically preceded by a period. One may encounter a local label with a name like .L1 in the context of an if statement or loop. 所有标签都有一个对应的地址（即 表 3 中的 addr ）。当 CPU 执行 b 指令时，它把 pc 寄存器设为 addr 。 b 指令只能让程序计数器在当前位置前后 128 MB 的范围内改变；编写汇编的程序员也可以用 br 指令指定一个要分支到的具体地址。与 b 指令不同， br 对地址范围没有限制。 All labels have an associated address ( addr in Table 3 ). When the CPU executes a b instruction, it sets the pc register to addr . The b instruction enables the program counter to change within 128 MB of its current location; a programmer writing assembly can also specify a particular address to branch to by using the br instruction. Therefore, an instruction whose address is 28 bytes away from the start of main may be represented with the label <main+28> . For example, the instruction b 0x7d0 <main+28> indicates a branch to address 0x7d0, which has the associated label <main+28> , meaning that it is 28 bytes away from the starting address of the main function. Executing this instruction sets pc to 0x7d0. 最后三条指令是 条件分支指令 。换句话说，只有当给定条件求值为真时，程序计数器寄存器才会被设为 addr 。 cbz 和 cbnz 指令除了地址之外还需要一个寄存器。对于 cbz ，如果 R 为零，就走分支， pc 被设为 addr 。对于 cbnz ，如果 R 不为零，就走分支， pc 被设为 addr 。 The last three instructions are conditional branch instructions . In other words, the program counter register is set to addr only if the given condition evaluates to true. The cbz and cbnz instructions require a register in addition to an address. In the case of cbz , if R is zero, the branch is taken and pc is set to addr . In the case of cbnz , if R is nonzero, the branch is taken and pc is set to addr . 条件分支指令中最强大的是 b.c 指令，它让编译器或汇编程序员能挑选一个自定义的后缀，指明走分支的条件。 The most powerful of the conditional branch instructions are the b.c instructions, which enable the compiler or assembly writer to pick a custom suffix that indicates the condition on which a branch is taken. 条件分支指令的后缀 Conditional branch instruction suffixes 表 4 列出了常用的条件分支后缀（c）。与分支一起使用时，每条指令都以字母 b 和一个点开头，表示它是一条分支指令。每条指令的后缀（c）表示分支的 条件 。分支指令的后缀还决定了把数值比较解释为有符号还是无符号。注意，条件分支指令的范围（1 MB）比 b 指令有限得多。这些后缀也用于条件选择指令（ csel ），我们会在下一节介绍它。 Table 4 lists the set of common conditional branch suffixes (c). When used in conjunction with a branch, each instruction starts with the letter b and a dot, denoting that it is a branch instruction. The suffix of each instruction (c) indicates the condition for the branch. The branch instruction suffixes also determine whether to interpret numerical comparisons as signed or unsigned. Note that conditional branch instructions have a much more limited range (1 MB) than the b instruction. These suffixes are also used for the conditional select instruction ( csel ), which is covered in the next section. 表 4. 条件分支指令后缀（括号中为同义后缀） Table 4. Conditional Branch Instruction Suffixes (synonyms shown in parentheses) 有符号比较 无符号比较 说明 eq eq 相等（==）或为零时分支 ne ne 不相等（!=）时分支 mi mi 为负（minus）时分支 pl pl 非负（>= 0）时分支 gt hi 大于（higher，高于）（>）时分支 ge cs ( hs ) 大于或等于（>=）时分支 lt lo ( cc ) 小于（<）时分支 le ls 小于或等于（<=）时分支 Signed Comparison Unsigned Comparison Description eq eq branch if equal (==) or branch if zero ne ne branch if not equal (!=) mi mi branch if minus (negative) pl pl branch if non-negative (>= 0) gt hi branch if greater than (higher) (>) ge cs ( hs ) branch if greater than or equal (>=) lt lo ( cc ) branch if less than (<) le ls branch if less than or equal (<=) goto 语句 The goto Statement 在接下来的几个小节中，我们会考察汇编中的条件语句和循环，并把它们逆向还原成 C。把条件语句和循环的汇编代码翻译回 C 时，理解对应的 C 语言 goto 形式会很有帮助。 goto 语句是 C 的一种原语，它强制程序的执行切换到代码中的另一行。与 goto 语句对应的汇编指令是 b 。 In the following subsections, we look at conditionals and loops in assembly and reverse engineer them back to C. When translating assembly code of conditionals and loops back into C, it is useful to understand their corresponding C language goto forms. The goto statement is a C primitive that forces program execution to switch to another line in the code. The assembly instruction associated with the goto statement is b . goto 语句由 goto 关键字后跟一个 goto 标签 （goto label）组成，goto 标签是一种指明执行应当在哪里继续的程序标签。所以， goto done 表示程序的执行应当分支到标记为 done 的那一行。C 中程序标签的其他例子包括第 2 章介绍过的 switch 语句标签 。 The goto statement consists of the goto keyword followed by a goto label , a type of program label that indicates that execution should continue at the corresponding label. So, goto done means that the program execution should branch to the line marked by label done . Other examples of program labels in C include the switch statement labels previously covered in Chapter 2. 下面的代码清单描绘了用普通 C 代码编写的函数 getSmallest （左），以及它在 C 中对应的 goto 形式（右）。 getSmallest 函数比较两个整数（ x 和 y ）的值，并把较小的值赋给变量 smallest 。 The following code listings depict a function getSmallest written in regular C code (left) and its associated goto form in C (right). The getSmallest function compares the value of two integers ( x and y ), and assigns the smaller value to variable smallest . 表 5. 一个 C 函数与其对应的 goto 形式的比较 Table 5. Comparison of a C function and its associated goto form. 普通的 C 版本 Regular C version int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if ( x > y ) { //if (conditional) smallest = y; //then statement } else { smallest = x; //else statement } return smallest; } goto 版本 Goto version int getSmallest(int x, int y) { int smallest; if (x <= y ) { //if (!conditional) goto else_statement; } smallest = y; //then statement goto done; else_statement: smallest = x; //else statement done: return smallest; } 这个函数的 goto 形式可能显得有违直觉，我们来讨论一下到底发生了什么。条件检查变量 x 是否小于或等于 y 。 The goto form of this function may seem counterintuitive, but let’s discuss what exactly is going on. The conditional checks to see whether variable x is less than or equal to y . 如果 x 小于或等于 y ，程序把控制转移到标记为 else_statement 的标签处，那里只有一条语句 smallest = x 。由于程序是线性执行的，程序接着执行标签 done 下面的代码，返回 smallest 的值（ x ）。 If x is less than or equal to y , the program transfers control to the label marked by else_statement , which contains the single statement smallest = x . Since the program executes linearly, the program continues on to execute the code under the label done , which returns the value of smallest ( x ). 如果 x 大于 y ， smallest 被设为 y 。接着程序执行语句 goto done ，把控制转移到 done 标签处，返回 smallest 的值（ y ）。 If x is greater than y , then smallest is set to y . The program then executes the statement goto done , which transfers control to the done label, which returns the value of smallest ( y ). 虽然在编程的早期 goto 语句很常用，但在现代代码中使用 goto 语句被认为是不好的做法，因为它降低了代码整体的可读性。事实上，计算机科学家艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉（Edsger Dijkstra）写过一篇抨击使用 goto 语句的著名文章，题为《 Go To 语句有害论 》（ Go To Statement Considered Harmful ） 1 。 While goto statements were commonly used in the early days of programming, their use in modern code is considered bad practice, because it reduces the overall readability of code. In fact, computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra wrote a famous paper lambasting the use of goto statements called Go To Statement Considered Harmful 1 . 一般来说，设计良好的 C 程序不使用 goto 语句，程序员也不被鼓励使用它，以免写出难以阅读、调试和维护的代码。不过，理解 C 的 goto 语句很重要，因为 GCC 在把含有条件语句的 C 代码（包括含有 if 语句和循环的代码）翻译成汇编之前，通常会先把它改写成 goto 形式。 In general, well-designed C programs do not use goto statements and programmers are discouraged from using it to avoid writing code that is difficult to read, debug, and maintain. However, the C goto statement is important to understand, as GCC typically changes C code with conditionals into a goto form prior to translating it to assembly, including code that contains if statements and loops. 接下来的几个小节更详细地介绍 if 语句和循环的汇编表示。 The following subsections cover the assembly representation of if statements and loops in greater detail. if 语句 If Statements 循环 Loops 参考文献 References Edsger Dijkstra. “Go To Statement Considered Harmful”. Communications of the ACM 11(3) pp. 147—​148. 1968.

Recursion 递归函数是一类特殊的函数，它们调用自身（也称为 自引用 函数，self-referential function）来计算一个值。和非递归的函数一样，递归函数的每次调用都会创建新的栈帧。与标准函数不同的是，递归函数中包含对自身的函数调用。 Recursive functions are a special class of functions that call themselves (also known as self-referential functions) to compute a value. Like their nonrecursive counterparts, recursive functions create new stack frames for each function call. Unlike standard functions, recursive functions contain function calls to themselves. 我们再来看把从 1 到 n 的正整数加起来的问题。在前面的小节中，我们讨论了实现这一任务的 sumUp 函数。 表 1 展示了一个相关的函数 sumDown ，它倒序（从 n 到 1）累加这些数，以及与它等价的递归函数： Let’s revisit the problem of summing up the set of positive integers from 1 to n . In previous sections, we discussed the sumUp function to achieve this task. Table 1 shows a related function called sumDown , which adds the numbers in reverse ( n to 1), and its recursive equivalent: 表 1. sumDown 函数的迭代版本与递归版本 Table 1. Iterative and recursive version of the sumDown function. 迭代版本 Iterative int sumDown(int n) { int total = 0; int i = n; while (i > 0) { total += i; i--; } return total; } 递归版本 Recursive int sumr(int n) { if (n <= 0) { return 0; } return n + sumr(n-1); } 递归函数 sumr 中的基本情形处理所有小于或等于零的 n 值，递归步骤则把 n 的当前值加到以 n - 1 调用 sumr 的结果上。编译 sumr 并用 GDB 反汇编，得到下面的汇编代码： The base case in the recursive function sumr accounts for any values of n that are less than or equal to zero, and the recursive step adds the current value of n to the result of the function call to sumr with the value n - 1. Compiling sumr and disassembling it with GDB yields the following assembly code: Dump of assembler code for function sumr: 0x770 <+0>: stp x29, x30, [sp, #-32]! // sp = sp-32; store x29,x30 on stack 0x774 <+4>: mov x29, sp // x29 = sp (i.e. x29 = top of stack) 0x778 <+8>: str w0, [x29, #28] // store w0 at x29+28 (n) 0x77c <+12>: ldr w0, [x29, #28] // w0 = n 0x780 <+16>: cmp w0, #0x0 // compare n to 0 0x784 <+20>: b.gt 0x790 <sumr+32> // if (n > 0) goto <sumr+32> 0x788 <+24>: mov w0, #0x0 // w0 = 0 0x78c <+28>: b 0x7a8 <sumr+56> // goto <sumr+56> 0x790 <+32>: ldr w0, [x29, #28] // w0 = n 0x794 <+36>: sub w0, w0, #0x1 // w0 = w0 - 1 (i.e. n-1) 0x798 <+40>: bl 0x770 <sumr> // call sumr(n-1) (result) 0x79c <+44>: mov w1, w0 // copy result into register w1 0x7a0 <+48>: ldr w0, [x29, #28] // w0 = n 0x7a4 <+52>: add w0, w1, w0 // w0 = w0 + w1 (i.e n + result) 0x7a8 <+56>: ldp x29, x30, [sp], #32 // restore x29, x30, and sp 0x7ac <+60>: ret // return w0 (result) 上面汇编代码的每一行都附有英文注释。 表 2 给出了对应的 goto 形式（左），以及不含 goto 语句的 C 程序（右）： Each line in the preceding assembly code is annotated with its English translation. Table 2 shows the corresponding goto form (left) and C program without goto statements (right): 表 2. sumr() 汇编代码的 C goto 形式及其翻译 Table 2. C Goto form and translation of sumr() assembly code. C goto 形式 C goto form int sumr(int n) { int result; if (n > 0) { goto body; } result = 0; goto done; body: result = n; result--; result = sumr(result); result += n; done: return result; } 不含 goto 语句的 C 版本 C version without goto statements int sumr(int n) { int result; if (n <= 0) { return 0; } result = sumr(n-1); result += n; return result; } 尽管这个翻译乍一看与原来的 sumr 函数并不完全相同，但仔细检查就会发现，两个函数确实是等价的。 Although this translation may not initially appear to be identical to the original sumr function, close inspection reveals that the two functions are indeed equivalent. 9.6.1. 动画：观察调用栈如何变化 9.6.1. (*x)++ : 1; } 每个函数都以一个指向整数的指针作为输入，并检查它是否为 NULL 。如果 x 不为 NULL ，函数让 x 所指向的值加一并返回它；否则，函数返回值 1。 Each function takes a pointer to an integer as input and checks whether it is NULL . Recall that dereferencing a null pointer leads to a null pointer exception in the code, causing a segmentation fault. To prevent any chance of this happening, the compiler takes the safe road and uses a branch.

We also introduce some new instructions involved with function management. 我们先复习一下调用栈是如何管理的。回想一下， sp 是 栈指针 ，总是指向栈顶。寄存器 x29 表示基址指针（也称 帧指针 ，即 FP ），指向当前栈帧的底部。 栈帧 （stack frame，也称 活动帧 或 活动记录 ）指的是栈中分配给单次函数调用的那一部分。当前正在执行的函数总是位于栈顶，它的栈帧称为 活动帧 （active frame）。活动帧的边界由栈指针（在栈顶，地址较低）和帧指针（在帧底，地址较高）界定。活动记录中通常存放着函数的局部变量。最后， 返回地址 （return address）表示被调用函数退出后，调用函数（例如 main ）从哪个程序地址继续执行。在 A64 系统中，返回地址存放在寄存器 x30 （也称 LR ，链接寄存器）中。 Let’s begin with a refresher on how the call stack is managed. Recall that sp is the stack pointer and always points to the top of the stack. The register x29 represents the base pointer (also known as the frame pointer or FP ) and points to the base of the current stack frame. The stack frame (also known as the activation frame or the activation record ) refers to the portion of the stack allocated to a single function call. The currently executing function is always at the top of the stack, and its stack frame is referred to as the active frame . The active frame is bounded by the stack pointer (at the top of stack, lower address) and frame pointer (at the bottom of the frame, higher address). The activation record typically holds local variables for a function. Lastly, the return address indicates the program address at which the calling function (e.g., main ) resumes execution once the callee function exits. In A64 systems, the return address is stored in register x30 (also known as LR ). 图 1 展示了 main 及其调用的一个名为 fname 的函数的栈帧。我们把 main 函数称为 调用者 （caller）函数，把 fname 称为 被调用者 （callee）函数。 Figure 1 shows the stack frames for main and a function it calls named fname . A64 的对齐策略要求：四字节的数据类型（例如 int ）位于四的倍数的地址上，而 64 位的数据类型（ long 、 double 和指针数据）位于八的倍数的地址上。对于 struct ，编译器会在字段之间添加空字节作为「填充」（padding），以确保每个字段都满足其对齐要求。例如，在上面代码片段声明的 struct 中，编译器在字节 a 63 处添加了一个字节的填充，确保 age 字段从一个四的倍数的地址开始。在内存中正确对齐的值可以在单次操作中被读取或写入，从而提高效率。 A64’s alignment policy requires that four-byte data types (e.g., int ) reside at addresses that are a multiple of four, whereas 64-bit data types ( long , double , and pointer data) reside at addresses that are a multiple of eight. For a struct , the compiler adds empty bytes as “padding” between fields to ensure that each field satisfies its alignment requirements. For example, in the struct declared in the previous code snippet, the compiler adds a byte of padding at byte a 63 to ensure that the age field starts at an address that is at a multiple of four. Values aligned properly in memory can be read or written in a single operation, enabling greater efficiency. 考虑把 struct 定义成下面这样时会发生什么： Consider what happens when the struct is defined as the following: struct studentTM { int age; int grad_yr; float gpa; char name[63]; }; struct studentTM student3; 把 name 数组移到最后，就把那个填充字节移到了结构体的末尾，确保 age 、 grad_yr 和 gpa 都是四字节对齐的。 Moving the name array to the end moves the byte of padding to the end of the struct, ensuring that age , grad_yr , and gpa are four-byte aligned.
